6.24.7: kuñjarāṇāṁ ca nadatāṁ sainyānāṁ ca prahr̥ṣyatām ॥7॥
6.24.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi śrīmadbhagavadgītāparvaṇi dhr̥tarāṣṭrasañjayasaṁvāde caturviṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥24॥
6.25.7: asmākaṁ tu viśiṣṭā ye tān nibodha dvijottama,
nāyakā mama sainyasya sañjñārthaṁ tān bravīmi te ॥7॥
6.25.9: anye ca bahavaḥ śūrā madarthe tyaktajīvitāḥ,
6.25.18: saubhadraśca mahābāhuḥ śaṅkhān dadhmuḥ pr̥thak pr̥thak ॥18॥
6.25.26: ācāryān mātulān bhrātr̥̄n putrān pautrān sakhīṁstathā ॥26॥
6.25.27: tān samīkṣya sa kaunteyaḥ sarvān bandhūnavasthitān ॥27॥
6.25.29: sīdanti mama gātrāṇi mukhaṁ ca pariśuṣyati,
6.25.30: gāṇḍīvaṁ sraṁsate hastāt tvak caiva paridahyate,
na ca śaknomyavasthātuṁ bhramatīva ca me manaḥ ॥30॥
6.25.32: na kāṅkṣe vijayaṁ kr̥ṣṇa na ca rājyaṁ sukhāni ca,
kiṁ no rājyena govinda kiṁ bhogairjīvitena vā ॥32॥
6.25.33: yeṣāmarthe kāṅkṣitaṁ no rājyaṁ bhogāḥ sukhāni ca,
ta ime’vasthitā yuddhe prāṇāṁstyaktvā dhanāni ca ॥33॥
6.25.35: api trailokya rājyasya hetoḥ kiṁ nu mahīkr̥te ॥35॥
6.25.36: nihatya dhārtarāṣṭrān naḥ kā prītiḥ syājjanārdana,
6.25.37: svajanaṁ hi kathaṁ hatvā sukhinaḥ syāma mādhava ॥37॥
6.25.45: aho bata mahatpāpaṁ kartuṁ vyavasitā vayam,
6.25.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi śrīmadbhagavadgītāparvaṇi śrīmadbhagavadgītāsūpaniṣatsu brahmavidyāyāṁ yogaśāstre śrīkr̥ṣṇārjunasaṁvāde’rjunaviṣādayogo nāma prathamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥ 1 ॥ bhīṣmaparvaṇi tu pañcaviṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥25॥
6.26.3: klaibyaṁ mā sma gamaḥ pārtha naitat tvayyupapadyate,
6.26.4: kathaṁ bhīṣmamahaṁ saṅkhye droṇaṁ ca madhusūdana,
6.26.6: yad vā jayema yadi vā no jayeyuḥ,
6.26.9: na yotsya iti govindamuktvā tūṣṇīṁ babhūva ha ॥9॥
6.26.12: na tvevāhaṁ jātu nāsaṁ na tvaṁ neme janādhipāḥ,
na caiva na bhaviṣyāmaḥ sarve vayamataḥ param ॥12॥
6.26.13: dehino’smin yathā dehe kaumāraṁ yauvanaṁ jarā,
6.26.15: yaṁ hi na vyathayantyete puruṣaṁ puruṣarṣabha,
6.26.16: nāsato vidyate bhāvo nābhāvo vidyate sataḥ,
6.26.17: avināśi tu tad viddhi yena sarvamidaṁ tatam,
6.26.19: ya enaṁ vetti hantāraṁ yaścainaṁ manyate hatam,
ubhau tau na vijānīto nāyaṁ hanti na hanyate ॥19॥
6.26.20: nnāyaṁ bhūtvā bhavitā vā na bhūyaḥ,
6.26.21: kathaṁ sa puruṣaḥ pārtha kaṁ ghātayati hanti kam ॥21॥
6.26.23: nainaṁ chindanti śastrāṇi nainaṁ dahati pāvakaḥ,
na cainaṁ kledayantyāpo na śoṣayati mārutaḥ ॥23॥
6.26.26: atha cainaṁ nityajātaṁ nityaṁ vā manyase mr̥tam,
6.26.27: jātasya hi dhruvo mr̥tyurdhruvaṁ janma mr̥tasya ca,
6.26.30: tasmāt sarvāṇi bhūtāni na tvaṁ śocitumarhasi ॥30॥
6.26.33: atha cet tvamimaṁ dharmyaṁ saṅgrāmaṁ na kariṣyasi,
tataḥ svadharmaṁ kīrtiṁ ca hitvā pāpamavāpsyasi ॥33॥
6.26.35: yeṣāṁ ca tvaṁ bahumato bhūtvā yāsyasi lāghavam ॥35॥
6.26.36: nindantastava sāmarthyaṁ tato duḥkhataraṁ nu kim ॥36॥
6.26.37: hato vā prāpsyasi svargaṁ jitvā vā bhokṣyase mahīm,
6.26.39: eṣā te’bhihitā sāṅkhye buddhiryoge tvimāṁ śr̥ṇū,
buddhyā yukto yayā pārtha karmabandhaṁ prahāsyasi ॥39॥
6.26.48: yogasthaḥ kuru karmāṇi saṅgaṁ tyaktvā dhanañjaya,
siddhyasiddhyoḥ samo bhūtvā samatvaṁ yoga ucyate ॥48॥
6.26.50: tasmād yogāya yujyasva yogaḥ karmasu kauśalam ॥50॥
6.26.51: karmajaṁ buddhiyuktā hi phalaṁ tyaktvā manīṣiṇaḥ,
6.26.52: tadā gantāsi nirvedaṁ śrotavyasya śrutasya ca ॥52॥
6.26.54: sthitadhīḥ kiṁ prabhāṣeta kimāsīta vrajeta kim ॥54॥
6.26.55: prajahāti yadā kāmān sarvān pārtha manogatān,
6.26.57: nābhinandati na dveṣṭi tasya prajñā pratiṣṭhitā ॥57॥
6.26.61: tāni sarvāṇi saṁyamya yukta āsīta matparaḥ,
vaśe hi yasyendriyāṇi tasya prajñā pratiṣṭhitā ॥61॥
6.26.69: yā niśā sarvabhūtānāṁ tasyāṁ jāgarti saṁyamī,
yasyāṁ jāgrati bhūtāni sā niśā paśyato muneḥ ॥69॥
6.26.71: vihāya kāmān yaḥ sarvān pumāṁścarati niḥspr̥haḥ,
6.26.72: eṣā brāhmī sthitiḥ pārtha naināṁ prāpya vimuhyati,
6.26.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi śrīmadbhagavadgītāparvaṇi śrīmadbhagavadgītāsūpaniṣatsu brahmavidyāyāṁ yogaśāstre śrīkr̥ṣṇārjunasaṁvāde sāṅkhyayogo nāma dvitīyo’dhyāyaḥ ॥ 2 ॥ bhīṣmaparvaṇi tu ṣaḍviṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥26॥
6.27.1: tat kiṁ karmaṇi ghore māṁ niyojayasi keśava ॥1॥
6.27.3: loke’smin dvividhā niṣṭhā purā proktā mayānagha,
6.27.5: na hi kaścit kṣaṇamapi jātu tiṣṭhatyakarmakr̥t,
6.27.6: karmendriyāṇi saṁyamya ya āste manasā smaran,
6.27.8: niyataṁ kuru karma tvaṁ karma jyāyo hyakarmaṇaḥ,
6.27.11: devān bhāvayatānena te devā bhāvayantu vaḥ,
6.27.12: iṣṭān bhogān hi vo devā dāsyante yajñabhāvitāḥ,
tairdattānapradāyaibhyo yo bhuṅkte stena eva saḥ ॥12॥
6.27.13: bhuñjate te tvaghaṁ pāpā ye pacantyātmakāraṇāt ॥13॥
6.27.15: tasmāt sarvagataṁ brahma nityaṁ yajñe pratiṣṭhitam ॥15॥
6.27.17: ātmanyeva ca santuṣṭastasya kāryaṁ na vidyate ॥17॥
6.27.22: na me pārthāsti kartavyaṁ triṣu lokeṣu kiñcana,
6.27.23: yadi hyahaṁ na varteyaṁ jātu karmaṇyatandritaḥ,
6.27.24: utsīdeyurime lokā na kuryāṁ karma cedaham,
6.27.28: guṇā guṇeṣu vartanta iti matvā na sajjate ॥28॥
6.27.33: prakr̥tiṁ yānti bhūtāni nigrahaḥ kiṁ kariṣyati ॥33॥
6.27.36: atha kena prayukto’yaṁ pāpaṁ carati pūruṣaḥ,
6.27.42: manasastu parā buddhiryo buddheḥ paratastu saḥ ॥42॥
6.27.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi śrīmadbhagavadgītāparvaṇi śrīmadbhagavadgītāsūpaniṣatsu brahmavidyāyāṁ yogaśāstre śrīkr̥ṣṇārjunasaṁvāde karmayogo nāma tr̥tīyo’dhyāyaḥ ॥ 3 ॥ bhīṣmaparvaṇi tu saptaviṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥27॥
6.28.2: sa kāleneha mahatā yogo naṣṭaḥ parantapa ॥2॥
6.28.3: sa evāyaṁ mayā te’dya yogaḥ proktaḥ purātanaḥ,
bhakto’si me sakhā ceti rahasyaṁ hyetaduttamam ॥3॥
6.28.4: aparaṁ bhavato janma paraṁ janma vivasvataḥ,
6.28.5: bahūni me vyatītāni janmāni tava cārjuna,
tānyahaṁ veda sarvāṇi na tvaṁ vettha parantapa ॥5॥
6.28.7: yadā yadā hi dharmasya glānirbhavati bhārata,
6.28.9: janma karma ca me divyamevaṁ yo vetti tattvataḥ,
tyaktvā dehaṁ punarjanma naiti māmeti so’rjuna ॥9॥
6.28.11: ye yathā māṁ prapadyante tāṁstathaiva bhajāmyaham,
6.28.12: kāṅkṣantaḥ karmaṇāṁ siddhiṁ yajanta iha devatāḥ,
kṣipraṁ hi mānuṣe loke siddhirbhavati karmajā ॥12॥
6.28.14: na māṁ karmāṇi limpanti na me karmaphale spr̥hā,
iti māṁ yo’bhijānāti karmabhirna sa badhyate ॥14॥
6.28.15: evaṁ jñātvā kr̥taṁ karma pūrvairapi mumukṣubhiḥ,
kuru karmaiva tasmāttvaṁ pūrvaiḥ pūrvataraṁ kr̥tam ॥15॥
6.28.16: tat te karma pravakṣyāmi yajjñātvā mokṣyase’śubhāt ॥16॥
6.28.17: karmaṇo hyapi boddhavyaṁ boddhavyaṁ ca vikarmaṇaḥ,
6.28.18: karmaṇyakarma yaḥ paśyedakarmaṇi ca karma yaḥ,
sa buddhimān manuṣyeṣu sa yuktaḥ kr̥tsnakarmakr̥t ॥18॥
6.28.21: śārīraṁ kevalaṁ karma kurvan nāpnoti kilbiṣam ॥21॥
6.28.22: samaḥ siddhāvasiddhau ca kr̥tvāpi na nibadhyate ॥22॥
6.28.32: evaṁ bahuvidhā yajñā vitatā brahmaṇo mukhe,
karmajān viddhi tān sarvānevaṁ jñātvā vimokṣyase ॥32॥
6.28.38: na hi jñānena sadr̥śaṁ pavitramiha vidyate,
6.28.40: nāyaṁ loko’sti na paro na sukhaṁ saṁśayātmanaḥ ॥40॥
6.28.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi śrīmadbhagavadgītāparvaṇi śrīmadbhagavadgītāsūpaniṣatsu brahmavidyāyāṁ yogaśāstre śrīkr̥ṣṇārjunasaṁvāde jñānakarmasaṁnyāsayogo nāma caturtho’dhyāyaḥ ॥ 4 ॥ bhīṣmaparvaṇi tu aṣṭāviṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥28॥
6.29.1: saṁnyāsaṁ karmaṇāṁ kr̥ṣṇa punaryogaṁ ca śaṁsasi,
6.29.3: jñeyaḥ sa nityasaṁnyāsī yo na dveṣṭi na kāṅkṣati,
nirdvandvo hi mahābāho sukhaṁ bandhāt pramucyate ॥3॥
6.29.4: sāṅkhyayogau pr̥thag bālāḥ pravadanti na paṇḍitāḥ,
6.29.5: yat sāṅkhyaiḥ prāpyate sthānaṁ tad yogairapi gamyate,
ekaṁ sāṅkhyaṁ ca yogaṁ ca yaḥ paśyati sa paśyati ॥5॥
6.29.8: naiva kiñcit karomīti yukto manyeta tattvavit,
6.29.10: brahmaṇyādhāya karmāṇi saṅgaṁ tyaktvā karoti yaḥ,
6.29.13: navadvāre pure dehī naiva kurvan na kārayan ॥13॥
6.29.14: na kartr̥tvaṁ na karmāṇi lokasya sr̥jati prabhuḥ,
6.29.15: nādatte kasyacit pāpaṁ na caiva sukr̥taṁ vibhuḥ,
6.29.18: śuni caiva śvapāke ca paṇḍitāḥ samadarśinaḥ ॥18॥
6.29.19: ihaiva tairjitaḥ sargo yeṣāṁ sāmye sthitaṁ manaḥ,
nirdoṣaṁ hi samaṁ brahma tasmād brahmaṇi te sthitāḥ ॥19॥
6.29.20: na prahr̥ṣyet priyaṁ prāpya nodvijet prāpya cāpriyam,
6.29.22: ye hi saṁsparśajā bhogā duḥkhayonaya eva te,
ādyantavantaḥ kaunteya na teṣu ramate budhaḥ ॥22॥
6.29.23: kāmakrodhodbhavaṁ vegaṁ sa yuktaḥ sa sukhī naraḥ ॥23॥
6.29.28: vigatecchābhayakrodho yaḥ sadā mukta eva saḥ ॥28॥
6.29.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi śrīmadbhagavadgītāparvaṇi śrīmadbhagavadgītāsūpaniṣatsu brahmavidyāyāṁ yogaśāstre śrīkr̥ṣṇārjunasaṁvāde karmasaṁnyāsayogo nāma pañcamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥ 5 ॥ bhīṣmaparvaṇi tu ekonatriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥29॥
6.30.1: anāśritaḥ karmaphalaṁ kāryaṁ karma karoti yaḥ,
sa saṁnyāsī ca yogī ca na niragnirna cākriyaḥ ॥1॥
6.30.2: yaṁ saṁnyāsamiti prāhuryogaṁ taṁ viddhi pāṇḍava,
6.30.14: manaḥ saṁyamya maccitto yukta āsīta matparaḥ ॥14॥
6.30.16: na cāti svapnaśīlasya jāgrato naiva cārjuna ॥16॥
6.30.19: yathā dīpo nivātastho neṅgate sopamā smr̥tā,
6.30.21: vetti yatra na caivāyaṁ sthitaścalati tattvataḥ ॥21॥
6.30.22: yaṁ labdhvā cāparaṁ lābhaṁ manyate nādhikaṁ tataḥ,
yasmin sthito na duḥkhena guruṇāpi vicālyate ॥22॥
6.30.30: yo māṁ paśyati sarvatra sarvaṁ ca mayi paśyati,
tasyāhaṁ na praṇaśyāmi sa ca me na praṇaśyati ॥30॥
6.30.31: sarvathā vartamāno’pi sa yogī mayi vartate ॥31॥
6.30.32: sukhaṁ vā yadi vā duḥkhaṁ sa yogī paramo mataḥ ॥32॥
6.30.33: etasyāhaṁ na paśyāmi cañcalatvāt sthitiṁ sthirām ॥33॥
6.30.34: cañcalaṁ hi manaḥ kr̥ṣṇa pramāthi balavad dr̥ḍham,
6.30.35: abhyāsena tu kaunteya vairāgyeṇa ca gr̥hyate ॥35॥
6.30.36: asaṁyatātmanā yogo duṣprāpa iti me matiḥ,
6.30.37: aprāpya yogasaṁsiddhiṁ kāṁ gatiṁ kr̥ṣṇa gacchati ॥37॥
6.30.40: na hi kalyāṇakr̥t kaścid durgatiṁ tāta gacchati ॥40॥
6.30.43: yatate ca tato bhūyaḥ saṁsiddhau kurunandana ॥43॥
6.30.47: śraddhāvānbhajate yo māṁ sa me yuktatamo mataḥ ॥47॥
6.30.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi śrīmadbhagavadgītāparvaṇi śrīmadbhagavadgītāsūpaniṣatsu brahmavidyāyāṁ yogaśāstre śrīkr̥ṣṇārjunasaṁvāde ātmasaṁyamayogo nāma ṣaṣṭho’dhyāyaḥ ॥6॥
6.31.1: asaṁśayaṁ samagraṁ māṁ yathā jñāsyasi tacchr̥ṇu ॥1॥
6.31.4: bhūmirāpo’nalo vāyuḥ khaṁ mano buddhireva ca,
6.31.7: mayi sarvamidaṁ protaṁ sūtre maṇigaṇā iva ॥7॥
6.31.8: praṇavaḥ sarvavedeṣu śabdaḥ khe pauruṣaṁ nr̥ṣu ॥8॥
6.31.9: puṇyo gandhaḥ pr̥thivyāṁ ca tejaścāsmi vibhāvasau,
6.31.10: bījaṁ māṁ sarvabhūtānāṁ viddhi pārtha sanātanam,
6.31.12: ye caiva sāttvikā bhāvā rājasāstāmasāśca ye,
matta eveti tān viddhi na tvahaṁ teṣu te mayi ॥12॥
6.31.14: daivī hyeṣā guṇamayī mama māyā duratyayā,
māmeva ye prapadyante māyāmetāṁ taranti te ॥14॥
6.31.15: na māṁ duṣkr̥tino mūḍhāḥ prapadyante narādhamāḥ,
6.31.17: priyo hi jñānino’tyarthamahaṁ sa ca mama priyaḥ ॥17॥
6.31.18: udārāḥ sarva evaite jñānī tvātmaiva me matam,
āsthitaḥ sa hi yuktātmā māmevānuttamāṁ gatim ॥18॥
6.31.20: taṁ taṁ niyamamāsthāya prakr̥tyā niyatāḥ svayā ॥20॥
6.31.21: yo yo yāṁ yāṁ tanuṁ bhaktaḥ śraddhayārcitumicchati,
6.31.22: labhate ca tataḥ kāmān mayaiva vihitān hi tān ॥22॥
6.31.23: devān devayajo yānti madbhaktā yānti māmapi ॥23॥
6.31.26: bhaviṣyāṇi ca bhūtāni māṁ tu veda na kaścana ॥26॥
6.31.29: te brahma tad viduḥ kr̥tsnamadhyātmaṁ karma cākhilam ॥29॥
6.31.30: sādhibhūtādhidaivaṁ māṁ sādhiyajñaṁ ca ye viduḥ,
6.31.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi śrīmadbhagavadgītāparvaṇi śrīmadbhagavadgītāsūpaniṣatsu brahmavidyāyāṁ yogaśāstre śrīkr̥ṣṇārjunasaṁvāde jñānavijñānayogo nāma saptamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥ 7 ॥ bhīṣmaparvaṇi tu ekatriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥31॥
6.32.1: kiṁ tad brahma kimadhyātmaṁ kiṁ karma puruṣottama,
6.32.5: antakāle ca māmeva smaran muktvā kalevaram,
yaḥ prayāti sa madbhāvaṁ yāti nāstyatra saṁśayaḥ ॥5॥
6.32.6: yaṁ yaṁ vāpi smaran bhāvaṁ tyajatyante kalevaram,
6.32.7: tasmāt sarveṣu kāleṣu māmanusmara yudhya ca,
6.32.11: yadakṣaraṁ vedavido vadanti viśanti yadyatayo vītarāgāḥ,
yadicchanto brahmacaryaṁ caranti tatte padaṁ saṅgraheṇa pravakṣye ॥11॥
6.32.12: sarvadvārāṇi saṁyamya mano hr̥di nirudhya ca,
6.32.13: yaḥ prayāti tyajan dehaṁ sa yāti paramāṁ gatim ॥13॥
6.32.14: ananyacetāḥ satataṁ yo māṁ smarati nityaśaḥ,
6.32.16: māmupetya tu kaunteya punarjanma na vidyate ॥16॥
6.32.19: bhūtagrāmaḥ sa evāyaṁ bhūtvā bhūtvā pralīyate,
6.32.20: yaḥ sa sarveṣu bhūteṣu naśyatsu na vinaśyati ॥20॥
6.32.21: yaṁ prāpya na nivartante taddhāma paramaṁ mama ॥21॥
6.32.22: puruṣaḥ sa paraḥ pārtha bhaktyā labhyastvananyayā,
6.32.23: prayātā yānti taṁ kālaṁ vakṣyāmi bharatarṣabha ॥23॥
6.32.24: tatra prayātā gacchanti brahma brahmavido janāḥ ॥24॥
6.32.26: śuklakr̥ṣṇe gatī hyete jagataḥ śāśvate mate,
6.32.27: naite sr̥tī pārtha jānan yogī muhyati kaścana,
6.32.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi śrīmadbhagavadgītāparvaṇi śrīmadbhagavadgītāsūpaniṣatsu brahmavidyāyāṁ yogaśāstre śrīkr̥ṣṇārjunasaṁvāde akṣarabrahmayogo nāmāṣṭamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥ 8 ॥ bhīṣmaparvaṇi tu dvātriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥32॥
6.33.5: na ca matsthāni bhūtāni paśya me yogamaiśvaram,
6.33.9: na ca māṁ tāni karmāṇi nibadhnanti dhanañjaya,
6.33.17: vedyaṁ pavitramoṅkāra r̥k sāma yajureva ca ॥17॥
6.33.18: gatirbhartā prabhuḥ sākṣī nivāsaḥ śaraṇaṁ suhr̥t,
6.33.24: ahaṁ hi sarvayajñānāṁ bhoktā ca prabhureva ca,
6.33.25: yānti devavratā devān pitr̥̄n yānti pitr̥vratāḥ,
bhūtāni yānti bhūtejyā yānti madyājino’pi mām ॥25॥
6.33.26: patraṁ puṣpaṁ phalaṁ toyaṁ yo me bhaktyā prayacchati,
6.33.27: yat karoṣi yadaśnāsi yajjuhoṣi dadāsi yat,
6.33.29: samo’haṁ sarvabhūteṣu na me dveṣyo’sti na priyaḥ,
ye bhajanti tu māṁ bhaktyā mayi te teṣu cāpyaham ॥29॥
6.33.30: sādhureva sa mantavyaḥ samyagvyavasito hi saḥ ॥30॥
6.33.31: kaunteya prati jānīhi na me bhaktaḥ praṇaśyati ॥31॥
6.33.32: māṁ hi pārtha vyapāśritya ye’pi syuḥ pāpayonayaḥ,
striyo vaiśyāstathā śūdrāste’pi yānti parāṁ gatim ॥32॥
6.33.34: manmanā bhava madbhakto madyājī māṁ namaskuru,
6.33.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi śrīmadbhagavadgītāparvaṇi śrīmadbhagavadgītāsūpaniṣatsu brahmavidyāyāṁ yogaśāstre śrīkr̥ṣṇārjunasaṁvāde rājavidyārājaguhyayogo nāma navamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥ 9 ॥ bhīṣmaparvaṇi tu trayastriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥33॥
6.34.1: bhūya eva mahābāho śr̥ṇu me paramaṁ vacaḥ,
6.34.2: na me viduḥ suragaṇāḥ prabhavaṁ na maharṣayaḥ,
6.34.4: sukhaṁ duḥkhaṁ bhavo’bhāvo bhayaṁ cābhayameva ca ॥4॥
6.34.5: bhavanti bhāvā bhūtānāṁ matta eva pr̥thagvidhāḥ ॥5॥
6.34.6: madbhāvā mānasā jātā yeṣāṁ loka imāḥ prajāḥ ॥6॥
6.34.7: etāṁ vibhūtiṁ yogaṁ ca mama yo vetti tattvataḥ,
6.34.8: ahaṁ sarvasya prabhavo mattaḥ sarvaṁ pravartate,
iti matvā bhajante māṁ budhā bhāvasamanvitāḥ ॥8॥
6.34.9: kathayantaśca māṁ nityaṁ tuṣyanti ca ramanti ca ॥9॥
6.34.10: dadāmi buddhiyogaṁ taṁ yena māmupayānti te ॥10॥
6.34.12: paraṁ brahma paraṁ dhāma pavitraṁ paramaṁ bhavān,
6.34.13: asito devalo vyāsaḥ svayaṁ caiva bravīṣi me ॥13॥
6.34.14: na hi te bhagavan vyaktiṁ vidurdevā na dānavāḥ ॥14॥
6.34.17: keṣu keṣu ca bhāveṣu cintyo’si bhagavan mayā ॥17॥
6.34.18: bhūyaḥ kathaya tr̥ptirhi śr̥ṇvato nāsti me’mr̥tam ॥18॥
6.34.20: ahamādiśca madhyaṁ ca bhūtānāmanta eva ca ॥20॥
6.34.24: purodhasāṁ ca mukhyaṁ māṁ viddhi pārtha br̥haspatim,
6.34.34: kīrtiḥ śrīrvāk ca nārīṇāṁ smr̥tirmedhā dhr̥tiḥ kṣamā ॥34॥
6.34.39: na tadasti vinā yat syānmayā bhūtaṁ carācaram ॥39॥
6.34.40d1: yad yad vibhūtimat sattvaṁ śrīmadūrjitameva vā.
6.34.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi śrīmadbhagavadgītāparvaṇi śrīmadbhagavadgītāsūpaniṣatsu brahmavidyāyāṁ yogaśāstre śrīkr̥ṣṇārjunasaṁvāde vibhūtiyogo nāma daśamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥ 10 ॥ bhīṣmaparvaṇi tu catustriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥34॥
6.35.1: yat tvayoktaṁ vacastena moho’yaṁ vigato mama ॥1॥
6.35.2: bhavāpyayau hi bhūtānāṁ śrutau vistaraśo mayā,
6.35.4: manyase yadi tacchakyaṁ mayā draṣṭumiti prabho,
6.35.5: paśya me pārtha rūpāṇi śataśo’tha sahasraśaḥ,
6.35.8: na tu māṁ śakyase draṣṭumanenaiva svacakṣuṣā,
divyaṁ dadāmi te cakṣuḥ paśya me yogamaiśvaram ॥8॥
6.35.12: yadi bhāḥ sadr̥śī sā syād bhāsastasya mahātmanaḥ ॥12॥
6.35.24: dhr̥tiṁ na vindāmi śamaṁ ca viṣṇo ॥24॥
6.35.25: diśo na jāne na labhe na śarma
6.35.34: droṇaṁ ca bhīṣmaṁ ca jayadrathaṁ ca
6.35.38: vettāsi vedyaṁ ca paraṁ ca dhāma
6.35.41: he kr̥ṣṇa he yādava he sakheti,
6.35.49: mā te vyathā mā ca vimūḍhabhāvo
6.35.51: dr̥ṣṭvedaṁ mānuṣaṁ rūpaṁ tava saumyaṁ janārdana,
6.35.53: nāhaṁ vedairna tapasā na dānena na cejyayā,
śakya evaṁvidho draṣṭuṁ dr̥ṣṭavānasi māṁ yathā ॥53॥
6.35.54: jñātuṁ draṣṭuṁ ca tattvena praveṣṭuṁ ca parantapa ॥54॥
6.35.55: nirvairaḥ sarvabhūteṣu yaḥ sa māmeti pāṇḍava ॥55॥
6.35.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi śrīmadbhagavadgītāparvaṇi śrīmadbhagavadgītāsūpaniṣatsu brahmavidyāyāṁ yogaśāstre śrīkr̥ṣṇārjunasaṁvāde viśvarūpadarśanayogo nāmaikādaśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥ 11 ॥ bhīṣmaparvaṇi tu pañcatriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥35॥
6.36.2: mayyāveśya mano ye māṁ nityayuktā upāsate,
6.36.6: ye tu sarvāṇi karmāṇi mayi saṁnyasya matparāḥ,
6.36.8: mayyeva mana ādhatsva mayi buddhiṁ niveśaya,
nivasiṣyasi mayyeva ata ūrdhvaṁ na saṁśayaḥ ॥8॥
6.36.9: atha cittaṁ samādhātuṁ na śaknoṣi mayi sthiram,
6.36.13: adveṣṭā sarvabhūtānāṁ maitraḥ karuṇa eva ca,
6.36.15: harṣāmarṣabhayodvegairmukto yaḥ sa ca me priyaḥ ॥15॥
6.36.16: sarvārambhaparityāgī yo madbhaktaḥ sa me priyaḥ ॥16॥
6.36.17: yo na hr̥ṣyati na dveṣṭi na śocati na kāṅkṣati,
śubhāśubhaparityāgī bhaktimān yaḥ sa me priyaḥ ॥17॥
6.36.18: samaḥ śatrau ca mitre ca tathā mānāpamānayoḥ,
6.36.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi śrīmadbhagavadgītāparvaṇi śrīmadbhagavadgītāsūpaniṣatsu brahmavidyāyāṁ yogaśāstre śrīkr̥ṣṇārjunasaṁvāde bhaktiyogo nāma dvādaśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥ 12 ॥ bhīṣmaparvaṇi tu ṣaṭtriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥36॥
6.37.1: etad yo vetti taṁ prāhuḥ kṣetrajña iti tadvidaḥ ॥1॥
6.37.2: kṣetrajñaṁ cāpi māṁ viddhi sarvakṣetreṣu bhārata,
6.37.3: tat kṣetraṁ yacca yādr̥k ca yadvikāri yataśca yat,
sa ca yo yatprabhāvaśca tat samāsena me śr̥ṇu ॥3॥
6.37.6: icchā dveṣaḥ sukhaṁ duḥkhaṁ saṅghātaścetanā dhr̥tiḥ,
6.37.12: anādimat paraṁ brahma na sat tannāsaducyate ॥12॥
6.37.16: avibhaktaṁ ca bhūteṣu vibhaktamiva ca sthitam,
bhūtabhartr̥ ca tajjñeyaṁ grasiṣṇu prabhaviṣṇu ca ॥16॥
6.37.17: jñānaṁ jñeyaṁ jñānagamyaṁ hr̥di sarvasya viṣṭhitam ॥17॥
6.37.18: iti kṣetraṁ tathā jñānaṁ jñeyaṁ coktaṁ samāsataḥ,
6.37.21: puruṣaḥ prakr̥tistho hi bhuṅkte prakr̥tijān guṇān,
6.37.23: ya evaṁ vetti puruṣaṁ prakr̥tiṁ ca guṇaiḥ saha,
6.37.28: na hinastyātmanā’’tmānaṁ tato yāti parāṁ gatim ॥28॥
6.37.30: tata eva ca vistāraṁ brahma sampadyate tadā ॥30॥
6.37.31: śarīrastho’pi kaunteya na karoti na lipyate ॥31॥
6.37.33: kṣetraṁ kṣetrī tathā kr̥tsnaṁ prakāśayati bhārata ॥33॥
6.37.34: bhūtaprakr̥timokṣaṁ ca ye viduryānti te param ॥34॥
6.37.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi śrīmadbhagavadgītāparvaṇi śrīmadbhagavadgītāsūpaniṣatsu brahmavidyāyāṁ yogaśāstre śrīkr̥ṣṇārjunasaṁvāde kṣetrakṣetrajñavibhāgayogo nāma trayodaśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥ 13 ॥ bhīṣmaparvaṇi tu saptatriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥37॥
6.38.1: yajjñātvā munayaḥ sarve parāṁ siddhimito gatāḥ ॥1॥
6.38.2: sarge’pi nopajāyante pralaye na vyathanti ca ॥2॥
6.38.3: mama yonirmahad brahma tasmin garbhaṁ dadhāmyaham,
6.38.9: sattvaṁ sukhe sañjayati rajaḥ karmaṇi bhārata,
6.38.10: rajaḥ sattvaṁ tamaścaiva tamaḥ sattvaṁ rajastathā ॥10॥
6.38.11: jñānaṁ yadā tadā vidyād vivr̥ddhaṁ sattvamityuta ॥11॥
6.38.14: yadā sattve pravr̥ddhe tu pralayaṁ yāti dehabhr̥t,
6.38.17: sattvāt sañjāyate jñānaṁ rajaso lobha eva ca,
6.38.18: ūrdhvaṁ gacchanti sattvasthā madhye tiṣṭhanti rājasāḥ,
6.38.22: prakāśaṁ ca pravr̥ttiṁ ca mohameva ca pāṇḍava,
na dveṣṭi sampravr̥ttāni na nivr̥ttāni kāṅkṣati ॥22॥
6.38.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi śrīmadbhagavadgītāparvaṇi śrīmadbhagavadgītāsūpaniṣatsu brahmavidyāyāṁ yogaśāstre śrīkr̥ṣṇārjunasaṁvāde guṇatrayavibhāgayogo nāma caturdaśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥ 14 ॥ bhīṣmaparvaṇi tu aṣṭātriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥38॥
6.39.1: chandāṁsi yasya parṇāni yastaṁ veda sa vedavit ॥1॥
6.39.2d1: chandāṁsi yasya parṇāni yastaṁ veda sa vedavit.
6.39.6: na tadbhāsayate sūryo na śaśāṅko na pāvakaḥ,
yad gatvā na nivartante tad dhāma paramaṁ mama ॥6॥
6.39.9: śrotraṁ cakṣuḥ sparśanaṁ ca rasanaṁ ghrāṇameva ca,
6.39.10: utkrāmantaṁ sthitaṁ vāpi bhuñjānaṁ vā guṇānvitam,
6.39.12: yaccandramasi yaccāgnau tat tejo viddhi māmakam ॥12॥
6.39.13: puṣṇāmi cauṣadhīḥ sarvāḥ somo bhūtvā rasātmakaḥ ॥13॥
6.39.16: dvāvimau puruṣau loke kṣaraścākṣara eva ca,
6.39.18: ato’smi loke vede ca prathitaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ॥18॥
6.39.19: sa sarvavid bhajati māṁ sarvabhāvena bhārata ॥19॥
6.39.20: etad buddhvā buddhimān syāt kr̥takr̥tyaśca bhārata ॥20॥
6.39.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi śrīmadbhagavadgītāparvaṇi śrīmadbhagavadgītāsūpaniṣatsu brahmavidyāyāṁ yogaśāstre śrīkr̥ṣṇārjunasaṁvāde puruṣottamayogo nāma pañcadaśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥ 15 ॥ bhīṣmaparvaṇi tu ekonacatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥39॥
6.40.6: dvau bhūtasargau loke’smin daiva āsura eva ca,
daivo vistaraśaḥ prokta āsuraṁ pārtha me śr̥ṇu ॥6॥
6.40.7: pravr̥ttiṁ ca nivr̥ttiṁ ca janā na vidurāsurāḥ,
na śaucaṁ nāpi cācāro na satyaṁ teṣu vidyate ॥7॥
6.40.18: ahaṅkāraṁ balaṁ darpaṁ kāmaṁ krodhaṁ ca saṁśritāḥ,
6.40.23: na sa siddhimavāpnoti na sukhaṁ na parāṁ gatim ॥23॥
6.40.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi śrīmadbhagavadgītāparvaṇi śrīmadbhagavadgītāsūpaniṣatsu brahmavidyāyāṁ yogaśāstre śrīkr̥ṣṇārjunasaṁvāde daivāsurasampadvibhāgayogo nāma ṣoḍaśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥ 16 ॥ bhīṣmaparvaṇi tu catvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥40॥
6.41.1: teṣāṁ niṣṭhā tu kā kr̥ṣṇa sattvamāho rajastamaḥ ॥1॥
6.41.2: trividhā bhavati śraddhā dehināṁ sā svabhāvajā,
sāttvikī rājasī caiva tāmasī ceti tāṁ śr̥ṇu ॥2॥
6.41.3: śraddhāmayo’yaṁ puruṣo yo yacchraddhaḥ sa eva saḥ ॥3॥
6.41.5: aśāstravihitaṁ ghoraṁ tapyante ye tapo janāḥ,
6.41.8: rasyāḥ snigdhāḥ sthirā hr̥dyā āhārāḥ sāttvikapriyāḥ ॥8॥
6.41.10: yātayāmaṁ gatarasaṁ pūti paryuṣitaṁ ca yat,
6.41.12: abhisandhāya tu phalaṁ dambhārthamapi caiva yat,
ijyate bharataśreṣṭha taṁ yajñaṁ viddhi rājasam ॥12॥
6.41.15: anudvegakaraṁ vākyaṁ satyaṁ priyahitaṁ ca yat,
6.41.17: śraddhayā parayā taptaṁ tapastat trividhaṁ naraiḥ,
6.41.20: deśe kāle ca pātre ca tad dānaṁ sāttvikaṁ smr̥tam ॥20॥
6.41.21: dīyate ca parikliṣṭaṁ tad dānaṁ rājasaṁ smr̥tam ॥21॥
6.41.26: praśaste karmaṇi tathā sacchabdaḥ pārtha yujyate ॥26॥
6.41.27: yajñe tapasi dāne ca sthitiḥ saditi cocyate,
6.41.28: aśraddhayā hutaṁ dattaṁ tapastaptaṁ kr̥taṁ ca yat,
asadityucyate pārtha na ca tat pretya no iha ॥28॥
6.41.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi śrīmadbhagavadgītāparvaṇi śrīmadbhagavadgītāsūpaniṣatsu brahmavidyāyāṁ yogaśāstre śrīkr̥ṣṇārjunasaṁvāde śraddhātrayavibhāgayogo nāma saptadaśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥ 17 ॥ bhīṣmaparvaṇi tu ekacatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥41॥
6.42.2: kāmyānāṁ karmaṇāṁ nyāsaṁ saṁnyāsaṁ kavayo viduḥ,
6.42.4: niścayaṁ śr̥ṇu me tatra tyāge bharatasattama,
6.42.6: etānyapi tu karmāṇi saṅgaṁ tyaktvā phalāni ca,
6.42.8: sa kr̥tvā rājasaṁ tyāgaṁ naiva tyāgaphalaṁ labhet ॥8॥
6.42.9: saṅgaṁ tyaktvā phalaṁ caiva sa tyāgaḥ sāttviko mataḥ ॥9॥
6.42.11: na hi dehabhr̥tā śakyaṁ tyaktuṁ karmāṇyaśeṣataḥ,
6.42.12: aniṣṭamiṣṭaṁ miśraṁ ca trividhaṁ karmaṇaḥ phalam,
bhavatyatyāgināṁ pretya na tu saṁnyāsināṁ kvacit ॥12॥
6.42.14: adhiṣṭhānaṁ tathā kartā karaṇaṁ ca pr̥thagvidham,
6.42.15: nyāyyaṁ vā viparītaṁ vā pañcaite tasya hetavaḥ ॥15॥
6.42.16: tatraivaṁ sati kartāramātmānaṁ kevalaṁ tu yaḥ,
6.42.17: yasya nāhaṅkr̥to bhāvo buddhiryasya na lipyate,
hatvāpi sa imām̐llokānna hanti na nibadhyate ॥17॥
6.42.19: jñānaṁ karma ca kartā ca tridhaiva guṇabhedataḥ,
6.42.21: vetti sarveṣu bhūteṣu tajjñānaṁ viddhi rājasam ॥21॥
6.42.24: yattu kāmepsunā karma sāhaṅkāreṇa vā punaḥ,
6.42.28: viṣādī dīrghasūtrī ca kartā tāmasa ucyate ॥28॥
6.42.30: pravr̥ttiṁ ca nivr̥ttiṁ ca kāryākārye bhayābhaye,
bandhaṁ mokṣaṁ ca yā vetti buddhiḥ sā pārtha sāttvikī ॥30॥
6.42.31: yayā dharmamadharmaṁ ca kāryaṁ cākāryameva ca,
ayathāvat prajānāti buddhiḥ sā pārtha rājasī ॥31॥
6.42.32: sarvārthān viparītāṁśca buddhiḥ sā pārtha tāmasī ॥32॥
6.42.34: prasaṅgena phalākāṅkṣī dhr̥tiḥ sā pārtha rājasī ॥34॥
6.42.35: yayā svapnaṁ bhayaṁ śokaṁ viṣādaṁ madameva ca,
na vimuñcati durmedhā dhr̥tiḥ sā pārtha tāmasī ॥35॥
6.42.36: sukhaṁ tvidānīṁ trividhaṁ śr̥ṇu me bharatarṣabha,
abhyāsād ramate yatra duḥkhāntaṁ ca nigacchati ॥36॥
6.42.38: pariṇāme viṣamiva tat sukhaṁ rājasaṁ smr̥tam ॥38॥
6.42.40: na tadasti pr̥thivyāṁ vā divi deveṣu vā punaḥ,
6.42.45: sve sve karmaṇyabhirataḥ saṁsiddhiṁ labhate naraḥ,
6.42.48: sahajaṁ karma kaunteya sadoṣamapi na tyajet,
6.42.50: siddhiṁ prāpto yathā brahma tathā’’pnoti nibodha me,
samāsenaiva kaunteya niṣṭhā jñānasya yā parā ॥50॥
6.42.51: buddhyā viśuddhayā yukto dhr̥tyā’’tmānaṁ niyamya ca,
6.42.53: ahaṅkāraṁ balaṁ darpaṁ kāmaṁ krodhaṁ parigraham,
6.42.54: brahmabhūtaḥ prasannātmā na śocati na kāṅkṣati,
samaḥ sarveṣu bhūteṣu madbhaktiṁ labhate parām ॥54॥
6.42.55: tato māṁ tattvato jñātvā viśate tadanantaram ॥55॥
6.42.62: tatprasādāt parāṁ śāntiṁ sthānaṁ prāpsyasi śāśvatam ॥62॥
6.42.63: iti te jñānamākhyātaṁ guhyād guhyataraṁ mayā,
6.42.64: sarvaguhyatamaṁ bhūyaḥ śr̥ṇu me paramaṁ vacaḥ,
iṣṭo’si me dr̥ḍhamiti tato vakṣyāmi te hitam ॥64॥
6.42.65: manmanā bhava madbhakto madyājī māṁ namaskuru,
māmevaiṣyasi satyaṁ te pratijāne priyo’si me ॥65॥
6.42.66: ahaṁ tvā sarvapāpebhyo mokṣayiṣyāmi mā śucaḥ ॥66॥
6.42.67: na cāśuśrūṣave vācyaṁ na ca māṁ yo’bhyasūyati ॥67॥
6.42.69: bhavitā na ca me tasmādanyaḥ priyataro bhuvi ॥69॥
6.42.70: adhyeṣyate ca ya imaṁ dharmyaṁ saṁvādamāvayoḥ,
6.42.75: yogaṁ yogeśvarāt kr̥ṣṇāt sākṣāt kathayataḥ svayam ॥75॥
6.42.77: vismayo me mahān rājan hr̥ṣyāmi ca punaḥ punaḥ ॥77॥
6.42.78: yatra yogeśvaraḥ kr̥ṣṇo yatra pārtho dhanurdharaḥ,
6.42.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi śrīmadbhagavadgītāparvaṇi śrīmadbhagavadgītāsūpaniṣatsu brahmavidyāyāṁ yogaśāstre śrīkr̥ṣṇārjunasaṁvāde mokṣasaṁnyāsayogo nāmāṣṭādaśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥ 18 ॥ bhīṣmaparvaṇi tu dvicatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥42॥
6.43.3: gītā gaṅgā ca gāyatrī govindeti hr̥di sthite,
6.43.10: samīyustatra sahitā draṣṭuṁ tad vaiśasaṁ mahat ॥10॥
6.43.11: te sene sāgaraprakhye muhuḥ pracalite nr̥pa ॥11॥
6.43.12: vimucya kavacaṁ vīro nikṣipya ca varāyudham,
6.43.16: kiṁ te vyavasitaṁ rājan yadasmānapahāya vai,
6.43.18: evaṁ gate tvayi jyeṣṭhe mama bhrātari bhārata,
bhīrme dunoti hr̥dayaṁ brūhi gantā bhavān kva nu ॥18॥
6.43.19: utsr̥jya kva nu gantāsi śatrūnabhimukho nr̥pa ॥19॥
6.43.22: eṣa bhīṣmaṁ tathā droṇaṁ gautamaṁ śalyameva ca,
6.43.28: dhanañjaye kathaṁ nāthe pāṇḍave ca vr̥kodare,
6.43.29: na nūnaṁ kṣatriyakule jātaḥ samprathite bhuvi,
6.43.30: tataste sainikāḥ sarve praśaṁsanti sma kauravān,
hr̥ṣṭāḥ sumanaso bhūtvā cailāni dudhuvuśca ha ॥30॥
6.43.32: tatastat kauravaṁ sainyaṁ dhikkr̥tvā tu yudhiṣṭhiram,
6.43.33: kiṁ nu vakṣyati rājāsau kiṁ bhīṣmaḥ prativakṣyati,
kiṁ bhīmaḥ samaraślāghī kiṁ nu kr̥ṣṇārjunāviti ॥33॥
6.43.36: tamuvāca tataḥ pādau karābhyāṁ pīḍya pāṇḍavaḥ,
6.43.37: āmantraye tvāṁ durdharṣa tvayā yotsyāmahe saha,
6.43.41: arthasya puruṣo dāso dāsastvartho na kasyacit,
6.43.44: rājan kimatra sāhyaṁ te karomi kurunandana,
kāmaṁ yotsye parasyārthe brūhi yat te vivakṣitam ॥44॥
6.43.45: etanme mantraya hitaṁ yadi śreyaḥ prapaśyasi ॥45॥
6.43.46: nainaṁ paśyāmi kaunteya yo māṁ yudhyantamāhave,
6.43.47: hanta pr̥cchāmi tasmāt tvāṁ pitāmaha namo’stu te,
6.43.48: na sma taṁ tāta paśyāmi samare yo jayeta mām,
6.43.55: karavāṇi ca te kāmaṁ brūhi tvamabhikaṅkṣitam,
6.43.56: arthasya puruṣo dāso dāsastvartho na kasyacit,
6.43.58: jayamāśāsva me brahman mantrayasva ca maddhitam,
yuddhyasva kauravasyārthe vara eṣa vr̥to mayā ॥58॥
6.43.59: dhruvaste vijayo rājan yasya mantrī haristava,
6.43.60: yato dharmastataḥ kr̥ṣṇo yataḥ kr̥ṣṇastato jayaḥ,
yuddhyasva gaccha kaunteya pr̥ccha māṁ kiṁ bravīmi te ॥60॥
6.43.62: na te’sti vijayastāvad yāvat yuddhyāmyahaṁ raṇe,
mamāśu nidhane rājan yatasva saha sodaraiḥ ॥62॥
6.43.63: ācārya praṇipatyaiṣa pr̥cchāmi tvāṁ namo’stu te ॥63॥
6.43.64: na śatruṁ tāta paśyāmi yo māṁ hanyād rathe sthitam,
6.43.65: hanyānmāṁ yudhi yodhānāṁ satyametad bravīmi te ॥65॥
6.43.66: śastraṁ cāhaṁ raṇe jahyāṁ śrutvā tu mahadapriyam,
6.43.68: so’bhivādya kr̥paṁ rājā kr̥tvā cāpi pradakṣiṇam,
6.43.71: arthasya puruṣo dāso dāsastvartho na kasyacit,
6.43.73: hanta pr̥cchāmi te tasmādācārya śr̥ṇu me vacaḥ,
6.43.76: anumānya kr̥paṁ rājā prayayau yena madrarāṭ ॥76॥
6.43.79: śapeyaṁ tvāṁ mahārāja parābhāvāya vai raṇe ॥79॥
6.43.80: tuṣṭo’smi pūjitaścāsmi yat kāṅkṣasi tadastu te,
6.43.81: brūhi caiva paraṁ vīra kenārthaḥ kiṁ dadāmi te,
6.43.82: arthasya puruṣo dāso dāsastvartho na kasyacit,
6.43.83: kariṣyāmi hi te kāmaṁ bhāgineya yathepsitam,
6.43.85: kimatra brūhi sāhyaṁ te karomi nr̥pasattama,
6.43.86: sa eva me varaḥ śalya udyoge yastvayā kr̥taḥ,
6.43.86d1: tvāṁ hi yokṣyati sūtatve sūtaputrasya mātula,
duryodhano raṇe śūramiti me naiṣṭhikī matiḥ.
6.43.90: śrutaṁ me karṇa bhīṣmasya dveṣāt kila na yotsyase,
asmān varaya rādheya yāvad bhīṣmo na hanyate ॥90॥
6.43.91: hate tu bhīṣme rādheya punareṣyasi saṁyugam,
dhārtarāṣṭrasya sāhāyyaṁ yadi paśyasi cet samam ॥91॥
6.43.94: atha sainyasya madhye tu prākrośat pāṇḍavāgrajaḥ,
6.43.97: yuyutso vāsudevaśca vayaṁ ca brūma sarvaśaḥ ॥97॥
6.43.98: vr̥ṇomi tvāṁ mahābāho yuddhyasva mama kāraṇāt,
6.43.100d2: senāmadhye hi taiḥ sākaṁ yuddhāya kr̥taniścayaḥ.
6.43.102: tato vyūhaṁ yathāpūrvaṁ pratyavyūhanta te punaḥ ॥102॥
6.43.105: gauravaṁ pāṇḍuputrāṇāṁ mānyān mānayatāṁ ca tān,
6.43.106: sauhr̥daṁ ca kr̥pāṁ caiva prāptakālaṁ mahātmanām,
dayāṁ ca jñātiṣu parāṁ kathayāñcakrire nr̥pāḥ ॥106॥
6.43.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi bhīṣpādisammānane tricatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥43॥
6.44.1: ke pūrvaṁ prāharaṁstatra kuravaḥ pāṇḍavā nu kim ॥1॥
6.44.2: bhīṣmaṁ pramukhataḥ kr̥tvā prayayau saha senayā ॥2॥
6.44.11: taṁ śrutvā ninadaṁ tasya sainyāstava vitatrasuḥ,
6.44.20: tāvakānāṁ pareṣāṁ ca nāsīt kaścit parāṅmukhaḥ ॥20॥
6.44.23: sarve tvanye mahīpālāḥ prekṣakā iva bhārata,
6.44.29: nātra sveṣāṁ pareṣāṁ vā viśeṣaḥ samadr̥śyata ॥29॥
6.44.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi yuddhārambhe catuścatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥44॥
6.45.10: gāṅgeyastu raṇe pārthaṁ viddhvā nākampayad balī ॥10॥
6.45.11: tathaiva pāṇḍavo rājan bhīṣmaṁ nākampayad yudhi,
6.45.15: dhvajaṁ ciccheda samare sārathiṁ ca nyapātayat ॥15॥
6.45.18: anyonyaṁ ca śaraiḥ kruddhau tatakṣāte parasparam,
6.45.20: tau vīkṣya tu mahātmānau kr̥tinau citrayodhinau ॥20॥
6.45.22: tasya mādrīsutaḥ ketuṁ saśaraṁ ca śarāsanam ॥22॥
6.45.32: tridhā ciccheda samare pāñcālyasya tu kārmukam,
6.45.35: saumadattiṁ raṇe śaṅkho rabhasaṁ rabhaso yudhi,
6.45.36: tasya vai dakṣiṇaṁ vīro nirbibheda raṇe bhujam,
6.45.38: bāhlīkaṁ tu raṇe kruddhaṁ kruddharūpo viśāmpate,
6.45.40: vivyādha samare tūrṇaṁ matto mattamiva dvipam ॥40॥
6.45.41: tau tatra samare kruddhau nardantau ca punaḥ punaḥ,
6.45.52: br̥hatkṣatraṁ tu kaikeyaṁ kr̥paḥ śāradvato yayau,
6.45.53: tāvanyonyaṁ hayān hatvā dhanuśchittvā ca bhārata ॥53॥
6.45.55: drupadastu tato rājan saindhavaṁ vai jayadratham,
6.45.56: tāḍayāmāsa samare sa ca taṁ pratyavidhyata ॥56॥
6.45.63: abhyadravata rājendra mattaḥ siṁha iva dvipam ॥63॥
6.45.71: śrutāyustu tataḥ kruddhaḥ phālguneḥ samare hayān,
6.45.73: ayudhyetāṁ sthirau bhūtvā mahatyā senayā saha ॥73॥
6.45.76: kekayā bhrātaraḥ pañca gāndhārān pañca māriṣa,
6.45.78: uttaraścāpi taṁ vīraṁ vivyādha niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ,
6.45.81: padātīnāṁ ca samare tava teṣāṁ ca saṅkule ॥81॥
6.45.82: tata unmattavad rājan na prājñāyata kiñcana ॥82॥
6.45.83: gajo gajena samare rathinaṁ ca rathī yayau,
6.45.85: praikṣanta tad raṇaṁ ghoraṁ devāsurasamaṁ bhuvi ॥85॥
6.45.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi dvandvayuddhe pañcacatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥45॥
6.46.1: nirmaryādaṁ prayuddhāni tat te vakṣyāmi bhārata ॥1॥
6.46.2: na putraḥ pitaraṁ jajñe pitā vā putramaurasam,
na bhrātā bhrātaraṁ tatra svasrīyaṁ na ca mātulaḥ ॥2॥
6.46.3: na mātulaṁ ca svasrīyo na sakhāyaṁ sakhā tathā,
āviṣṭā iva yudhyante pāṇḍavāḥ kurubhiḥ saha ॥3॥
6.46.6: na śekuścalituṁ kecit saṁnipatya rathā rathaiḥ,
6.46.36: vyākrośanta narā rājaṁstatra tatra sma bāndhavān,
6.46.41: naiva śastraṁ vimuñcanti naiva krandanti māriṣa ॥41॥
6.46.44: anye ca virathāḥ śūrā rathamanyasya saṁyuge ॥44॥
6.46.47: nijaghāna pitā putraṁ putraśca pitaraṁ raṇe,
svasrīyo mātulaṁ cāpi svasrīyaṁ cāpi mātulaḥ ॥47॥
6.46.48: sakhā sakhāyaṁ ca tathā sambandhī bāndhavaṁ tathā,
evaṁ yuyudhire tatra kuravaḥ pāṇḍavaiḥ saha ॥48॥
6.46.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi saṅkulayuddhe ṣaṭcatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥46॥
6.47.2: durmukhaḥ kr̥tavarmā ca kr̥paḥ śalyo viviṁśatiḥ,
6.47.19: tathaiva kr̥tavarmā ca kr̥paḥ śalyaśca māriṣa,
6.47.27: atha bhīṣmo mahāstrāṇi divyāni subahūni ca,
6.47.37: tasya kruddhaḥ sa nāgendro br̥hataḥ sādhuvāhinaḥ,
6.47.41: bhīmamārtasvaraṁ kr̥tvā papāta ca mamāra ca ॥41॥
6.47.43: uttaraṁ vai hataṁ dr̥ṣṭvā vairāṭirbhrātaraṁ tadā,
6.47.53: tataste tu nimeṣārdhāt pratyapadyan dhanūṁṣi ca ॥53॥
6.47.58: tasya dehe nipatito bāṇo vajrātigo mahān ॥58॥
6.47.63: dr̥ṣṭvā senāpatiṁ tūrṇaṁ yāntaṁ śalyarathaṁ prati ॥63॥
6.47.64: tato bhīṣmaṁ puraskr̥tya tava putro mahābalaḥ,
6.47.66: saubhadre bhīmasene ca sātyakau ca mahārathe ॥66॥
6.47.67: kaikeye ca virāṭe ca dhr̥ṣṭadyumne ca pārṣate,
6.47.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi śvetayuddhe saptacatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥47॥
6.48.1: evaṁ śvete maheṣvāse prāpte śalyarathaṁ prati,
6.48.2: bhīṣmaḥ śāntanavaḥ kiṁ vā tanmamācakṣva pr̥cchataḥ,
6.48.5: jighāṁsantaṁ yudhāṁ śreṣṭhaṁ tadā’’sīt tumulaṁ mahat,
6.48.8: nudan samantāt samare ravirudyan yathā tamaḥ,
6.48.12: udīrṇāśca hayā rājan vahantastatra tatra ha,
6.48.24: pitā putraṁ ca samare nābhijānāti kaścana,
cakre bhagne yuge chinne ekadhurye haye hataḥ ॥24॥
6.48.25: evaṁ ca samare sarve vīrāśca virathīkr̥tāḥ ॥25॥
6.48.26: tena tena sma dr̥śyante dhāvamānāḥ samantataḥ,
gajo hataḥ śiraśchinnaṁ marma bhinnaṁ hayo hataḥ ॥26॥
6.48.27: ahataḥ ko’pi naivāsīd bhīṣme nighnati śātravān,
6.48.33: bhīṣmaṁ śāntanavaṁ yuddhe sthitāḥ paśyāma sarvaśaḥ,
6.48.38: jīvitaṁ dustyajaṁ tyaktvā bhayaṁ ca sumahāhave ॥38॥
6.48.41: śvetaṁ cāpi tathā bhīṣmaḥ śaraughaiḥ samavākirat,
6.48.44: śaraiḥ paramasaṅkruddho yadi śveto na pālayet,
6.48.46: durmukhaḥ kr̥tavarmā ca kr̥paḥ śalyo viśāmpatiḥ ॥46॥
6.48.50: āpatat sahasā bhūyo yatra bhīṣmo vyavasthitaḥ,
6.48.52: nigr̥hya kārmukaṁ śveto bhīṣmaṁ vivyādha saptabhiḥ,
6.48.59: pāṇḍavāścāpi saṁhr̥ṣṭā dadhmuḥ śaṅkhān mudā yutāḥ ॥59॥
6.48.60: bhīṣmasya patitaṁ ketuṁ dr̥ṣṭvā tālaṁ mahātmanaḥ,
6.48.62: bhīṣmaḥ śāntanavaḥ śūrastathā satyaṁ bravīmi vaḥ,
6.48.63: bāhlīkaḥ kr̥tavarmā ca śalaḥ śalyaśca bhārata ॥63॥
6.48.66: sa nivārya tu tān sarvān kesarī kuñjarāniva ॥66॥
6.48.68: śvetaṁ vivyādha rājendra kaṅkapatraiḥ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ,
6.48.69: tataḥ pravyathito rājā bhīṣmaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā nivāritam ॥69॥
6.48.70: pravīraṁ sarvalokasya śvetena yudhi vai tadā,
6.48.71: taṁ vīraṁ vāritaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā śvetena śaravikṣatam,
6.48.72: dhvajamunmathitaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā tāṁ ca senāṁ nivāritām ॥72॥
6.48.73: śvetaṁ prati mahārāja vyasr̥jat sāyakān bahūn,
tānāvārya raṇe śveto bhīṣmasya rathināṁ varaḥ ॥73॥
6.48.75: tatra sandhāya vipulān bhallān sapta śilāśitān ॥75॥
6.48.76: dhvajaṁ dvābhyāṁ tu ciccheda saptamena ca sāratheḥ ॥76॥
6.48.78: virathaṁ rathināṁ śreṣṭhaṁ śvetaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā pitāmahaḥ ॥78॥
6.48.80: tataḥ śaktiṁ raṇe śveto jagrāhogrāṁ mahābhayām ॥80॥
6.48.81: abravīcca tadā śveto bhīṣmaṁ śāntanavaṁ raṇe ॥81॥
6.48.82: tiṣṭhedānīṁ susaṁrabdhaḥ paśya māṁ puruṣo bhava,
6.48.90: gadāṁ jagrāha saṁhr̥ṣṭo bhīṣmasya nidhanaṁ prati,
6.48.92: śvetaḥ krodhasamāviṣṭo bhrāmayitvā tu tāṁ gadām ॥92॥
6.48.93: rathe bhīṣmasya cikṣepa yathā devo dhaneśvaraḥ,
6.48.94: virathaṁ rathināṁ śreṣṭhaṁ bhīṣmaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā rathottamāḥ ॥94॥
6.48.97: bhīṣma bhīṣma mahābāho śīghraṁ yatnaṁ kuruṣva vai ॥97॥
6.48.98: eṣa hyasya jaye kālo nirdiṣṭo viśvayoninā,
6.48.99: samprahr̥ṣṭamanā bhūtvā vadhe tasya mano dadhe,
virathaṁ rathināṁ śreṣṭhaṁ śvetaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā padātinam ॥99॥
6.48.104: devadūtavacaḥ śrutvā vadhe tasya mano dadhe,
6.48.106: pitā te bharataśreṣṭha śvetaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā mahārathaiḥ,
6.48.108: ājaghne viśikhaiḥ ṣaṣṭyā senānyaṁ sa mahārathaḥ,
6.48.110: dhr̥ṣṭadyumnaṁ ca viṁśatyā kaikeyaṁ cāpi pañcabhiḥ,
6.48.113: sa tasya kavacaṁ bhittvā hr̥dayaṁ cāmitaujasaḥ ॥113॥
6.48.115: taṁ bhīṣmeṇa naravyāghraṁ tathā vinihataṁ yudhi ॥115॥
6.48.117: tato duḥśāsano rājan śvetaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā nipātitam ॥117॥
6.48.120: tato’vahāraḥ sainyānāṁ tava teṣāṁ ca bhārata ॥120॥
6.48.121: tāvakānāṁ pareṣāṁ ca nardatāṁ ca muhurmuhuḥ,
6.48.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi śvetavadhe aṣṭacatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥48॥
6.49.1: śvete senāpatau tāta saṅgrāme nihate paraiḥ,
6.49.3: manaḥ prīṇāti me vākyaṁ jayaṁ sañjaya śr̥ṇvataḥ,
pratyupāyaṁ cintayato lajjāṁ prāpnoti me na hi ॥3॥
6.49.4: kr̥taṁ vairaṁ sadā tena pituḥ putreṇa dhīmatā ॥4॥
6.49.5: sarvaṁ balaṁ parityajya durgaṁ saṁśritya tiṣṭhati ॥5॥
6.49.6: pāṇḍavānāṁ pratāpena durgaṁ deśaṁ niveśya ca,
6.49.7: āścaryaṁ vai sadā teṣāṁ purā rājñāṁ sudurmatiḥ,
tato yudhiṣṭhire bhaktaḥ kathaṁ sañjaya sūditaḥ ॥7॥
6.49.8: prakṣiptaḥ sammataḥ kṣudraḥ putro me puruṣādhamaḥ,
na yuddhaṁ rocayed bhīṣmo na cācāryaḥ kathañcana ॥8॥
6.49.9: na kr̥po na ca gāndhārī nāhaṁ sañjaya rocaye,
6.49.10: na bhīmo nārjunaścaiva na yamau puruṣarṣabhau,
vāryamāṇo mayā nityaṁ gāndhāryā vidureṇa ca ॥10॥
6.49.13: tasyāhaṁ vyasanaṁ ghoraṁ manye prāptaṁ tu sañjaya,
śvetasya ca vināśena bhīṣmasya vijayena ca ॥13॥
6.49.14: arjunāddhi bhayaṁ bhūyastanme tāta na śāmyati ॥14॥
6.49.15: sa hi śūraśca kaunteyaḥ kṣiprakārī dhanañjayaḥ,
6.49.21: teṣāṁ krodhaṁ cintayaṁstu ahaḥsu ca niśāsu ca,
6.49.22: śr̥ṇu rājan sthiro bhūtvā tavāpanayano mahān,
6.49.23: sandīpte bhavane yadvat kūpasya khananaṁ tathā ॥23॥
6.49.25: śvetaṁ tu nihataṁ dr̥ṣṭvā virāṭasya camūpatim,
6.49.30: tathā rukmaratho rājan putraḥ śalyasya mānitaḥ ॥30॥
6.49.33: te tu bāṇamayaṁ varṣaṁ śaṅkhamūrdhni nyapātayan,
6.49.40: sa hatāśvād rathāt tūrṇaṁ khaḍgamādāya vidrutaḥ,
6.49.45: atyatiṣṭhad raṇe bhīṣmo vidhūma iva pāvakaḥ ॥45॥
6.49.46: na śekuḥ pāṇḍaveyasya yodhā bhīṣmaṁ nirīkṣitum ॥46॥
6.49.52: tataḥ sainyeṣu bhagneṣu mathiteṣu ca sarvaśaḥ,
prāpte cāstaṁ dinakare na prājñāyata kiñcana ॥52॥
6.49.53: bhīṣmaṁ ca samudīryantaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā pārthā mahāhave,
6.49.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi śaṅkhayuddhe prathamadivasāvahāre ekonapañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥49॥
6.50.1: bhīṣme ca yuddhasaṁrabdhe hr̥ṣṭe duryodhane tathā ॥1॥
6.50.7: śakyo jetuṁ yamaḥ kruddho vajrapāṇiśca saṁyuge,
varuṇaḥ pāśabhr̥d vāpi kubero vā gadādharaḥ ॥7॥
6.50.8: na tu bhīṣmo mahātejāḥ śakyo jetuṁ mahābalaḥ,
6.50.9: vanaṁ yāsyāmi vārṣṇeya śreyo me tatra jīvitum ॥9॥
6.50.10: na tvetān pr̥thivīpālān dātuṁ bhīṣmāya mr̥tyave,
kṣapayiṣyati senāṁ me kr̥ṣṇa bhīṣmo mahāstravit ॥10॥
6.50.13: jīvitaṁ bahu manye’haṁ jīvitaṁ hyadya durlabham ॥13॥
6.50.16: kiṁ nu kr̥tvā hitaṁ me syād brūhi mādhava māciram,
6.50.17: eko bhīmaḥ paraṁ śaktyā yudhyatyeva mahābhujaḥ,
6.50.21: dhakṣyanti kṣatriyān sarvān prayuktāni punaḥ punaḥ ॥21॥
6.50.23: sa tvaṁ paśya mahābhāga yogeśvara mahāratham,
bhīṣmaṁ yaḥ śamayet saṅkhye dāvāgniṁ jalado yathā ॥23॥
6.50.26: mā śuco bharataśreṣṭha na tvaṁ śocitumarhasi ॥26॥
6.50.27: yasya te bhrātaraḥ śūrāḥ sarvalokeṣu dhanvinaḥ,
ahaṁ ca priyakr̥d rājan sātyakiśca mahāyaśāḥ ॥27॥
6.50.29: eṣa te pārṣato nityaṁ hitakāmaḥ priye rataḥ ॥29॥
6.50.30: śikhaṇḍī ca mahābāho bhīṣmasya nidhanaṁ kila ॥30॥
6.50.30d1: kariṣyati na sandeho nr̥pāṇāṁ yudhi paśyatām,
6.50.32: dhr̥ṣṭadyumna nibodhedaṁ yat tvāṁ vakṣyāmi māriṣa,
nātikramyaṁ bhavet tacca vacanaṁ mama bhāṣitam ॥32॥
6.50.34: sa tvaṁ puruṣaśārdūla vikramya jahi kauravān ॥34॥
6.50.35: ahaṁ ca te’nuyāsyāmi bhīmaḥ kr̥ṣṇaśca māriṣa,
6.50.37: ahaṁ droṇāntakaḥ pārtha vihitaḥ śambhunā purā,
raṇe bhīṣmaṁ kr̥paṁ droṇaṁ tathā śalyaṁ jayadratham ॥37॥
6.50.45: tena ratnavatā pārthaḥ sa ca gāṇḍīvadhanvanā ॥45॥
6.50.46: śiro’bhūd drupado rājan mahatyā senayā vr̥taḥ ॥46॥
6.50.55: grīvāyāṁ niyutaṁ cāpi sahasrāṇi ca saptatiḥ,
6.50.58: sūryodayaṁ ta icchantaḥ sthitā yuddhāya daṁśitāḥ,
6.50.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi krauñcavyūhanirmāṇe pañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥50॥
6.51.5: ekaikaśaḥ samarthā hi yūyaṁ sarve mahārathāḥ,
pāṇḍuputrān raṇe hantuṁ sasainyān kimu saṁhatāḥ ॥5॥
6.51.10: tato bhīṣmaśca droṇaśca tava putrāśca māriṣa,
6.51.21: tataste tāvakāḥ sarve hr̥ṣṭā yuddhāya bhārata,
6.51.22: teṣāṁ śrutvā tu hr̥ṣṭānāṁ vr̥ddhaḥ kurupitāmahaḥ,
6.51.23: tataḥ śaṅkhāśca bheryaśca paṇavā vividhāḥ pare,
6.52.3: teṣāṁ madhye sthito rājan putro duryodhanastava,
6.52.8: saubhadre bhīmasene ca sātyakau ca mahārathe,
kaikeye ca virāṭe ca dhr̥ṣṭadyumne ca pārṣate ॥8॥
6.52.13: eṣa bhīṣmaḥ susaṅkruddho vārṣṇeya mama vāhinīm,
6.52.14: eṣa droṇaḥ kr̥paḥ śalyo vikarṇaśca janārdana,
6.52.17: evamuktvā tataḥ śaurī rathaṁ taṁ lokaviśrutam,
6.52.21: trāsayantaṁ raṇe śūrān mardayantaṁ ca sāyakaiḥ,
6.52.27: sa bhīṣmaṁ pañcaviṁśatyā kr̥paṁ ca navabhiḥ śaraiḥ ॥27॥
6.52.28: droṇaṁ ṣaṣṭyā naravyāghro vikarṇaṁ ca tribhiḥ śaraiḥ,
śalyaṁ caiva tribhirbāṇai rājānaṁ caiva pañcabhiḥ ॥28॥
6.52.30: tato droṇaṁ maheṣvāsaṁ gāṅgeyasya priye ratam ॥30॥
6.52.31: bhīṣmastu rathināṁ śreṣṭho rājan vivyādha pāṇḍavam ॥31॥
6.52.32: teṣāṁ tu ninadaṁ śrutvā sahitānāṁ prahr̥ṣṭavat ॥32॥
6.52.33: teṣāṁ mahārathānāṁ sa madhyaṁ prāpya dhanañjayaḥ ॥33॥
6.52.35: pīḍyamānaṁ svakaṁ sainyaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā pārthena saṁyuge,
6.52.36: tvayi jīvati gāṅgeya droṇe ca rathināṁ vare ॥36॥
6.52.37: na yudhyati raṇe pārthaṁ hitakāmaḥ sadā mama ॥37॥
6.52.38: sa tathā kuru gāṅgeya yathā hanyeta phālgunaḥ,
6.52.39: dhik kṣātraṁ dharmamityuktvā prāyāt pārtharathaṁ prati,
ubhau śvetahayau rājan saṁsaktau prekṣya pārthivāḥ ॥39॥
6.52.40: siṁhanādān bhr̥śaṁ cakruḥ śaṅkhān dadhmuśca māriṣa,
6.52.41: parivārya raṇe bhīṣmaṁ sthitā yuddhāya māriṣa,
6.52.49: bhīṣmo’pi samare pārthaṁ vivyādha niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ,
anyonyasya hayān viddhvā dhvajau ca sumahābalau ॥49॥
6.52.50: tataḥ kruddho mahārāja bhīṣmaḥ praharatāṁ varaḥ ॥50॥
6.52.52: virarāja raṇe rājan sapuṣpa iva kiṁśukaḥ,
tato’rjuno bhr̥śaṁ kruddho nividdhaṁ prekṣya mādhavam ॥52॥
6.52.53: yatamānau tu tau vīrāvanyonyasya vadhaṁ prati ॥53॥
6.52.58: dāritā sahasā bhūmiścakampe ca nanāda ca,
6.52.61: na tayorvivaraṁ kaścid raṇe paśyati bhārata ॥61॥
6.52.62: dharme sthitasya hi yathā na kaścid vr̥jinaṁ kvacit,
6.52.64: na śakyau yudhi saṁrabdhau jetumetau kathañcana ॥64॥
6.52.66: na hi śakyo raṇe jetuṁ bhīṣmaḥ pārthena dhīmatā ॥66॥
6.52.67: sadhanuḥ sarathaḥ sāśvaḥ pravapan sāyakān raṇe,
6.52.68: na vijetuṁ raṇe bhīṣma utsaheta dhanurdharam,
6.52.72: vartamāne tathā ghore tasmin yuddhe sudāruṇe,
6.52.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi bhīṣmārjunayuddhe dvipañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥52॥
6.53.2: diṣṭameva paraṁ manye pauruṣāditi me matiḥ,
yatra śāntanavo bhīṣmo nātarad yudhi pāṇḍavam ॥2॥
6.53.3: sa kathaṁ pāṇḍavaṁ yuddhe nātarat sañjayaujasā ॥3॥
6.53.4: śr̥ṇu rājan sthiro bhūtvā yuddhametat sudāruṇam,
na śakyāḥ pāṇḍavā jetuṁ devairapi savāsavaiḥ ॥4॥
6.53.12: taṁ ca dīptaṁ śaraṁ ghoramāyāntaṁ mr̥tyumātmanaḥ,
ciccheda śaravr̥ṣṭiṁ ca bhāradvāje mumoca ha ॥12॥
6.53.13: tata uccukruśuḥ sarve pañcālāḥ pāṇḍavaiḥ saha,
dhr̥ṣṭadyumnena tat karma kr̥taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā suduṣkaram ॥13॥
6.53.20: vyaṁsayitvā gadāṁ tāṁ ca preṣayāmāsa pārṣatam ॥20॥
6.53.21: te tasya kavacaṁ bhittvā papuḥ śoṇitamāhave ॥21॥
6.53.30: tataḥ sa vipulaṁ carma śatacandraṁ ca bhānumat,
khaḍgaṁ ca vipulaṁ divyaṁ pragr̥hya subhujo balī ॥30॥
6.53.31: āmiṣārthī yathā siṁho vane mattamiva dvipam ॥31॥
6.53.32: lāghavaṁ cāstrayogaṁ ca balaṁ bāhvośca bhārata ॥32॥
6.53.33: na śaśāka tato gantuṁ balavānapi saṁyuge ॥33॥
6.53.36: sa droṇaṁ niśitairbāṇai rājan vivyādha saptabhiḥ,
pārṣataṁ ca rathaṁ tūrṇaṁ svakamārohayat tadā ॥36॥
6.53.38: tataḥ sā mahatī senā kaliṅgānāṁ janeśvara,
6.53.41: kaliṅgānāṁ ca samare bhīmasya ca mahātmanaḥ,
6.53.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi dhr̥ṣṭadyumnadroṇayuddhe tripañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥53॥
6.54.3: putreṇa tava rājendra sa tathokto mahābalaḥ,
mahatyā senayā guptaḥ prāyād bhīmarathaṁ prati ॥3॥
6.54.6: tataḥ śrutāyuḥ saṅkruddho rājñā ketumatā saha,
6.54.7: ayutena gajānāṁ ca niṣādaiḥ saha ketumān ॥7॥
6.54.10: ghoramāsīt tato yuddhaṁ bhīmasya sahasā paraiḥ ॥10॥
6.54.12: anyonyaṁ sma tadā yodhā vikarṣanto viśāmpate ॥12॥
6.54.19: śakradeva iti khyāto jaghnatuḥ pāṇḍavaṁ śaraiḥ,
6.54.23: hatāśve tu rathe tiṣṭhan bhīmaseno mahābalaḥ ॥23॥
6.54.24: sa tayā nihato rājan kāliṅgatanayo rathāt ॥24॥
6.54.26: tato bhīmo mahāvegāṁ tyaktvā gurvīṁ mahāgadām ॥26॥
6.54.33: nikr̥tya tu raṇe bhīmastomarān vai caturdaśa ॥33॥
6.54.35: na ca taṁ mamr̥ṣe bhīmaḥ siṁhanādaṁ mahāhave ॥35॥
6.54.37: na bhīmaṁ samare mene mānuṣaṁ bharatarṣabha,
6.54.39: tato mumoca kāliṅgaḥ śaktiṁ tāmakarod dvidhā,
6.54.43: sa cacāra bahūn mārgānabhitaḥ pātayan gajān,
6.54.48: nikr̥tya rathināṁ cājau ratheṣāśca yugāni ca ॥48॥
6.54.59: tad ghoramabhavad yuddhaṁ tasya teṣāṁ ca bhārata,
6.54.62: sa cakre vasudhāṁ kīrṇāṁ śabalaiḥ kusumairiva,
6.54.66: evaṁ sā bahulā senā kaliṅgānāṁ tarasvinām ॥66॥
6.54.76: satyadevaṁ ca satyaṁ ca prāhiṇod yamasādanam ॥76॥
6.54.80: saṁnivārya sa tāṁ ghorāṁ śaravr̥ṣṭiṁ samutthitām,
6.54.82: evaṁ sa tānyanīkāni kaliṅgānāṁ punaḥ punaḥ ॥82॥
6.54.83: bibheda samare tūrṇaṁ prekṣya bhīṣmaṁ mahāratham,
6.54.87: prākampanta ca sainyāni vāhanāni ca sarvaśaḥ,
6.54.88: mārgān bahūn vicaratā dhāvatā ca tatastataḥ,
6.54.95: na hi pañcālarājasya loke kaścana vidyate,
6.54.97: śaṅkhaṁ dadhmau ca samare siṁhanādaṁ nanāda ca ॥97॥
6.54.101: sa tatra gatvā śaineyo javena jayatāṁ varaḥ,
6.54.106: tataḥ śāntanavo bhīṣmaḥ śrutvā taṁ ninadaṁ raṇe,
6.54.108: parivārya tu te sarve gāṅgeyaṁ tarasā raṇe,
6.54.111: hatāśve sa rathe tiṣṭhan bhīmasenaḥ pratāpavān,
śaktiṁ cikṣepa tarasā gāṅgeyasya rathaṁ prati ॥111॥
6.54.113: tataḥ śaikyāyasīṁ gurvīṁ pragr̥hya balavān gadām,
6.54.115: bhīṣmastu nihate tasmin sārathau rathināṁ varaḥ,
6.54.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi dvitīyayuddhadivase kaliṅgarājavadhe catuṣpañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥54॥
6.55.5: dhr̥ṣṭadyumnaṁ tu saṁyuktaṁ drauṇinā vīkṣya bhārata,
6.55.6: sa śalyaṁ pañcaviṁśatyā kr̥paṁ ca navabhiḥ śaraiḥ,
6.55.14: tato duryodhano rājā dr̥ṣṭvā putraṁ mahāratham,
pīḍitaṁ tava pautreṇa prāyāt tatra prajeśvaraḥ ॥14॥
6.55.15: saṁnivr̥tte tava sute sarva eva janādhipāḥ,
6.55.16: sa taiḥ parivr̥taḥ śūraiḥ śūro yudhi sudurjayaiḥ,
6.55.22: nāpyantarikṣaṁ na diśo na bhūmirna ca bhāskaraḥ,
6.55.31: dhvajānāṁ carmaṇāṁ caiva vyajanānāṁ ca sarvaśaḥ,
6.55.32: pratodānāṁ ca yoktrāṇāṁ kaśānāṁ caiva māriṣa,
6.55.33: nāsīt tatra pumān kaścit tava sainyasya bhārata,
6.55.34: yo yo hi samare pārthaṁ pratyudyāti viśāmpate,
6.55.36: tat prabhagnaṁ balaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā pitā devavratastava,
6.55.37: eṣa pāṇḍusuto vīraḥ kr̥ṣṇena sahito balī,
tathā karoti sainyāni yathā kuryād dhanañjayaḥ ॥37॥
6.55.38: na hyeṣa samare śakyo vijetuṁ hi kathañcana,
6.55.39: na nivartayituṁ cāpi śakyeyaṁ mahatī camūḥ,
6.55.41: śrāntā bhītāśca no yodhā na yotsyanti kathañcana ॥41॥
6.55.43: tato’vahāraḥ sainyānāṁ tava teṣāṁ ca bhārata,
astaṁ gacchati sūrye’bhūt sandhyākāle ca vartati ॥43॥
6.55.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi dvitīyayuddhadivasāvahāre pañcapañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥55॥
6.56.3: cakṣuṣī ca bharadvājaḥ kr̥tavarmā ca sātvataḥ ॥3॥
6.56.10: vyūḍhaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā tu tat sainyaṁ savyasācī parantapaḥ,
6.56.15: madhye sainyasya mahataḥ sthitā yuddhāya bhārata,
6.56.16: tatastu sātyakī rājan draupadyāḥ pañca cātmajāḥ,
6.56.18: sarvasya jagato goptā goptā yasya janārdanaḥ,
6.56.19: vadhārthaṁ tava putrāṇāṁ tatpakṣaṁ ye ca saṅgatāḥ,
6.56.21: dhāvatāṁ ca rathaughānāṁ nighnatāṁ ca pr̥thak pr̥thak ॥21॥
6.56.22: samprahāre sutumule tava teṣāṁ ca bhārata ॥22॥
6.56.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi tr̥tīye yuddhadivase parasparavyūharacanāyāṁ ṣaṭpañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥56॥
6.57.3: prārthayānā yaśo dīptaṁ mr̥tyuṁ kr̥tvā nivartanam ॥3॥
6.57.6: na diśaḥ pradiśo vāpi tatra hanyuḥ kathaṁ narāḥ ॥6॥
6.57.7: vartate ca tathā yuddhaṁ tatra tatra viśāmpate ॥7॥
6.57.8: na vyūho bhidyate tatra kauravāṇāṁ kathañcana,
6.57.18: sagajaṁ pātayāmāsa gajī sa rathināṁ baram ॥18॥
6.57.20: padātī rathinaṁ saṅkhye rathī cāpi padātinam,
6.57.37: abhyayāt pāṇḍavaṁ yuddhe rākṣasaṁ ca ghaṭotkacam ॥37॥
6.57.38: tathaiva pāṇḍavāḥ sarve mahatyā senayā saha,
6.57.39: kirīṭī ca yayau kruddhaḥ samantāt pārthivottamān,
6.57.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi tr̥tīye yuddhadivase saṅkulayuddhe saptapañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥57॥
6.58.1: tataste pārthivāḥ kruddhāḥ phālgunaṁ vīkṣya saṁyuge,
6.58.4: cikṣipuḥ samare kruddhāḥ phālgunasya rathaṁ prati,
6.58.12: tato dharmasuto rājā mādrīputrau ca pāṇḍavau,
6.58.17: niṣasāda rathopasthe kaśmalaṁ ca jagāma ha ॥17॥
6.58.18: taṁ visañjñaṁ viditvā tu tvaramāṇo’sya sārathiḥ,
6.58.20: droṇasya paśyataḥ sainyaṁ gāṅgeyasya ca paśyataḥ ॥20॥
6.58.21: dravamāṇaṁ tu tat sainyaṁ tava putrasya saṁyuge ॥21॥
6.58.22: vāryamāṇaṁ ca bhīṣmeṇa droṇena ca mahātmanā ॥22॥
6.58.30: yatra yatra sutastubhyaṁ yaṁ yaṁ paśyati bhārata,
6.58.33: abravīt tvarito gatvā bhīṣmaṁ śāntanavaṁ vacaḥ ॥33॥
6.58.34: pitāmaha nibodhedaṁ yat tvāṁ vakṣyāmi bhārata,
6.58.35: kr̥pe caiva maheṣvāse dravate yad varūthinī ॥35॥
6.58.36: tathā droṇasya saṅgrāme drauṇeścaiva kr̥pasya ca ॥36॥
6.58.38: na yotsye pāṇḍavān saṅkhye nāpi pārṣatasātyakī ॥38॥
6.58.39: śrutvā tu vacanaṁ tubhyamācāryasya kr̥pasya ca,
6.58.41: etacchrutvā vaco bhīṣmaḥ prahasan vai muhurmuhuḥ,
6.58.43: yat tu śakyaṁ mayā kartuṁ vr̥ddhenādya nr̥pottama,
6.58.45: dadhmuḥ śaṅkhān mudā yuktā bherīḥ sañjaghnire bhr̥śam ॥45॥
6.58.46: pāṇḍavā hi tato rājan śrutvā taṁ ninadaṁ mahat,
6.58.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi tr̥tīye yuddhadivase bhīṣmaduryodhanasaṁvāde aṣṭapañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥58॥
6.59.8: tiṣṭha sthito’smi viddhyenaṁ nivartasva sthiro bhava,
6.59.14: na dr̥ṣṭaṁ na śrutaṁ vāpi yuddhametādr̥śaṁ nr̥pa,
yathā tava sutānāṁ ca pāṇḍavānāṁ ca bhārata ॥14॥
6.59.18: tāta bhrātaḥ sakhe bandho vayasya mama mātula,
mā māṁ parityajetyanye cukruśuḥ patitā raṇe ॥18॥
6.59.19: sthito’haṁ samare mā bhairiti cānye vicukruśuḥ ॥19॥
6.59.22: sa utpan vai rathopasthe darśayan pāṇilāghavam,
6.59.23: tamekaṁ samare śūraṁ pāṇḍavāḥ sr̥ñjayaiḥ saha,
6.59.24: pūrvasyāṁ diśi taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā pratīcyāṁ dadr̥śurjanāḥ ॥24॥
6.59.25: evaṁ sa samare śūro gāṅgeyaḥ pratyadr̥śyata ॥25॥
6.59.27: kurvāṇaṁ samare karma sūdayānaṁ ca vāhinīm,
vyākrośanta raṇe tatra narā bahuvidhā bahu ॥27॥
6.59.29: na hi moghaḥ śaraḥ kaścidāsīd bhīṣmasya saṁyuge ॥29॥
6.59.32: yo yo bhīṣmaṁ naravyāghramabhyeti yudhi kaścana ॥32॥
6.59.33: muhūrtadr̥ṣṭaḥ sa mayā patito bhuvi dr̥śyate,
6.59.37: abhajyata mahārāja na ca dvau saha dhāvataḥ,
6.59.38: jaghānātra pitā putra putraśca pitaraṁ tathā ॥38॥
6.59.42: ayaṁ sa kālaḥ samprāptaḥ pārtha yaste’bhikāṅkṣitaḥ ॥42॥
6.59.43: yat tvayā kathitaṁ vīra purā rājñāṁ samāgame ॥43॥
6.59.44: sānubandhān haniṣyāmi ye māṁ yotsyanti saṁyuge ॥44॥
6.59.45: iti tat kuru kaunteya satyaṁ vākyamarindama,
bībhatso paśya sainyaṁ svaṁ bhajyamānaṁ tatastataḥ ॥45॥
6.59.51: tato bhīṣmaḥ kuruśreṣṭha siṁhavad vinadan muhuḥ,
6.59.57: tasya tat pūjayāmāsa lāghavaṁ śāntanoḥ sutaḥ,
sādhu pārtha mahābāho sādhu bhoḥ pāṇḍunandana ॥57॥
6.59.58: prīto’smi subhr̥śaṁ putra kuru yuddhaṁ mayā saha ॥58॥
6.59.59: mumoca samare vīraḥ śarān pārtharathaṁ prati ॥59॥
6.59.69: ekāhnā hi raṇe bhīṣmo nāśayed devadānavān,
kiṁ nu pāṇḍusutān yuddhe sabalān sapadānugān ॥69॥
6.59.70: ete ca kauravāstūrṇaṁ prabhagnān vīkṣya somakān ॥70॥
6.59.74: na cāntarikṣaṁ na diśo na bhūmi-
6.59.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi tr̥tīyadivasāvahāre ekonaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥59॥
6.60.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi bhīṣmārjunadvairathe ṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥60॥
6.61.3: babhūva sadr̥śaḥ kārṣṇernāstre nāpi ca lāghave ॥3॥
6.61.5: pīḍayānaṁ tu tat sainyaṁ pautraṁ tava viśāmpate,
6.61.6: pratyudyayau sa saubhadrastejasā ca balena ca ॥6॥
6.61.8: sa drauṇimiṣuṇaikena viddhvā śalyaṁ ca pañcabhiḥ,
6.61.14: tau tu tatra pitāputrau parikṣiptau mahārathau,
6.61.19: tataḥ sa madrakān hatvā daśaiva daśabhiḥ śaraiḥ,
6.61.24: sa hatāśve rathe tiṣṭhan dadarśa bharatarṣabha,
6.61.29: tvaran senāpatiḥ kruddho bibheda gadayā śiraḥ ॥29॥
6.61.30: tasya rājan sanistriṁśaṁ suprabhaṁ ca śarāvaram,
hatasya patato hastād vegena nyapatad bhuvi ॥30॥
6.61.31: taṁ nihatya gadāgreṇa sa lebhe paramāṁ mudam,
6.61.34: tau tatra samare śūrau sametau yuddhadurmadau,
6.61.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi caturthayuddhadivase sāṁyamaniputravadhe ekaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥61॥
6.62.1: yat sainyaṁ mama putrasya pāṇḍusainyena bādhyate ॥1॥
6.62.2: nityaṁ hi māmakāṁstāta hatāneva hi śaṁsasi,
6.62.4: pāṇḍavā hi jayantyeva jīyante caiva māmakāḥ ॥4॥
6.62.5: śroṣyāmi satataṁ tāta duḥsahāni bahūni ca ॥5॥
6.62.6: tamupāyaṁ na paśyāmi jīyeran yena pāṇḍavāḥ,
6.62.7: śr̥ṇu rājan sthiro bhūtvā tavaivāpanayo mahān ॥7॥
6.62.20: te vai sameyuḥ saṅgrāme rājan durmantrite tava ॥20॥
6.62.28: satyavrataṁ ca samare purumitraṁ ca bhārata ॥28॥
6.62.30: tataḥ śalyo mahārāja svasrīyau rathināṁ varau ॥30॥
6.62.31: chādyamānau tatastau tu mādrīputrau na celatuḥ ॥31॥
6.62.36: āpatantaṁ ca taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā gajānīkaṁ vr̥kodaraḥ,
6.62.38: sa gajān gadayā nighnan vyacarat samare balī,
6.62.41: abhyavarṣanta dhāvanto meghā iva girīn yathā ॥41॥
6.62.54: vihvalanto gatā bhūmiṁ śailā iva dharātale ॥54॥
6.62.58: taṁ hi vīraṁ maheṣvāsaṁ saubhadrapramukhā rathāḥ,
6.62.63: yathā paśūnāṁ saṅghātaṁ yaṣṭyā pālaḥ prakālayet,
6.62.65: atiṣṭhat tumule bhīmaḥ śmaśāna iva śūlabhr̥t ॥65॥
6.62.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi caturthadivase bhīmayuddhe dviṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥62॥
6.63.8: sa saṁvārya balaughāṁstān gadayā rathināṁ varaḥ,
6.63.10: na prājahan bhīmasenaṁ bhaye jāte mahābalam ॥10॥
6.63.11: tataḥ śaikyāyasīṁ gurvīṁ pragr̥hya mahatīṁ gadām,
6.63.13: vinighnan vyacarat saṅkhye yugānte kālavad vibhuḥ,
6.63.21: taṁ tathā mahatīṁ senāṁ drāvayantaṁ punaḥ punaḥ,
6.63.22: yato yataḥ prekṣate sma gadāmudyamya pāṇḍavaḥ,
tena tena sma dīryante sarvasainyāni bhārata ॥22॥
6.63.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi sātyakibhūriśravaḥsamāgame triṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥63॥
6.64.1: tato bhūriśravā rājan sātyakiṁ navabhiḥ śaraiḥ,
6.64.4: taṁ caiva pāṇḍavāḥ sarve sātyakiṁ rabhasaṁ raṇe,
6.64.11: saphalaḥ sūta cādyeha yo’haṁ paśyāmi sodarān,
6.64.12: tatra tiṣṭhati saṁnaddhaḥ svayaṁ rājā suyodhanaḥ ॥12॥
6.64.16: taṁ tu duryodhanaḥṣaṣṭyā viddhvā bhīmaṁ mahābalam,
6.64.17: bhīmasya ca raṇe rājan dhanuściccheda bhāsuram,
6.64.18: samare prekṣya yantāraṁ viśokaṁ tu vr̥kodaraḥ,
6.64.31: sr̥kkiṇī vilihan vīraḥ paśumadhye yathā vr̥kaḥ ॥31॥
6.64.34: suṣeṇaṁ ca tato hatvā preṣayāmāsa mr̥tyave,
6.64.40: eṣa bhīmo raṇe kruddho dhārtarāṣṭrān mahārathān ॥40॥
6.64.41: yathā prāgryān yathā jyeṣṭhān yathā śūrāṁśca saṅgatān,
6.64.43: abhyayāt sahasā tatra yatra bhīmo vyavasthitaḥ ॥43॥
6.64.44: adr̥śyaṁ samare cakre jīmūta iva bhāskaram ॥44॥
6.64.46: gajaṁ ca śaravr̥ṣṭyā tu bibhiduste samantataḥ ॥46॥
6.64.50: tasya tat sumahad rūpaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā sarve mahārathāḥ ॥50॥
6.64.53: tāṁstu bhītān samālakṣya bhīmasenaṁ ca mūrcchitam ॥53॥
6.64.54: tato ghaṭotkaco rājan prekṣya bhīmaṁ tathāgatam ॥54॥
6.64.55: sa kr̥tvā dāruṇāṁ māyāṁ bhīrūṇāṁ bhayavardhinīm ॥55॥
6.64.56: airāvaṇaṁ samārūḍhaḥ sa vai māyākr̥taṁ svayam ॥56॥
6.64.59: ghaṭotkacastu svaṁ nāgaṁ codayāmāsa taṁ tadā ॥59॥
6.64.63: tasya taṁ nadato nādaṁ sughoraṁ bhīmaniḥsvanam,
śrutvā bhīṣmo’bravīd droṇaṁ rājānaṁ ca suyodhanam ॥63॥
6.64.67: tatra gacchāma bhadraṁ vo rājānaṁ parirakṣitum,
6.64.68: te tvaradhvaṁ mahāvīryāḥ kiṁ cireṇa prayāmahe,
mahān hi vartate raudraḥ saṅgrāmo lomaharṣaṇaḥ ॥68॥
6.64.70: bhīṣmasya tad vacaḥ śrutvā sarva eva mahārathāḥ,
6.64.73: tasya taṁ ninadaṁ śrutvā dr̥ṣṭvā nāgāṁśca yudhyataḥ ॥73॥
6.64.74: na rocate me saṅgrāmo haiḍimbena durātmanā ॥74॥
6.64.75: naiṣa śakyo yudhā jetumapi vajrabhr̥tā svayam ॥75॥
6.64.76: labdhalakṣyaḥ prahārī ca vayaṁ ca śrāntavāhanāḥ,
6.64.78: pitāmahavacaḥ śrutvā tathā cakruḥ sma kauravāḥ,
6.64.79: siṁhanādān bhr̥śaṁ cakruḥ śaṅkhān dadhmuśca bhārata ॥79॥
6.64.81: kauravāstu tato rājan prayayuḥ śibiraṁ svakam,
6.64.82: yuddhe sumanaso bhūtvā jagmuḥ svaśibiraṁ prati ॥82॥
6.64.87: tataḥ kr̥tvā vidhiṁ sarvaṁ śibirasya yathāvidhi,
6.64.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi caturthadivasāvahāre catuḥṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥64॥
6.65.2: putrāṇāṁ ca parābhāvaṁ śrutvā sañjaya sarvaśaḥ,
cintā me mahatī sūta bhaviṣyati kathaṁ tviti ॥2॥
6.65.3: yathā hi dr̥śyate sarvaṁ daivayogena sañjaya ॥3॥
6.65.5: kena dattavarāstāta kiṁ vā jñānaṁ vidanti te ॥5॥
6.65.6: yena kṣayaṁ na gacchanti divi tārāgaṇā iva,
punaḥ punarna mr̥ṣyāmi hataṁ sainyaṁ tu pāṇḍavaiḥ ॥6॥
6.65.7: yathāvadhyāḥ pāṇḍusutā yathā vadhyāśca me sutāḥ ॥7॥
6.65.8: na hi pāraṁ prapaśyāmi duḥkhasyāsya kathañcana ॥8॥
6.65.9: putrāṇāṁ vyasanaṁ manye dhruvaṁ prāptaṁ sudāruṇam ॥9॥
6.65.10: ghātayiṣyati me sarvān putrān bhīmo na saṁśayaḥ,
na hi paśyāmi taṁ vīraṁ yo me rakṣet sutān raṇe ॥10॥
6.65.11: dhruvaṁ vināśaḥ samprāptaḥ putrāṇāṁ mama sañjaya,
tasmānme kāraṇaṁ sūta śaktiṁ caiva viśeṣataḥ ॥11॥
6.65.12: duryodhanaśca yaccakre dr̥ṣṭvā svān vimukhān raṇe ॥12॥
6.65.16: na vai vibhīṣikāṁ kāñcid rājan kurvanti pāṇḍavāḥ,
6.65.17: ārabhante sadā pārthāḥ prārthayānā mahad yaśaḥ ॥17॥
6.65.18: śriyā paramayā yuktā yato dharmastato jayaḥ ॥18॥
6.65.21: sarvaṁ ca tadanādr̥tya putrāṇāṁ tava kilbiṣam ॥21॥
6.65.22: na caitān bahu manyante putrāstava viśāmpate ॥22॥
6.65.23: sāmprataṁ sumahad ghoraṁ phalaṁ prāptaṁ janeśvara ॥23॥
6.65.24: sa tvaṁ bhuṅkṣva mahārāja saputraḥ sasuhr̥jjanaḥ,
6.65.25: tathā mayā cāpyasakr̥d vāryamāṇo na budhyase ॥25॥
6.65.26: vākyaṁ hitaṁ ca pathyaṁ ca martyāḥ pathyamivauṣadham,
6.65.27: śr̥ṇu bhūyo yathātattvaṁ yanmāṁ tvaṁ paripr̥cchasi,
6.65.29: dr̥ṣṭvā bhrātr̥̄n raṇe sarvān nirjitāṁstu mahārathān,
6.65.31: droṇaśca tvaṁ ca śalyaśca kr̥po droṇistathaiva ca,
6.65.33: trayāṇāmapi lokānāṁ paryāptā iti me matiḥ,
6.65.34: yaṁ samāśritya kaunteyā jayantyasmān kṣaṇe kṣaṇe ॥34॥
6.65.35: śr̥ṇu rājan vaco mahyaṁ yathā vakṣyāmi kaurava,
bahuśaśca mayokto’si na ca me tat tvayā kr̥tam ॥35॥
6.65.36: etat kṣemamahaṁ manye pr̥thivyāstava vā vibho ॥36॥
6.65.37: bhuṅkṣvemāṁ pr̥thivīṁ rājan bhrātr̥bhiḥ sahitaḥ sukhī,
6.65.38: na ca me krośatastāta śrutavānasi vai purā,
6.65.39: taṁ śr̥ṇuṣva mahābāho mama kīrtayataḥ prabho ॥39॥
6.65.40: nāsti lokeṣu tad bhūtaṁ bhavitā no bhaviṣyati,
6.65.41: yat tu me kathitaṁ tāta munibhirbhāvitātmabhiḥ,
6.65.42: purā kila surāḥ sarve r̥ṣayaśca samāgatāḥ,
6.65.44: dhyānenāvedya tad brahmā kr̥tvā ca niyato’ñjalim,
6.65.48: jaya viśva mahādeva jaya lokahite rata,
6.65.59: pādau tava dharā devī diśo bāhū divaṁ śiraḥ,
6.65.60: balaṁ tapaśca satyaṁ ca karma dharmātmakaṁ tava,
6.65.61: aśvinau śravaṇau nityaṁ devī jihvā sarasvatī,
6.65.62: na saṅkhyānaṁ parīmāṇaṁ na tejo na parākramam,
na balaṁ yogayogīśa jānīmaste na sambhavam ॥62॥
6.65.66: tvaṁ gatiḥ sarvabhūtānāṁ tvaṁ netā tvaṁ jagadguruḥ,
6.65.68: jagato dhāraṇārthāya vijñāpyaṁ kuru me vibho ॥68॥
6.65.69: yat tat paramakaṁ guhyaṁ tvatprasādādidaṁ vibho,
6.65.73: dharmaṁ prāpya yaśaḥ prāpya yogaṁ prāpsyasi tattvataḥ ॥73॥
6.65.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi viśvopākhyāne pañcaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥65॥
6.66.4: ko nvayaṁ yo bhagavatā praṇamya vinayād vibho,
vāgbhiḥ stuto variṣṭhābhiḥ śrotumicchāma taṁ vayam ॥4॥
6.66.6: yat tat paraṁ bhaviṣyaṁ ca bhavitavyaṁ ca yatparam,
bhūtātmā ca prabhuścaiva brahma yacca paraṁ padam ॥6॥
6.66.9: ta ime nr̥ṣu sambhūtā ghorarūpā mahābalāḥ ॥9॥
6.66.10: teṣāṁ vadhārthaṁ bhagavān nareṇa sahito vaśī,
6.66.15: etat paramakaṁ brahma etat paramakaṁ yaśaḥ ॥15॥
6.66.16: yat tat puruṣasañjñaṁ vai gīyate jñāyate na ca ॥16॥
6.66.17: etat paramakaṁ teja etat paramakaṁ sukham,
6.66.20: yoginaṁ taṁ mahātmānaṁ praviṣṭaṁ mānuṣīṁ tanum,
6.66.24: evamuktvā sa bhagavān devān sarṣigaṇān purā,
6.66.25: kathāṁ tāṁ brahmaṇā gītāṁ śrutvā prītā divaṁ yayuḥ ॥25॥
6.66.28: etamarthaṁ ca vijñāya śrutvā ca prabhumavyayam,
6.66.29: yasya caivātmajo brahmā sarvasya jagataḥ pitā,
6.66.30: mā gaccha saṁyugaṁ tena vāsudevena dhanvinā ॥30॥
6.66.31: mā pāṇḍavaiḥ sārdhamiti tat tvaṁ mohānna budhyase,
manye tvāṁ rākṣasaṁ krūraṁ tathā cāsi tamovr̥taḥ ॥31॥
6.66.32: yasmād dviṣasi govindaṁ pāṇḍavaṁ taṁ dhanañjayam,
6.66.33: tasmād bravīmi te rājanneṣa vai śāśvato’vyayaḥ,
6.66.35: yataḥ kr̥ṣṇastato dharmo yato dharmastato jayaḥ ॥35॥
6.66.37: śreyoyuktāṁ sadā buddhiṁ pāṇḍavānāṁ dadhāti yaḥ,
balaṁ caiva raṇe nityaṁ bhayebhyaścaiva rakṣati ॥37॥
6.66.38: sa eṣa śāśvato devaḥ sarvaguhyamayaḥ śivaḥ,
vāsudeva iti jñeyo yanmāṁ pr̥cchasi bhārata ॥38॥
6.66.40d1: kr̥ṣṇeti nāmnā vikhyāta imaṁ lokaṁ sa rakṣati,
6.66.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi viśvopākhyāne ṣaṭṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥66॥
6.67.4: sa sr̥ṣṭvā pr̥thivīṁ devīṁ sarvalokeśvaraḥ prabhuḥ ॥4॥
6.67.5: apsu vai śayanaṁ cakre mahātmā puruṣottamaḥ,
sarvatejomayo devo yogāt suṣvāpa tatra ha ॥5॥
6.67.7: eṣa lokān sasarjādau devāṁśca r̥ṣibhiḥ saha,
nidhanaṁ caiva mr̥tyuṁ ca prajānāṁ prabhavāpyayau ॥7॥
6.67.8: eṣa kartā ca kāryaṁ ca pūrvadevaḥ svayamprabhuḥ ॥8॥
6.67.9: ubhe sandhye diśaḥ khaṁ ca niyamāṁśca janārdanaḥ ॥9॥
6.67.13: yo dhārayati bhūtāni dharāṁ cemāṁ saparvatām ॥13॥
6.67.17: eṣa mātā pitā caiva sarveṣāṁ prāṇināṁ hariḥ ॥17॥
6.67.18: paraṁ hi puṇḍarīkākṣānna bhūtaṁ na bhaviṣyati,
6.67.23: sadā naraḥ paṭhaṁścedaṁ svastimān sa sukhī bhavet ॥23॥
6.67.24: ye ca kr̥ṣṇaṁ prapadyante te na muhyanti mānavāḥ,
bhaye mahati magnāṁśca pāti nityaṁ janārdanaḥ ॥24॥
6.67.25: sa taṁ yudhiṣṭhiro jñātvā yāthātathyena bhārata,
6.67.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi viśvopākhyāne saptaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥67॥
6.68.1: śr̥ṇu cedaṁ mahārāja brahmabhūtaṁ stavaṁ mama,
brahmarṣibhiśca devaiśca yaḥ purā kathito bhuvi ॥1॥
6.68.3: bhūtaṁ bhavyaṁ bhaviṣyaṁ ca mārkaṇḍeyo’bhyuvāca ha,
yajñaṁ tvāṁ caiva yajñānāṁ tapaśca tapasāmapi ॥3॥
6.68.4: devānāmapi devaṁ ca tvāmāha bhagavān bhr̥guḥ,
purāṇaṁ caiva paramaṁ viṣṇo rūpaṁ taveti ca ॥4॥
6.68.5: vāsudevo vasūnāṁ tvaṁ śakraṁ sthāpayitā tathā,
6.68.7: avyaktaṁ te śarīrotthaṁ vyaktaṁ te manasi sthitam,
6.68.8: śirasā te divaṁ vyāptaṁ bāhubhyāṁ pr̥thivī tathā,
jaṭharaṁ te trayo lokāḥ puruṣo’si sanātanaḥ ॥8॥
6.68.13: keśavaṁ bahu mene sa pāṇḍavāṁśca mahārathān ॥13॥
6.68.14: māhātmyaṁ te śrutaṁ rājan keśavasya mahātmanaḥ ॥14॥
6.68.15: narasya ca yathātattvaṁ yanmāṁ tvaṁ pr̥cchase nr̥pa,
6.68.16: yathā ca pāṇḍavā rājannavadhyā yudhi kasyacit ॥16॥
6.68.17: prītimān hi dr̥ṛha kr̥ṣṇaḥ pāṇḍaveṣu yaśasviṣu,
tasmād bravīmi rājendra śamo bhavatu pāṇḍavaiḥ ॥17॥
6.68.19: vyasarjayacca rājānaṁ śayanaṁ ca viveśa ha ॥19॥
6.68.20: rājā ca śibiraṁ prāyāt praṇipatya mahātmane,
śiśye ca śayane śubhre rātriṁ tāṁ bharatarṣabha ॥20॥
6.68.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi viśvopākhyāne aṣṭaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥68॥
6.69.2: te sarve sahitā yuddhe samālokya parasparam ॥2॥
6.69.3: vyūhau ca vyūhya saṁrabdhāḥ samprahr̥ṣṭāḥ prahāriṇaḥ ॥3॥
6.69.4d1: śyenavad vyūhya taṁ vyūhaṁ dhaumyasya vacanāt svayam.
6.69.4d2: sa hi tasya suvijñāta agnicityeṣu bhārata,
6.69.7: tān dr̥ṣṭvābhyudyatān saṅkhye pāṇḍavā hi yaśasvinaḥ,
6.69.10: mahātmā drupadaḥ śrīmān saha putreṇa saṁyuge ॥10॥
6.69.13: praviśya tu raṇe bhīmo makaraṁ mukhatastadā,
6.69.17: pūrvaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā vadhaṁ ghoraṁ balasya balināṁ varaḥ ॥17॥
6.69.18: bhrātr̥̄ṇāṁ ca vadhaṁ yuddhe smaramāṇo mahārathaḥ,
ācārya satataṁ hi tvaṁ hitakāmo mamānagha ॥18॥
6.69.19: vayaṁ hi tvāṁ samāśritya bhīṣmaṁ caiva pitāmaham,
devānapi raṇe jetuṁ prārthayāmo na saṁśayaḥ ॥19॥
6.69.20: sa tathā kuru bhadraṁ te yathā vadhyanti pāṇḍavāḥ ॥20॥
6.69.21d1: uvāca tatra rājānaṁ saṅkruddha iva niḥśvasan,
na śakyā hi yathā jetuṁ pāṇḍavā hi mahābalāḥ.
6.69.21d2: yathābalaṁ yathāvīryaṁ karma kuryāmahaṁ hi te,
6.69.23: śaineyaṁ tu raṇe kruddho bhāradvājaḥ pratāpavān,
6.69.25: tato droṇaśca bhīṣmaśca tathā śalyaśca māriṣa,
6.69.30: tato droṇo mahārāja abhyadravata taṁ raṇe,
6.69.31: śikhaṇḍī tu samāsādya droṇaṁ śastrabhr̥tāṁ varam,
6.69.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi pañcama divasayuddhārambhe ekonasaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥69॥
6.70.3: abhavat tumulaḥ śabdaḥ saṁspr̥śan gaganaṁ mahat ॥3॥
6.70.12: prāvartata kurūṇāṁ ca pāṇḍavānāṁ ca bhārata ॥12॥
6.70.20: gadānāṁ parighāṇāṁ ca hastānāṁ corubhiḥ saha ॥20॥
6.70.21: pādānāṁ bhūṣaṇānāṁ ca keyūrāṇāṁ ca saṅghaśaḥ,
6.70.22: saṅghātāḥ sma pradr̥śyante tatra tatra viśāmpate ॥22॥
6.70.23: jaghnuḥ parasparaṁ tatra kṣatriyāḥ kāla āgate ॥23॥
6.70.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi saṅkulayuddhe saptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥70॥
6.71.2: dhvajaṁ ca dr̥ṣṭvā pārthasya sarvān no bhayamāviśat ॥2॥
6.71.8: diśaṁ prācīṁ pratīcīṁ ca na jānīmo’stramohitāḥ ॥8॥
6.71.22: matsyā duryodhanaṁ jagmuḥ śakuniṁ ca viśāmpate,
6.71.34: yugāni paryakarṣanta tatra tatra sma bhārata ॥34॥
6.71.41: ratheṣu ca rathāt yuddhe saṁsaktān varavāraṇāḥ,
6.71.42: teṣāṁ tathā karṣatāṁ tu gajānāṁ rūpamābabhau,
6.71.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi saṅkulayuddhe ekasaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥71॥
6.72.2: droṇaṁ kr̥paṁ vikarṇaṁ ca maheṣvāsaṁ mahābalam,
6.72.3: saindhavaṁ ca maheṣvāsaṁ sāmātyaṁ saha bandhubhiḥ,
6.72.15: yadakurvan raṇe śūrāḥ sr̥ñjayāḥ kurubhiḥ saha ॥15॥
6.72.16: naiva khaṁ na diśo rājan na sūryaṁ śatrutāpana,
6.72.20: virejuḥ samare rājan grahā iva nabhastale ॥20॥
6.72.27: tataḥ sandhāya vai tīkṣṇaṁ śaraṁ paramadāruṇam ॥27॥
6.72.32: te vadhyamānā bhīṣmeṇa pañcālāḥ somakaiḥ saha ॥32॥
6.72.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi pañcamadivasayuddhe dvisaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥72॥
6.73.6: avidhyat phālgunaṁ rājan navatyā niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ,
6.73.7: dīrghamuṣṇaṁ ca niḥśvasya cintayitvā punaḥ punaḥ ॥7॥
6.73.10: tasya te kavacaṁ bhittvā papuḥ śoṇitamāhave,
6.73.12: tasya tat sumahat karma śaśaṁsuḥ kurusattamāḥ,
6.73.16: drauṇiṁ tyaktvā tato yuddhe kaunteyaḥ śvetavāhanaḥ,
6.73.25: satyavrataṁ ca saptatyā viddhvā śakrasamo yudhi,
nr̥tyanniva raṇe vīra ārtiṁ naḥ samajījanat ॥25॥
6.73.27: sa viddho vikṣaran raktaṁ śatrusaṁvāraṇaṁ mahat,
6.73.30: tasya dr̥ṣṭvā tu tat karma parivavruḥ sutāstava,
dahantaṁ samare sainyaṁ vane kakṣaṁ yatholbaṇam ॥30॥
6.73.32: tat tasya caritaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā pautrastava viśāmpate,
6.73.33: vivyādha niśitaiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ sārathiṁ ca tribhiḥ śaraiḥ ॥33॥
6.73.34: tathaiva lakṣmaṇo rājan saubhadraṁ niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ,
6.73.36: śaktiṁ cikṣepa saṅkruddhaḥ saubhadrasya rathaṁ prati ॥36॥
6.73.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi dvandvayuddhe trisaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥73॥
6.74.2: pragāḍhaṁ laghu citraṁ ca darśayan hastalāghavam ॥2॥
6.74.8: sa hi sandr̥śya senāṁ te yuyudhānena pātitām,
6.74.12: taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā yuyudhānasya sutā daśa mahābalāḥ,
6.74.14: ehi yudhyasva saṅgrāme samastaiḥ pr̥thageva vā ॥14॥
6.74.15: asmān vā tvaṁ parājitya yaśaḥ prāpnuhi saṁyuge,
vayaṁ vā tvāṁ parājitya prītiṁ dhāsyāmahe pituḥ ॥15॥
6.74.17: sādhvidaṁ kathyate vīrā yadyevaṁ matiradya vaḥ,
yudhyadhvaṁ sahitā yattā nihaniṣyāmi vo raṇe ॥17॥
6.74.19: ekasya ca bahūnāṁ ca sametānāṁ raṇājire ॥19॥
6.74.23: visr̥jya śaravr̥ṣṭiṁ tāṁ daśa rājan mahārathāḥ,
6.74.26: te hatā nyapatan rājan vajrabhagnā iva drumāḥ,
tān dr̥ṣṭvā nihatān vīro raṇe putrān mahābalān ॥26॥
6.74.29d1: pīḍitau khaḍgaghātābhyāṁ sravad raktau kṣitau bhr̥śam.
6.74.34: samprāpyaiva gatā nāśaṁ śalabhā iva pāvakam ॥34॥
6.74.38: te sene bhr̥śasaṁvigne yayatuḥ svaṁ niveśanam ॥38॥
6.74.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi pañcamadivasāvahāre catuḥsaptatitamodhyāyaḥ ॥74॥
6.75.1: te viśramya tato rājan sahitāḥ kurupāṇḍavāḥ,
6.75.2: tatra śabdo mahānāsīt tava teṣāṁ ca bhārata,
6.75.12: śikhaṇḍī tu maheṣvāsaḥ somakaiḥ saṁvr̥to balī,
6.75.15: vyūḍhaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā tu tat sainyaṁ pitā devavratastava,
6.75.23: tato yuddhāya sañjagmuḥ pāṇḍavāḥ kauravaiḥ saha,
6.75.24: pratīyū rathino nāgā nāgāṁśca rathino yayuḥ,
6.75.28: tavāpi ca babhau senā grahairdyauriva saṁvr̥tā ॥28॥
6.75.32: sa saṅgr̥hya svayaṁ vāhān bhāradvājaḥ pratāpavān,
6.75.33: te vadhyamānā droṇena bhīṣmeṇa ca narottamāḥ,
6.75.35: āsīd vyatikaro ghorastava teṣāṁ ca bhārata ॥35॥
6.75.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi ṣaṣṭhadivasayuddhārambhe pañcasaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥75॥
6.76.3: nātivr̥ddhamabālaṁ ca na kr̥śaṁ na ca pīvaram,
6.76.4: asiyuddhe niyuddhe ca gadāyuddhe ca kovidam ॥4॥
6.76.6: kampaneṣu ca cāpeṣu kaṇapeṣu ca sarvaśaḥ,
6.76.7: aparokṣaṁ ca vidyāsu vyāyāme ca kr̥taśramam,
6.76.8: samyak praharaṇe yāne vyapayāne ca kovidam ॥8॥
6.76.10: na goṣṭhyā nopakāreṇa na ca bandhunimittataḥ,
6.76.20: r̥ṣayo vā mahābhāgāḥ purāṇā bhuvi sañjaya ॥20॥
6.76.24: ukto hi vidureṇāhaṁ hitaṁ pathyaṁ ca nityaśaḥ,
na ca jagrāha tanmandaḥ putro duryodhano mama ॥24॥
6.76.25: tasya manye matiḥ pūrvaṁ sarvajñasya mahātmanaḥ,
āsīd yathāgataṁ tāta yena dr̥ṣṭamidaṁ purā ॥25॥
6.76.26: purā dhātrā yathā sr̥ṣṭaṁ tat tathā naitadanyathā ॥26॥
6.76.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi dhr̥tarāṣṭracintāyāṁ ṣaṭsaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥76॥
6.77.2: tava doṣāt purā vr̥ttaṁ dyūtameva viśāmpate ॥2॥
6.77.3: tava doṣeṇa yuddhaṁ ca pravr̥ttaṁ saha pāṇḍavaiḥ,
6.77.4: iha ca pretya vā rājaṁstvayā prāptaṁ yathātatham ॥4॥
6.77.5: tasmād rājan sthiro bhūtvā prāpyedaṁ vyasanaṁ mahat,
śr̥ṇu yuddhaṁ yathāvr̥ttaṁ śaṁsato me narādhipa ॥5॥
6.77.10: athālokya praviṣṭaṁ tamūcuste sarva eva tu,
6.77.11: sa taiḥ parivr̥taḥ pārtho bhrātr̥bhiḥ kr̥taniścayaiḥ,
6.77.12: samprāpya madhyaṁ sainyasya na bhīḥ pāṇḍavamāviśat,
yathā devāsure yuddhe mahendraṁ prāpya dānavān ॥12॥
6.77.15: samastānāṁ vadhe rājan matiṁ cakre mahāmanāḥ ॥15॥
6.77.20: mama prāṇaiḥ priyatamaḥ kva bhīma iti duḥkhitaḥ ॥20॥
6.77.27: na hi me jīvitenāpi vidyate’dya prayojanam,
6.77.28: yadi yāmi vinā bhīmaṁ kiṁ māṁ kṣatraṁ vadiṣyati,
6.77.30: mama bhīmaḥ sakhā caiva sambandhī ca mahābalaḥ,
6.77.31: so’haṁ tatra gamiṣyāmi yatra yāto vr̥kodaraḥ,
nighnantaṁ māṁ ripūn paśya dānavāniva vāsavam ॥31॥
6.77.32: evamuktvā tato vīro yayau madhyena bhārata,
6.77.33: sa dadarśa tadā bhīmaṁ dahantaṁ ripuvāhinīm,
vāto vr̥kṣāniva balāt prabhañjantaṁ raṇe ripūn ॥33॥
6.77.47: etasminneva kāle tu droṇaḥ śastrabhr̥tāṁ varaḥ,
6.77.49: jitvā tu drupadaṁ droṇaḥ śaṅkhaṁ dadhmau pratāpavān,
6.77.50: atha śuśrāva tejasvī droṇaḥ śastrabhr̥tāṁ varaḥ,
6.77.52: dhr̥ṣṭadyumnaṁ ca bhīmaṁ ca vicarantau mahāraṇe,
6.77.56: pravr̥ttimadhigacchantu na hi śuddhyati me manaḥ,
6.77.57: madhyandinagate sūrye prayayuḥ sarva eva hi ॥57॥
6.77.61: na saṁvārayituṁ śaktā tava senā janādhipa,
6.77.64: nāśaṁsata vadhaṁ vīraḥ putrāṇāṁ tava bhārata ॥64॥
6.77.74: vadhyamānaṁ tu tat sainyaṁ droṇena niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ,
6.77.75: tathā dr̥ṣṭvā ca tatsainyaṁ jahr̥ṣe tāvakaṁ balam,
cukruśuḥ sarvato yodhāḥ sādhu sādhviti bhārata ॥75॥
6.77.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi saṅkulayuddhe droṇaparākrame saptasaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥77॥
6.78.4: sajjaṁ śarāsanaṁ saṅkhye śarairvivyādha te sutam ॥4॥
6.78.8: tau dr̥ṣṭvā samare kruddhau vinighnantau parasparam,
6.78.16: tatyajuḥ samare bhīmaṁ tava putrā mahābalāḥ ॥16॥
6.78.17: tān nāmr̥ṣyata kaunteyo jīvamānā gatā iti,
6.78.18: pārṣatena ca samprekṣya tava sainye mahārathāḥ ॥18॥
6.78.20: tāvakānāṁ ca balināṁ pareṣāṁ caiva bhārata ॥20॥
6.78.31: kurūṇāṁ caiva sainyeṣu pāṇḍavānāṁ ca bhārata ॥31॥
6.78.35: na tatrāsīt pumān kaścid yo yuddhaṁ nābhikāṅkṣati ॥35॥
6.78.36: evaṁ yuyudhire vīrāḥ prārthayānā mahad yaśaḥ,
6.78.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi saṅkulayuddhe aṣṭasaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥78॥
6.79.3: adya tvāṁ nihaniṣyāmi yadi notsr̥jase raṇam ॥3॥
6.79.4: adya kuntyāḥ parikleśaṁ vanavāsaṁ ca kr̥tsnaśaḥ,
6.79.6: karṇasya matamāsthāya saubalasya ca yat purā,
6.79.7: ulūkasya samādeśaṁ yad dadāsi ca hr̥ṣṭavat ॥7॥
6.79.8: samīkariṣye tat pāpaṁ yat purā kr̥tavānasi ॥8॥
6.79.11: tato’sya kārmukaṁ dvābhyāṁ sūtaṁ dvābhyāṁ ca vivyadhe,
6.79.13: chittvā taṁ ca nanādoccaistava putrasya paśyataḥ ॥13॥
6.79.17: tataḥ sa rājā sindhūnāṁ rathaśreṣṭho mahārathaḥ,
6.79.31: bhittvā dehaṁ gatā bhūmiṁ jvalanta iva pannagāḥ ॥31॥
6.79.37: sa hatāśve rathe tiṣṭhan śrutakarmā mahārathaḥ,
6.79.38: sā durmukhasya vimalaṁ varma bhittvā yaśasvinaḥ,
6.79.39: taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā virathaṁ tatra sutasomo mahārathaḥ,
6.79.49: tato’sya dhanurekena dvābhyāṁ sūtaṁ ca māriṣa,
ciccheda samare tūrṇaṁ taṁ ca vivyādha saptabhiḥ ॥49॥
6.79.51: duṣkarṇaṁ sudr̥ḍhaṁ kruddho vivyādha hr̥daye bhr̥śam ॥51॥
6.79.52: sa papāta tato bhūmau vajrāhata iva drumaḥ,
duṣkarṇaṁ vyathitaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā pañca rājan mahārathāḥ ॥52॥
6.79.58: viviśuste paraṁ sainyaṁ siṁhā iva vanād vanam ॥58॥
6.79.64d1: hatvā vidrāvya ca śaraiḥ śibirāyaiva jagmatuḥ.
6.79.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi ṣaṣṭhadivasāvahāre ekonāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥79॥
6.80.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi bhīṣmaduryodhanasaṁvāde aśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥80॥
6.81.2: ahaṁ droṇaśca śalyaśca kr̥tavarmā ca sātvataḥ,
6.81.7: devānapi raṇe jetuṁ samarthā iti me matiḥ ॥7॥
6.81.8: avaśyaṁ hi mayā rājaṁstava vācyaṁ hitaṁ sadā,
6.81.9: sarvathāhaṁ tu rājendra kariṣye vacanaṁ tava ॥9॥
6.81.10: pāṇḍavāṁśca raṇe jeṣye māṁ vā jeṣyanti pāṇḍavāḥ,
6.81.11: tataḥ prabhāte vimale svena sainyena vīryavān ॥11॥
6.81.14: nāge nāge rathāḥ sapta sapta cāśvā rathe rathe ॥14॥
6.81.15: anvaśvaṁ daśa dhānuṣkā dhānuṣke daśa carmiṇaḥ,
evaṁ vyūḍhaṁ mahārāja tava sainyaṁ mahārathaiḥ ॥15॥
6.81.16: sthitaṁ raṇāya mahate bhīṣmeṇa yudhi pālitam,
daśāśvānāṁ sahasrāṇi dantināṁ ca tathaiva ca ॥16॥
6.81.18: rakṣyamāṇaḥ sa taiḥ śūrairgopyamānāśca tena te,
6.81.20: tataḥ śabdo mahānāsīt putrāṇāṁ tava bhārata,
6.81.28: citrasenaṁ vikarṇaṁ ca tathā durmarṣaṇaṁ vibhuḥ ॥28॥
6.81.37: ya ime māṁ yaduśreṣṭha yoddhukāmā raṇājire ॥37॥
6.81.44: dvābhyāṁ tribhiḥ śaraiścānyān pārtho vivyādha māriṣa ॥44॥
6.81.45: te hanyamānāḥ pārthena bhīṣmaṁ śāntanavaṁ yayuḥ,
6.81.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi saptamayuddhadivase ekāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥81॥
6.82.1: tathā pravr̥tte saṅgrāme nivr̥tte ca suśarmaṇi,
6.82.2: pratyudyāte ca gāṅgeye tvaritaṁ vijayaṁ prati ॥2॥
6.82.3: dr̥ṣṭvā duryodhano rājā raṇe pārthasya vikramam,
6.82.4: teṣāṁ tu pramukhe śūṁra suśarmāṇaṁ mahābalam,
6.82.6: taṁ prayāntaṁ raṇe vīraṁ sarvasainyena bhāratam,
6.82.10: abhavat tumulo nādo bhayād dr̥ṣṭvā kirīṭinam ॥10॥
6.82.12: na śekuḥ pāṇḍavā draṣṭuṁ śvetaṁ grahamivoditam ॥12॥
6.82.19: āruroha rathaṁ tūrṇaṁ putrasya rathināṁ varaḥ ॥19॥
6.82.20: tatastu tau pitāputrau bhāradvājaṁ rathe sthitau,
6.82.21: cikṣepa samare tūrṇaṁ śaṅgaṁ prati janeśvara ॥21॥
6.82.22: sa tasya hr̥dayaṁ bhittvā pītvā śoṇitamāhave,
6.82.24: hataṁ tamātmajaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā virāṭaḥ prādravad bhayāt,
6.82.29: sa hatāśvādavaplutya rathād vai rathināṁ varaḥ ॥29॥
6.82.35: śitaistu bahuśo rājaṁstaṁ ca vivyādha pattribhiḥ,
śikhaṇḍī tu tataḥ khaḍgaṁ khaṇḍitaṁ tena sāyakaiḥ ॥35॥
6.82.38: śikhaṇḍī tu bhr̥śaṁ rājaṁstāḍyamānaḥ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ,
6.82.40: ardhacandreṇa samare taṁ ca vivyādha sāyakaiḥ ॥40॥
6.82.43: tadastraṁ bhasmasāt kr̥tvā māyāṁ tāṁ rākṣasīṁ tadā ॥43॥
6.82.45: tat tathā pīḍitaṁ tena mādhavena yaśasvinā,
6.82.50: vivyathe na ca rājendra tava putro janeśvara,
dhr̥ṣṭadyumnaṁ ca samare tūrṇaṁ vivyādha patribhiḥ ॥50॥
6.82.56: pracchādayāmāsa ca taṁ mahāmegho raviṁ yathā ॥56॥
6.82.61: śyālasya te mahārāja tava putrasya paśyataḥ ॥61॥
6.82.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi dvairathe dvyaśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥82॥
6.83.1: bahūni hi vicitrāṇi dvairathāni sma sañjaya,
6.83.2: na caiva māpakaṁ kiñciddhr̥ṣṭaṁ śaṁsasi sañjaya,
6.83.5: gaṅgāyāḥ suranadyā vai svādu bhūtvā yathodakam,
6.83.6: prāpya pāṇḍusutān vīrān vyarthaṁ bhavati saṁyuge ॥6॥
6.83.9: na hi rakṣanti rājānaḥ sarvathātrāpi jīvitam ॥9॥
6.83.15: yudhyatāṁ hi tathā rājan viśeṣo na vyadr̥śyata,
6.83.17: bhallābhyāṁ ca sutīkṣṇābhyāṁ dhanuḥ ketuṁ ca māriṣa,
6.83.21: irāvāṁstu raṇe kruddho bhrātarau tau mahārathau,
6.83.22: tasmiṁstu patite bhūmau gatasattve tu sārathau,
6.83.31: nivr̥tteṣu tu pāṇḍūnāṁ punaḥ sainyeṣu bhārata,
6.83.33: nihatya tān śarān rājā rākṣasasya dhanuścutān,
6.83.38: sa hatāśve rathe tiṣṭhan rākṣasendraḥ pratāpavān,
6.83.39: tridhā ciccheda nr̥patiḥ sā vyakīryata medinīm ॥39॥
6.83.40: śaktiṁ vinihatāṁ dr̥ṣṭvā haiḍimbaḥ prādravad bhayāt,
6.83.41: taṁ vijitya raṇe śūraṁ vikrāntaṁ khyātapauruṣam,
ajeyaṁ samare vīraṁ yamena varuṇena ca ॥41॥
6.83.42: pāṇḍavīṁ samare senāṁ sammamarda sa kuñjaraḥ,
6.83.46d2: nijaghāna raṇe taṁ tu sūtaṁ cāsya nyapātayat.
6.83.48: ekasthau tu raṇe śūrau dr̥ḍhe vikṣipya kārmukau ॥48॥
6.83.50: prahasanniva tāṁ cāpi śastravr̥ṣṭiṁ jaghāna ha ॥50॥
6.83.53: niṣasāda mahārāja kaśmalaṁ ca jagāma ha ॥53॥
6.83.54: taṁ visañjñaṁ nipatitaṁ sūtaḥ samprekṣya saṁyuge,
6.83.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi dvandvayuddhe tryaśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥83॥
6.84.1: tato yudhiṣṭhiro rājā madhyaṁ prāpte divākare,
6.84.3: sa saṁvārya raṇe rājā preṣitān dharmasūnunā,
6.84.4: te tasya kavacaṁ bhittvā papuḥ śoṇitamāhave,
6.84.6: rathaśreṣṭho rathāt tūrṇaṁ bhūmau pārtho nyapātayat ॥6॥
6.84.7: ketuṁ vipatitaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā śrutāyuḥ sa tu pārthivaḥ,
6.84.11: lokānāṁ nr̥pa śāntyarthaṁ krodhite pāṇḍave tadā ॥11॥
6.84.14: sa tu dhairyeṇa taṁ kopaṁ saṁnivārya mahāyaśāḥ,
6.84.16: satvaraṁ ca raṇe rājaṁstasya vāhān mahātmanaḥ,
nijaghāna śaraiḥ kṣipraṁ sūtaṁ ca sumahābalaḥ ॥16॥
6.84.17: hatāśvaṁ tu rathaṁ tyaktvā dr̥ṣṭvā rājño’sya pauruṣam,
6.84.19: vyāttānano yathā kālastava sainyaṁ jaghāna ha ॥19॥
6.84.21: cekitānaṁ raṇe yattaṁ rājan vivyādha patribhiḥ ॥21॥
6.84.23: so’vaplutya rathāt tūrṇaṁ gadāṁ jagrāha sātvataḥ ॥23॥
6.84.24: sa tayā vīraghātinyā gadayā gadināṁ varaḥ,
gautamasya hayān hatvā sārathiṁ ca nyapātayat ॥24॥
6.84.34: āropayad rathaṁ tūrṇaṁ gautamaṁ rathināṁ varam ॥34॥
6.84.35: navatyā sāyakaiḥ kṣipraṁ rājan vivyādha vakṣasi ॥35॥
6.84.46: ete hi bahavaḥ śūrāḥ kr̥tāstrā yuddhadurmadāḥ,
yathā hanyurna naḥ senāṁ tathā mādhava codaya ॥46॥
6.84.52: na cainamabravīt kiñcicchubhaṁ vā yadi vāśubham ॥52॥
6.84.55: tāvakānāṁ ca samare pāṇḍavānāṁ ca bhārata ॥55॥
6.84.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi saptamayuddhadivase suśarmārjunasamāgame caturaśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥84॥
6.85.1: padā hato nāga iva śvasan balī,
6.85.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi saptamayuddhadivase pañcāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥85॥
6.86.11: taṁ tu chittvā raṇe bhīṣmo nārācaṁ kālasammitam,
6.86.11d1: hatāśve tu rathe tiṣṭhan śaktiṁ cikṣepa dharmarāṭ,
6.86.12: hatāśvaṁ tu rathaṁ tyaktvā dharmaputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ,
6.86.13: yamāvapi hi saṅkruddhaḥ samāsādya raṇe tadā,
6.86.16: tataste pārthivāḥ sarve śrutvā pārthasya bhāṣitam,
6.86.18: taṁ carantaṁ raṇe pārthā dadr̥śuḥ kauravaṁ yudhi,
6.86.26: prayayau sr̥ñjayān kruddhaḥ strītvaṁ cintya śikhaṇḍinaḥ ॥26॥
6.86.27: sr̥ñjayāstu tato dr̥ṣṭvā hr̥ṣṭaṁ bhīṣmaṁ mahāraṇe,
6.86.31: āryāṁ yuddhe matiṁ kr̥tvā na tyajanti sma saṁyugam,
6.86.33: taṁ śrutvā ninadaṁ ghoraṁ tāvakānāṁ mahārathau,
6.86.34: tau tasya turagān hatvā tvaramāṇau mahārathau,
6.86.36: tato yudhiṣṭhiro rājā mahatyā senayā vr̥taḥ,
6.86.39: droṇastu samare kruddhaḥ putrasya priyakr̥t tava,
6.86.40: parivārya raṇe bhīṣmaṁ yuyudhuḥ pāṇḍavaiḥ saha ॥40॥
6.86.42: yudhyatāṁ tu tathā teṣāṁ kurvatāṁ karma duṣkaram,
6.86.47: yayau svaśibiraṁ rājā niśāyāṁ senayā vr̥taḥ ॥47॥
6.86.48: avajitya tataḥ saṅkhye yayau svaśibiraṁ prati ॥48॥
6.86.49: bhīṣmaṁ śāntanavaṁ tūrṇaṁ prayātaḥ śibiraṁ prati ॥49॥
6.86.50: doṇo drauṇiḥ kr̥paḥ śalyaḥ kr̥tavarmā ca sātvataḥ,
parivārya camūṁ sarvāṁ prayayuḥ śibiraṁ prati ॥50॥
6.86.51: parivārya raṇe yodhān yayatuḥ śibiraṁ prati ॥51॥
6.86.54: rakṣāṁ kr̥tvā tataḥ śūrānyasya gulmān yathāvidhi,
apanīya ca śalyāni snātvā ca vividhairjalaiḥ ॥54॥
6.86.56: na hi yuddhakathāṁ kāñcit tatrākurvan mahārathāḥ ॥56॥
6.86.57: te prasupte bale tatra pariśrāntajane nr̥pa,
6.86.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi saptamadivasayuddhāvahāre ṣaḍaśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥86॥
6.87.1: pariṇāmya niśāṁ tāṁ tu sukhaṁ prāptā janeśvarāḥ,
6.87.3: bhīṣmaśca rathināṁ śreṣṭho bhāradvājaśca vai nr̥pa ॥3॥
6.87.4: vyūhāya vidadhū rājan pāṇḍavān prati daṁśitāḥ ॥4॥
6.87.5: bhīṣmaḥ kr̥tvā mahāvyūhaṁ pitā tava viśāmpate,
6.87.15: taṁ tu dr̥ṣṭvā mahāvyūhaṁ tāvakānāṁ mahārathaḥ,
6.87.16: prativyūhaṁ tvamapi hi kuru pārṣata satvaram ॥16॥
6.87.17: tataḥ sa pārṣataḥ krūro vyūhaṁ cakre sudāruṇam,
6.87.19: madhye yudhiṣṭhiro rājā mādrīputrau ca pāṇḍavau ॥19॥
6.87.24: tataḥ śūrāḥ samāsādya samare te parasparam,
6.87.27: nārācā niśitāḥ saṅkhye sampatanti sma bhārata,
6.87.40: tataḥ pravavr̥te yuddhaṁ tava teṣāṁ ca bhārata,
6.87.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi aṣṭamadivasayuddhārambhe saptāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥87॥
6.88.1: bhīṣmaṁ tu samare kruddhaṁ pratapantaṁ samantataḥ,
na śekuḥ pāṇḍavā draṣṭuṁ tapantamiva bhāskaram ॥1॥
6.88.3: sa tu bhīṣmo raṇaślāghī somakān sahasr̥ñjayān,
6.88.4: te vadhyamānā bhīṣmeṇa pañcālāḥ somakaiḥ saha,
6.88.5: sa teṣāṁ rathināṁ vīro bhīṣmaḥ śāntanavo yudhi,
ciccheda sahasā rājan bāhūnatha śirāṁsi ca ॥5॥
6.88.8: na tatrāsīt pumān kaścit pāṇḍavānāṁ viśāmpate,
6.88.9: sa hi bhīṣmaṁ samāsādya tāḍayāmāsa saṁyuge,
6.88.12: bhīmastu sārathiṁ hatvā bhīṣmasya rathināṁ varaḥ,
6.88.13: kṣurapreṇa sutīkṣṇena sa hato nyapatad bhuvi ॥13॥
6.88.14: hate tasmin mahārāja tava putre mahārathe,
nāmr̥ṣyanta raṇe śūrāḥ sodarāḥ sapta saṁyuge ॥14॥
6.88.25: sa śaraḥ paṇḍitaṁ hatvā viveśa dharaṇītalam,
6.88.27: vivyādha samare rājan sa hato nyapatad bhuvi ॥27॥
6.88.28: ādityaketoḥ ketuṁ ca chittvā bāṇena saṁyuge,
6.88.30: manyamānā hi tat satyaṁ sabhāyāṁ tasya bhāṣitam ॥30॥
6.88.31: abavīt tāvakān yodhān bhīmo’yaṁ yudhi vadhyatām ॥31॥
6.88.32: bhrātr̥̄n sandr̥śya nihatān prāsmaraṁste hi tad vacaḥ ॥32॥
