6.88.34: na budhyase purā yat tat tathyamuktaṁ vaco mahat ॥34॥
6.88.35: tathaiva ca vadhārthāya putrāṇāṁ pāṇḍavo balī,
nūnaṁ jāto mahābāhuryathā hanti sma kauravān ॥35॥
6.88.37: nihatā bhrātaraḥ śūrā bhīmasenena me yudhi,
6.88.40: gāndhāryā ca yaśasvinyā tat tvaṁ tāta na buddhavān ॥40॥
6.88.41: samayaśca mayā pūrvaṁ kr̥to vai śatrukarśana,
6.88.42: yaṁ yaṁ hi dhārtarāṣṭrāṇāṁ bhīmo drakṣyati saṁyuge,
haniṣyati raṇe nityaṁ satyametad bravīmi te ॥42॥
6.88.43: sa tvaṁ rājan sthiro bhūtvā raṇe kr̥tvā dr̥ḍhāṁ matim,
yodhayasva raṇe pārthān svargaṁ kr̥tvā parāyaṇam ॥43॥
6.88.44: na śakyāḥ pāṇḍavā jetuṁ sendrairapi surāsuraiḥ,
tasmād yuddhe sthirāṁ kr̥tvā matiṁ yuddhyasva bhārata ॥44॥
6.88.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi sunābhādidhr̥tarāṣṭraputravadhe aṣṭāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥88॥
6.89.1: dr̥ṣṭvā me nihatān putrān bahūnekena sañjaya,
6.89.2: ahanyahani me putrāḥ kṣayaṁ gacchanti sañjaya,
6.89.3: yatra me tanayāḥ sarve jīyante na jayantyuta,
yatra bhīṣmasya droṇasya kr̥pasya ca mahātmanaḥ ॥3॥
6.89.6: na hi duryodhano mandaḥ purā proktamabudhyata,
vāryamāṇo mayā tāta bhīṣmeṇa vidureṇa ca ॥6॥
6.89.7: nābudhyata purā mohāt tasya prāptamidaṁ phalam ॥7॥
6.89.8: yad bhīmasenaḥ samare putrān mama vicetasaḥ,
6.89.9: na buddhavānasi vibho procyamānaṁ hitaṁ tadā ॥9॥
6.89.10: nivāraya sutān dyūtāt pāṇḍavān mā druheti ca,
suhr̥dāṁ hitakāmānāṁ bruvatāṁ tat tadeva ca ॥10॥
6.89.11: na śuśrūṣasi tad vākyaṁ martyaḥ pathyamivauṣadham,
6.89.12: akr̥tvā vacanaṁ pathyaṁ kṣayaṁ gacchanti kauravāḥ ॥12॥
6.89.13: tasmāt tvaṁ śr̥ṇu tattvena yathā yuddhamavartata ॥13॥
6.89.22: droṇastu rathinaḥ śreṣṭhān somakān sr̥ñjayaiḥ saha,
6.89.25: kūjatāṁ krandatāṁ caiva stanatāṁ caiva bhārata,
6.89.26: cakāra kadanaṁ ghoraṁ kruddhaḥ kāla ivāparaḥ ॥26॥
6.89.29: tato bhīmo raṇe kruddho rabhasaśca viśeṣataḥ,
6.89.35: arjunena hataiḥ saṅkhye tathā bhārata rājabhiḥ,
prababhau vasudhā ghorā tatra tatra viśāmpate ॥35॥
6.89.39: kruddhe śāntanave bhīṣme droṇe ca rathasattame ॥39॥
6.89.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi aṣṭamadivasayuddhe ekonanavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥89॥
6.90.9: bhāryārthaṁ tāṁ ca jagrāha pārthaḥ kāmavaśānugām,
6.90.10: sa nāgaloke saṁvr̥ddho mātrā ca parirakṣitaḥ,
6.90.13: irāvānasmi bhadraṁ te putraścāhaṁ tava prabho ॥13॥
6.90.14: mātuḥ samāgamo yaśca tat sarvaṁ pratyavedayat,
6.90.15: pariṣvajya sutaṁ cāpi ātmanaḥ sadr̥śaṁ guṇaiḥ,
6.90.19: utpetuḥ sahasā rājan haṁsā iva mahodadhau,
6.90.25: tataḥ kṣīṇe hayānīke kiñciccheṣe ca bhārata,
6.90.37: purato’pi ca pr̥ṣṭhe ca pārśvayośca bhr̥śāhataḥ,
eko bahubhiratyarthaṁ dhairyād rājan na vivyathe ॥37॥
6.90.40: vikr̥ṣya ca śitaṁ khaḍgaṁ gr̥hītvā ca śarāvaram,
6.90.44: bhūmiṣṭhamatha taṁ saṅkhye sampradr̥śya tataḥ punaḥ,
6.90.48: tān sarvān patitān dr̥ṣṭvā bhīto duryodhanastataḥ,
6.90.50: paśya vīra yathā hyeṣa phālgunasya suto balī,
6.90.51: tvaṁ ca kāmagamastāta māyāstre ca viśāradaḥ,
6.90.57: tena māyāmayāḥ sr̥ṣṭā hayāstāvanta eva hi,
6.90.61: ciccheda kārmukaṁ dīptaṁ śarāvāpaṁ ca satvaram ॥61॥
6.90.62: sa nikr̥ttaṁ dhanurdr̥ṣṭvā khaṁ javena samāviśat,
6.90.64: tathā sa rākṣasaśreṣṭhaḥ śaraiḥ kr̥ttaḥ punaḥ punaḥ ॥64॥
6.90.65: māyā hi sahajā teṣāṁ vayo rūpaṁ ca kāmajam ॥65॥
6.90.66: evaṁ tad rākṣasasyāṅgaṁ chinnaṁ chinnaṁ babhūva ha,
6.90.67: paraśvadhena tīkṣṇena ciccheda ca punaḥ punaḥ,
6.90.71: tāṁ dr̥ṣṭvā tādr̥śīṁ māyāṁ rākṣasasya durātmanaḥ ॥71॥
6.90.79: tasmin mahati saṅgrāme tādr̥śe bhairave punaḥ,
6.90.86: tena yaudhiṣṭhire sainye bahavo mānavā hatāḥ,
6.90.87: tatra bhārata bhīṣmasya raṇe dr̥ṣṭvā parākramam,
6.90.88: raudramāsīd raṇe yuddhaṁ sātyakasya ca dhanvinaḥ ॥88॥
6.90.89: eka eva raṇe śakto nihantuṁ sarvasainikān ॥89॥
6.90.93: na sma paśyāmahe kañcit prāṇān yaḥ parirakṣati,
6.90.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi irāvadvadhe navatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥90॥
6.91.1: irāvantaṁ tu nihataṁ dr̥ṣṭvā pārthā mahārathāḥ,
6.91.2: irāvantaṁ tu nihataṁ saṅgrāme vīkṣya rākṣasaḥ,
6.91.4: taṁ śrutvā sumahānādaṁ tava sainyasya bhārata ॥4॥
6.91.5: ūrustambhaḥ samabhavad vepathuḥ sveda eva ca,
6.91.9: svabalaṁ ca bhayāt tasya prāyaśo vimukhīkr̥tam,
6.91.10: pragr̥hya vipulaṁ cāpaṁ siṁhavad vinadan muhuḥ,
6.91.12: putraṁ tava mahārāja cukopa sa niśācaraḥ,
6.91.14: nadanto vividhān nādān meghā iva savidyutaḥ ॥14॥
6.91.22: tat tu dr̥ṣṭvā mahat karma putrasya tava māriṣa ॥22॥
6.91.30: evamuktvā tu haiḍimbo mahad visphārya kārmukam ॥30॥
6.91.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi haiḍimbayuddhe ekanavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥91॥
6.92.1: dadhāra yudhi rājendro yathā varṣaṁ mahādvipaḥ ॥1॥
6.92.4: sa tairviddhaḥ sravan raktaṁ prabhinna iva kuñjaraḥ ॥4॥
6.92.5: dadhre matiṁ vināśāya rājñaḥ sa piśitāśanaḥ,
6.92.9: rathaṁ ca vārayāmāsa kuñjareṇa sutasya te,
6.92.13: prabhagnaṁ ca balaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā jagāma paramāṁ vyathām ॥13॥
6.92.13d1: aśaktaḥ pratiyoddhuṁ vai dr̥ṣṭvā tasya parākramam,
6.92.18: taṁ śrutvā ninadaṁ ghoraṁ tasya bhīmasya rakṣasaḥ,
6.92.19: haiḍimbo yudhyate nūnaṁ rājñā duryodhanena ha ॥19॥
6.92.20: naiṣa śakyo hi saṅgrāme jetuṁ bhūtena kenacit,
tatra gacchata bhadraṁ vo rājānaṁ parirakṣata ॥20॥
6.92.21: etaddhi vaḥ paraṁ kr̥tyaṁ sarveṣāṁ naḥ parantapāḥ ॥21॥
6.92.36: tataḥ punarameyātmā nārācān daśa pañca ca ॥36॥
6.92.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi haiḍimbayuddhe dvinavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥92॥
6.93.7: rākṣasasya tu taṁ śabdaṁ śrutvā rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ,
6.93.8: yathāsya śrūyate śabdo nadato bhairavaṁ svanam ॥8॥
6.93.10: teṣāṁ ca rakṣaṇārthāya yudhyate phālgunaḥ paraiḥ,
6.93.11: gaccha rakṣasva haiḍimbaṁ saṁśayaṁ paramaṁ gatam,
6.93.18: teṣāmāpatatāṁ śrutvā śabdaṁ taṁ tāvakaṁ balam,
6.93.19: tataḥ pravavr̥te yuddhaṁ tatra teṣāṁ mahātmanām ॥19॥
6.93.22: hayā gajaiḥ samājagmuḥ pādātā rathibhiḥ saha,
6.93.24: naiva sve na pare rājan samajānam parasparam ॥24॥
6.93.25: pitā putraṁ na jānīte putro vā pitaraṁ tathā,
6.93.28: narāṇāṁ caiva kāyebhyaḥ śirasāṁ patatāṁ raṇe,
6.93.39: rathān hayān padātīṁśca mamr̥duḥ śataśo raṇe ॥39॥
6.93.42: prārthayānā yaśo rājan svargaṁ vā yuddhaśālinaḥ ॥42॥
6.93.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi saṅkulayuddhe trinavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥13॥
6.94.1: svasainyaṁ nihataṁ dr̥ṣṭvā rājā duryodhanaḥ svayam,
6.94.9: kṣipraṁ gacchata bhadraṁ vo rājānaṁ parirakṣata ॥9॥
6.94.20: guruṁ pravyathitaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā rājā duryodhanaḥ svayam,
6.94.27: taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā saṁśayaṁ prāptaṁ pīḍyamānaṁ mahāratham ॥27॥
6.94.30: spardhate hi maheṣvāso nityaṁ droṇasutena saḥ,
sa visphārya mahaccāpaṁ drauṇiṁ vivyādha patriṇā ॥30॥
6.94.31: yathā śakro mahārāja purā vivyādha dānavam,
6.94.32: yena lokatrayaṁ krodhāt trāsitaṁ svena tejasā,
6.94.35: jaghāna caturo vāhān sārathiṁ dhvajameva ca,
saptamena ca bhallena nīlaṁ vivyādha vakṣasi ॥35॥
6.94.44: prāyaśaśca maheṣvāsā ye pradhānāḥ sma kauravāḥ ॥44॥
6.94.46: tad dr̥ṣṭvā tāvakaṁ sainyaṁ vidrutaṁ śibiraṁ prati,
6.94.47: yudhyadhvaṁ mā palāyadhvaṁ māyaiṣā rākṣasī raṇe,
6.94.48: tāṁśca pradravato dr̥ṣṭvā jayaṁ prāptāśca pāṇḍavāḥ ॥48॥
6.94.50: evaṁ tava balaṁ sarvaṁ haiḍimbena durātmanā,
6.94.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi aṣṭamayuddhadivase ghaṭotkacayuddhe caturnavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥94॥
6.95.5: nideśe tava tiṣṭhanti mayā sārdhaṁ parantapa ॥5॥
6.95.8: tvāṁ samāśritya durdharṣaṁ tanme kartuṁ tvamarhasi ॥8॥
6.95.10: śr̥ṇu rājan mama vaco yat tvāṁ vakṣyāmi kaurava,
6.95.12: arjunena yamābhyāṁ vā bhīmasenena vā punaḥ,
6.95.12d1: na tu kāryastvayā rājan haiḍimbena durātmanā.
6.95.13: ahaṁ droṇaḥ kr̥po drauṇiḥ kr̥tavarmā ca sātvataḥ,
6.95.15: raudre tasmin rākṣasendre yadi te’nuśayo mahān,
ayaṁ vā gacchatu raṇe tasya yuddhāya durmateḥ ॥15॥
6.95.26: te nipeturmahārāja nāgeṣu ca ratheṣu ca ॥26॥
6.95.37: tān dr̥ṣṭvā nihatān kruddho bhagadattaḥ pratāpavān,
6.95.38: sa nāgaḥ preṣitastena bāṇo jyācodito yathā,
6.95.44: tamāpatantaṁ samare gajaṁ gajapatiḥ sa ca ॥44॥
6.95.49: sa pradudrāva vegena praṇadan bhairavaṁ ravam ॥49॥
6.95.52: kiranto vividhān bāṇān śastrāṇi vividhāni ca,
6.95.56: tena saṁloḍyamānaṁ tu pāṇḍavānāṁ balaṁ mahat ॥56॥
6.95.57: bhagnaṁ tu svabalaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā bhagadattena dhīmatā ॥57॥
6.95.60: nāgaṁ jighāṁsuḥ sahasā cikṣepa ca mahābalaḥ,
6.95.63: śūlaṁ nipatitaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā dvidhā kr̥ttaṁ ca pārthivaḥ ॥63॥
6.95.64: cikṣepa tāṁ rākṣasasya tiṣṭha tiṣṭheti cābravīt ॥64॥
6.95.65: utpatya rākṣasastūrṇaṁ jagrāha ca nanāda ca ॥65॥
6.95.69: taṁ tu śrutvā mahānādaṁ prahr̥ṣṭānāṁ mahātmanām,
6.95.81: dr̥ṣṭvā ca pāṇḍavo bhrātr̥̄n yudhyamānān mahārathān,
6.95.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi bhagadattayuddhe pañcanavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥95॥
6.96.2: idaṁ nūnaṁ mahāprājño viduro dr̥ṣṭavān purā ॥2॥
6.96.3: kurūṇāṁ pāṇḍavānāṁ ca kṣayaṁ ghoraṁ mahāmatiḥ,
6.96.4: anye ca bahavo vīrāḥ saṅgrāme madhusūdana,
6.96.6: adhanasya mr̥taṁ śreyo na ca jñātivadhād dhanam,
kiṁ nu prāpsyāmahe kr̥ṣṇa hatvā jñātīn samāgatān ॥6॥
6.96.8: kr̥taṁ rājñā mahābāho yācatā ca suyodhanam ॥8॥
6.96.9: rājyārdhaṁ pañca vā grāmān nākārṣīt sa ca durmatiḥ,
dr̥ṣṭvā hi kṣatriyān śūrān śayānān dharaṇītale ॥9॥
6.96.11: yuddhaṁ tu me na rucitaṁ jñātibhirmadhusūdana,
6.96.12: nāyaṁ yāpayituṁ kālo vidyate mādhava kvacit ॥12॥
6.96.14: atha śabdo mahānāsīt tava sainyasya bhārata,
6.96.16: parivārya raṇe droṇaṁ vasavo vāsavaṁ yathā ॥16॥
6.96.17: tataḥ śāntanavo bhīṣmaḥ kr̥paśca rathināṁ varaḥ,
6.96.22: sr̥kkiṇī saṁlihan vīraḥ śārdūla iva darpitaḥ ॥22॥
6.96.24: apareṇa tu bhallena pītena niśitena tu,
6.96.25: sasarja tvarayā yuktaḥ putrāṁste prāpya māriṣa ॥25॥
6.96.32: yathā govr̥ṣabho varṣaṁ sandhārayati khāt patat,
6.96.33: adbhutaṁ ca mahārāja tatra cakre vr̥kodaraḥ,
yat putrāṁste’vadhīt saṅkhye droṇaṁ caiva nyavārayat ॥33॥
6.96.35: yathā hi paśumadhyastho dārayeta paśūn vr̥kaḥ,
6.96.42: vyaṁsitaṁ vīkṣya nistriṁśaṁ saubhadreṇa raṇe tadā,
6.96.44: tatrākrando mahānāsīt tava teṣāṁ ca bhārata,
6.96.45: anyonyaṁ hi raṇe śūrāḥ keśeṣvākṣipya māninaḥ,
6.96.47: nyahanacca pitā putraṁ putraśca pitaraṁ tathā,
6.96.78: parasparaṁ samāsādya tava teṣāṁ ca saṁyuge,
teṣu śrānteṣu bhagneṣu mr̥diteṣu ca bhārata ॥78॥
6.96.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi aṣṭamadivasayuddhāvahāre ṣaṇṇavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥96॥
6.97.2: kathaṁ pāṇḍusutāḥ saṅkhye jetavyāḥ sagaṇā iti ॥2॥
6.97.4: droṇo bhīṣmaḥ kr̥paḥ śalyaḥ saumadattiśca saṁyuge,
na pārthān pratibādhante na jāne tacca kāraṇam ॥4॥
6.97.5d1: tvayi yuddhavimukhe cāpi jitaścāsmi hi pāṇḍavaiḥ,
droṇasya pramukhe vīrā hatāste bhrātaro mama.
6.97.7: mā śoca bharataśreṣṭha kariṣye’haṁ priyaṁ tava ॥7॥
6.97.8: nivr̥tte yudhi gāṅgeye nyastaśastre ca bhārata ॥8॥
6.97.9: paśyato yudhi bhīṣmasya śape satyena te nr̥pa ॥9॥
6.97.10: pāṇḍaveṣu dayāṁ nityaṁ sa hi bhīṣmaḥ karoti vai,
6.97.11: abhimānī raṇe bhīṣmo nityaṁ cāpi raṇapriyaḥ,
sa kathaṁ pāṇḍavān yuddhe jeṣyate tāta saṅgatān ॥11॥
6.97.12: sa tvaṁ śīghramito gatvā bhīṣmasya śibiraṁ prati,
anumānya guruṁ vr̥ddhaṁ śastraṁ nyāsaya bhārata ॥12॥
6.97.13: nyastaśastre tato bhīṣme nihatān paśya pāṇḍavān,
6.97.20: dhārtarāṣṭro mahārāja vibabhau sa pathi vrajan ॥20॥
6.97.23: taṁ prayāntaṁ naravyāghraṁ bhīṣmasya śibiraṁ prati,
6.97.28: dakṣiṇaṁ dakṣiṇaḥ kāle sambhr̥tya svabhujaṁ tadā,
6.97.32: sa taiḥ parivr̥to rājā pradīpaiḥ kāñcanairjvalan,
6.97.34: samprāpya tu tato rājā bhīṣmasya sadanaṁ śubham,
6.97.36: tvāṁ vayaṁ hi samāśritya saṁyuge śatrusūdana ॥36॥
6.97.38: tasmādarhasi gāṅgeya kr̥pāṁ kartuṁ mayi prabho,
jahi pāṇḍusutān vīrān mahendra iva dānavān ॥38॥
6.97.41: dayayā yadi vā rājan dveṣyabhāvānmama prabho,
6.97.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi bhīṣmaṁ prati duryodhanavākye saptanavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥97॥
6.98.4: abravīt tava putraṁ sa sāmapūrvamidaṁ vacaḥ,
6.98.5: ghaṭamānaṁ yathāśakti kurvāṇaṁ ca tava priyam,
6.98.9: yacca naḥ sahitān sarvān virāṭanagare tadā,
6.98.10: droṇaṁ ya yudhi saṁrabdhaṁ māṁ ca nirjitya saṁyuge,
6.98.12: vijitya ca yadā karṇaṁ sadā puruṣamāninam,
6.98.14: ko hi śakto raṇe jetuṁ pāṇḍavaṁ rabhasaṁ tadā,
6.98.16: tvaṁ tu mohānna jānīṣe vācyāvācyaṁ suyodhana ॥16॥
6.98.17: mumūrṣurhi naraḥ sarvān vr̥kṣān paśyati kāñcanān,
6.98.18: svayaṁ vairaṁ mahat kr̥tvā pāṇḍavaiḥ saha sr̥ñjayaiḥ,
yuddhyasva tānadya raṇe paśyāmaḥ puruṣo bhava ॥18॥
6.98.19: ahaṁ tu somakān sarvān pañcālāṁśca samāgatān,
6.98.20: tān vā nihatya samare prītiṁ dāsyāmyahaṁ tava ॥20॥
6.98.21: pūrvaṁ hi strī samutpannā śikhaṇḍī rājaveśmani,
varadānāt pumāñjātaḥ saiṣā vai strī śikhaṇḍinī ॥21॥
6.98.22: yāsau prāṅnirmitā dhātrā saiṣā vai strī śikhaṇḍinī ॥22॥
6.98.23: sukhaṁ svapihi gāndhāre śvo’pi kartā mahāraṇam,
yaṁ janāḥ kathayiṣyanti yāvat sthāsyati medinī ॥23॥
6.98.24: abhivādya guruṁ mūrdhnā prayayau svaṁ niveśanam ॥24॥
6.98.25: āgamya tu tato rājā visr̥jya ca mahājanam,
6.98.26: praviṣṭaḥ sa niśāṁ tāṁ ca gamayāmāsa pārthivaḥ,
prabhātāyāṁ ca śarvaryāṁ prātarutthāya tān nr̥paḥ ॥26॥
6.98.27: adya bhīṣmo raṇe kruddho nihaniṣyati somakān ॥27॥
6.98.33: sa no guptaḥ sahāyaḥ syāddhanyāt pārthāṁśca saṁyuge ॥33॥
6.98.34: strīpūrvako hyasau rājaṁstasmād varjyo mayā raṇe ॥34॥
6.98.35: rājyaṁ sphītaṁ mahābāho striyaśca tyaktavān purā ॥35॥
6.98.36: naivaṁ cāhaṁ striyaṁ jātu na strīpūrvaṁ kathañcana,
hanyāṁ yudhi naraśreṣṭha satyametad bravīmi te ॥36॥
6.98.37: ayaṁ strīpūrvako rājañchikhaṇḍī yadi te śrutaḥ,
udyoge kathitaṁ yattat tathā jātā śikhaṇḍinī ॥37॥
6.98.38: kanyā bhūtvā pumāñjātaḥ sa ca māṁ yodhayiṣyati,
tasyāhaṁ pramukhe bāṇān na muñceyaṁ kathañcana ॥38॥
6.98.40: evaṁ māṁ bharataśreṣṭha gāṅgeyaḥ prāha śāstravit,
6.98.41: arakṣyamāṇaṁ hi vr̥ko hanyāt siṁhaṁ mahāhave,
6.98.42: mātulaḥ śakuniḥ śalyaḥ kr̥po droṇo viviṁśatiḥ,
yattā rakṣantu gāṅgeyaṁ tasmin gupte dhruvo jayaḥ ॥42॥
6.98.44: kampayanto bhuvaṁ dyāṁ ca kṣobhayantaśca pāṇḍavān ॥44॥
6.98.46: sarve te sma vyatiṣṭhanta rakṣantastaṁ mahāratham ॥46॥
6.98.49: yathā bhīṣmaṁ na no hanyād duḥśāsana tathā kuru,
6.98.50: bhīṣmaṁ pramukhataḥ kr̥tvā prayayau saha senayā,
6.98.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi bhīṣmaduryodhanasaṁvāde aṣṭanavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥98॥
6.99.1: tataḥ śāntanavo bhīṣmo niryayau saha senayā,
6.99.3: bhīṣmeṇa sahitāḥ sarve putraiśca tava bhārata,
6.99.6: vyūhamadhye sthito rājan pāṇḍavān prati bhārata ॥6॥
6.99.8: evaṁ ca taṁ tadā vyūhaṁ kr̥tvā bhārata tāvakāḥ,
6.99.12: sthitā raṇe mahārāja mahatyā senayā vr̥tāḥ ॥12॥
6.99.15: pāṇḍavāḥ samare śūrāḥ sthitā yuddhāya daṁśitāḥ,
6.99.16: abhyudyayū raṇe pārthān bhīṣmaṁ kr̥tvāgrato nr̥pa,
6.99.24: diśaḥ prajvalitā rājan pāṁsuvarṣaṁ papāta ca ॥24॥
6.99.28: nipetuḥ sahasā bhūmau vedayantyo mahad bhayam ॥28॥
6.99.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi parasparavyūharacanāyāmutpātadarśane ekonaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥99॥
6.100.7: tasya tat kurvataḥ karma mahat saṅkhye mahībhr̥taḥ,
6.100.9: trātāraṁ nādhyagacchanta paṅke magnā iva dvipāḥ ॥9॥
6.100.14: śarāśca niśitāḥ pītā niścaranti sma saṁyuge,
6.100.16: mohayitvā kr̥paṁ droṇaṁ drauṇiṁ ca sabr̥hadbalam,
saindhavaṁ ca maheṣvāso vyacarallaghu suṣṭhu ca ॥16॥
6.100.18: taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā kṣatriyāḥ śūrāḥ pratapantaṁ tarasvinam,
6.100.22: taṁ śrutvā ninadaṁ ghoraṁ tava sainyasya bhārata,
6.100.24: tasya cānyanna paśyāmi saṁyuge bheṣajaṁ mahat ॥24॥
6.100.25: sa gatvā tvaritaṁ vīraṁ jahi saubhadramāhave ॥25॥
6.100.27: prayayau samare tūrṇaṁ tava putrasya śāsanāt,
6.100.28: tasya śabdena mahatā pāṇḍavānāṁ balaṁ mahat,
6.100.30: kārṣṇiścāpi mudā yuktaḥ pragr̥hya saśaraṁ dhanuḥ,
6.100.31: tataḥ sa rākṣasaḥ kruddhaḥ samprāpyaivārjuniṁ raṇe,
nātidūre sthitāṁ tasya drāvayāmāsa vai camūm ॥31॥
6.100.32: tāṁ vadhyamānāṁ ca tathā pāṇḍavānāṁ mahācamūm,
pratyudyayau raṇe rakṣo devasenāṁ yathā balaḥ ॥32॥
6.100.37: te tu kruddhā maheṣvāsā draupadeyāḥ prahāriṇaḥ,
rākṣasaṁ dudruvuḥ saṅkhye grahāḥ pañca raviṁ yathā ॥37॥
6.100.43: alambuṣo bhr̥śaṁ rājan nāgendra iva cukrudhe ॥43॥
6.100.49: virathāṁśca maheṣvāsān kr̥tvā tatra sa rākṣasaḥ,
6.100.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi alambuṣābhimanyusamāgame śatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥100॥
6.101.3: dhanañjayaśca kiṁ cakre mama sainyeṣu saṁyuge,
bhīmo vā rathināṁ śreṣṭho rākṣaso vā ghaṭotkacaḥ ॥3॥
6.101.4: etadācakṣva me satyaṁ kuśalo hyasi sañjaya ॥4॥
6.101.11: rathābhyāṁ rathinau śreṣṭhau yathā vai devadānavau,
6.101.16: te tasya viviśustūrṇaṁ kāyaṁ nirbhidya marmasu,
6.101.17: puṣpitaiḥ kiṁśukai rājan saṁstīrṇa iva parvataḥ,
6.101.19: tena te viśikhā muktā yamadaṇḍopamāḥ śitāḥ ॥19॥
6.101.22: vimukhaṁ ca tato rakṣo vadhyamānaṁ raṇe’riṇā ॥22॥
6.101.24: nābhimanyumapaśyanta naiva svān na parān raṇe,
6.101.28: hatamāyaṁ tato rakṣo vadhyamānaṁ ca sāyakaiḥ ॥28॥
6.101.30: ārjuniḥ samare sainyaṁ tāvakaṁ sammamarda ha,
6.101.32: koṣṭhīkr̥tya ca taṁ vīraṁ dhārtarāṣṭrā mahārathāḥ,
6.101.34: ubhayoḥ sadr̥śaṁ karma sa piturmātulasya ca,
6.101.44: abhyadravad raṇe drauṇiṁ rāhuḥ khe śaśinaṁ yathā ॥44॥
6.101.49: śaineyaṁ sa tu nirbhidya prāviśad dharaṇītalam,
6.101.50: ciccheda samare drauṇiḥ siṁhanādaṁ mumoca ha ॥50॥
6.101.55: dr̥ṣṭvā putraṁ ca taṁ grastaṁ rāhuṇeva niśākaram,
6.101.58: abhyadravad raṇe kruddho droṇaṁ prati mahārathaḥ ॥58॥
6.101.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi alambuṣābhimanyuyuddhe ekādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥101॥
6.102.2: priyo hi pāṇḍavo nityaṁ bhāradvājasya dhīmataḥ,
ācāryaśca raṇe nityaṁ priyaḥ pārthasya sañjaya ॥2॥
6.102.4: na droṇaḥ samare pārthaṁ jānīte priyamātmanaḥ,
6.102.5: na kṣatriyā raṇe rājan varjayanti parasparam,
6.102.6: raṇe bhārata pārthena droṇo viddhastribhiḥ śaraiḥ,
6.102.12: te śarāḥ prāpya kaunteyaṁ samantād viviśuḥ prabho,
6.102.13: arjunastu raṇe nādaṁ vinadya rathināṁ varaḥ,
6.102.15: mumucuḥ śaravr̥ṣṭiṁ ca pāṇḍavasya rathaṁ prati,
6.102.18: atha kruddho raṇe pārthastrigartān prati bhārata ॥18॥
6.102.22: praśaśāma tato vāyuḥ prasannāśca diśo daśa,
6.102.29: bhīmastu rathināṁ śreṣṭho gadāṁ gr̥hya mahāhave ॥29॥
6.102.38: prādravanta diśo rājan vimr̥dnantaḥ svakaṁ balam ॥38॥
6.102.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi bhīmaparākrame dvyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥102॥
6.103.3: sammamarda ca tat sainyaṁ pitā devavratastava,
6.103.5: dhr̥ṣṭadyumnaṁ tato viddhvā virāṭaṁ ca śaraistribhiḥ,
6.103.7: śikhaṇḍī taṁ ca vivyādha bharatānāṁ pitāmaham,
6.103.13: tathā bhīmo mahārāja draupadyāḥ pañca cātmajāḥ,
6.103.16: tatrāsīt sumahad yuddhaṁ tava teṣāṁ ca saṅkulam,
6.103.20: mr̥dnantaste narān rājan hayāṁśca subahūn raṇe,
6.103.22: r̥ddhyā vaiśravaṇaṁ cāti nayena ca br̥haspatim ॥22॥
6.103.31: tathaiva ca rathān rājan pramamarda raṇe gajaḥ,
6.103.32: evaṁ te bahudhā rājan pratyamr̥dnan parasparam ॥32॥
6.103.33: tasmin raudre tathā yuddhe vartamāne mahābhaye,
6.103.39: prākrośan kṣatriyāstatra dr̥ṣṭvā tad vaiśasaṁ mahat,
6.103.41: evaṁ bahuvidhā vācaḥ śrūyante sma parasparam,
6.103.43: bhīṣmaṁ droṇaṁ kr̥paṁ caiva śalyaṁ covāca bhārata,
6.103.44: tataḥ pravavr̥te yuddhaṁ kurūṇāṁ pāṇḍavaiḥ saha,
6.103.45: yat purā na nigr̥hṇāsi vāryamāṇo mahātmabhiḥ,
6.103.46: na hi pāṇḍusutā rājan sasainyāḥ sapadānugāḥ,
rakṣanti samare prāṇān kauravā vāpi saṁyuge ॥46॥
6.103.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi saṅkulayuddhe tryadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥103॥
6.104.2: suśarmāpi tato bāṇaiḥ pārthaṁ vivyādha saṁyuge,
vāsudevaṁ ca saptatyā pārthaṁ ca navabhiḥ punaḥ ॥2॥
6.104.4: vyadravanta raṇe rājan bhaye jāte mahārathāḥ ॥4॥
6.104.5: utsr̥jya turagān kecid rathān kecicca māriṣa,
6.104.7: nirapekṣā vyadhāvanta tena tena sma bhārata ॥7॥
6.104.9: tad balaṁ pradrutaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā putro duryodhanastava,
6.104.11: sa ekaḥ samare tasthau kiran bahuvidhāñśarān,
bhrātr̥bhiḥ sahitaḥ sarvaiḥ śeṣā hi pradrutā narāḥ ॥11॥
6.104.17: tathaiva drupado rājā droṇaṁ viddhvā śitaiḥ śaraiḥ,
6.104.20: samāgatau tau tu raṇe mahāmātrau vyarocatām ॥20॥
6.104.21: tasyāśvāṁścaturo hatvā sūtaṁ ca navabhiḥ śaraiḥ ॥21॥
6.104.22: hatāśvāt tu rathāt tūrṇaṁ so’vaplutya mahārathaḥ ॥22॥
6.104.36: chittvā śaktiṁ tu gāṅgeyaḥ sātyakiṁ navabhiḥ śaraiḥ,
6.104.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi vārṣṇeyayuddhe caturadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥104॥
6.105.3: tasya kāryaṁ tvayā vīra rakṣaṇaṁ sumahātmanaḥ ॥3॥
6.105.4: nihanyāt samare yattān pañcālān pāṇḍavaiḥ saha ॥4॥
6.105.7: parivārya sthito bhīṣmaṁ sainyena mahatā vr̥taḥ ॥7॥
6.105.10: nakulaṁ sahadevaṁ ca dharmarājaṁ ca pāṇḍavam,
6.105.12: khurāhatā dharā rājaṁścakampe ca nanāda ca ॥12॥
6.105.16: hreṣatāṁ caiva śabdena na prājñāyata kiñcana,
tato yudhiṣṭhiro rājā mādrīputrau ca pāṇḍavau ॥16॥
6.105.25: tato duryodhano dīno dr̥ṣṭvā sainyaṁ parājitam ॥25॥
6.105.26: eṣa pāṇḍusuto jyeṣṭho yamābhyāṁ sahito raṇe ॥26॥
6.105.27: paśyatāṁ vo mahābāho senāṁ drāvayati prabho,
6.105.28: putrasya tava tad vākyaṁ śrutvā śalyaḥ pratāpavān ॥28॥
6.105.29: sa yayau rathavaṁśena yatra rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ,
tadāpatad vai sahasā śalyasya sumahad balam ॥29॥
6.105.32: yudhiṣṭhiraṁ punaḥ ṣaṣṭyā vivyādha niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ ॥32॥
6.105.34d2: tato bhīṣmaśca droṇaśca sainyena mahatā vr̥tau,
6.106.1: tataḥ pitā tava kruddho niśitaiḥ sāyakottamaiḥ,
6.106.2: nakulaṁ ca tribhirviddhvā sahadevaṁ ca saptabhiḥ ॥2॥
6.106.28: abhajyata mahārāja na ca dvau saha dhāvataḥ,
6.106.29: jaghānātra pitā putraṁ putraśca pitaraṁ tathā ॥29॥
6.106.30: priyaṁ sakhāyaṁ cākrande sakhā daivabalāt kr̥taḥ,
6.106.33: ayaṁ sa kālaḥ samprāptaḥ pārtha yaḥ kāṅkṣitastava ॥33॥
6.106.34: yat purā kathitaṁ vīra rājñāṁ teṣāṁ samāgame ॥34॥
6.106.36: sānubandhān haniṣyāmi ye māṁ yotsyanti saṅgare,
iti tat kuru kaunteya satyaṁ vākyamarindama ॥36॥
6.106.38: avadhyānāṁ vadhaṁ kr̥tvā rājyaṁ vā narakottaram ॥38॥
6.106.39: duḥkhāni vanavāse vā kiṁ nu me sukr̥taṁ bhavet,
codayāśvān yato bhīṣmaḥ kariṣye vacanaṁ tava ॥39॥
6.106.42: tato bhīṣmaḥ kuruśreṣṭhaḥ siṁhavad vinadan muhuḥ ॥42॥
6.106.48: tasya tat pūjayāmāsa lāghavaṁ śāntanoḥ sutaḥ ॥48॥
6.106.49: sādhu sādhu mahābāho sādhu kuntīsuteti ca ॥49॥
6.106.50: mumoca samare bhīṣmaḥ śarān pārtharathaṁ prati ॥50॥
6.106.52d1: jaghāna samare murdhni siṁhavad vinadan muhuḥ.
6.106.60: hato bhīṣmo hato bhīṣmastatra tatra vaco mahat,
6.106.62: sa siṁha iva mātaṅgaṁ yūtharṣabha ivarṣabham,
6.106.63: asambhramaṁ raṇe bhīṣmo vicakarṣa mahad dhanuḥ ॥63॥
6.106.65: tvayā hi deva saṅgrāme hatasyāpi mamānagha ॥65॥
6.106.66: śreya eva paraṁ kr̥ṣṇa loke bhavati sarvataḥ,
6.106.67: praharasva yatheṣṭaṁ vai dāso’smi tava cānagha,
6.106.72: yat tvayā kathitaṁ pūrvaṁ na yotsyāmīti keśava,
6.106.73: mamaiṣa bhāraḥ sarvo hi haniṣyāmi pitāmaham,
śape keśava śastreṇa satyena sukr̥tena ca ॥73॥
6.106.76: na kiñciduktvā sakrodha āruroha rathaṁ punaḥ,
tau rathasthau naravyāghrau bhīṣmaḥ śāntanavaḥ punaḥ ॥76॥
6.106.79: tathā pāṇḍavasainyāni babhañja yudhi te pitā,
6.106.83: pipīlikā iva kṣuṇṇā durbalā balinā raṇe ॥83॥
6.106.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi navamadivasayuddhasamāptau ṣaḍadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥106॥
6.107.1: sandhyā samabhavad ghorā nāpaśyāma tato raṇam ॥1॥
6.107.2: tato yudhiṣṭhiro rājā sandhyāṁ sandr̥śya bhārata,
6.107.3: bhīṣmaṁ ca yudhi saṁrabdhaṁ pīḍayantaṁ mahāratham ॥3॥
6.107.4d2: buddhiṁ svaśibiraṁ gantuṁ cakre rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ.
6.107.10: tasmin rātrimukhe ghore pāṇḍavā vr̥ṣṇibhiḥ saha,
6.107.12: tato yudhiṣṭhiro rājā mantrayitvā ciraṁ nr̥pa,
6.107.13d1: mama mādhava sainyeṣu vadhyamāneṣu tena vai,
kathaṁ yotsyāma durdharṣaṁ śreyo me’tra vidhīyatām.
6.107.13d2: na yuddhaṁ rocate mahyaṁ bhīṣmeṇa saha mādhava,
hanti bhīṣmo mahāvīro mama sainyaṁ ca saṁyuge.
6.107.16: śakyo jetuṁ yamaḥ kruddho vajrapāṇiśca devarāṭ ॥16॥
6.107.17: na tu bhīṣmaḥ susaṅkruddhaḥ śakyo jetuṁ mahāhave ॥17॥
6.107.19: vanaṁ yāsyāmi durdharṣa śreyo vai tatra me gatam,
na yuddhaṁ rocate kr̥ṣṇa hanti bhīṣmo hi naḥ sadā ॥19॥
6.107.23: jīvitaṁ bahu manye’haṁ jīvitaṁ hyadya durlabham,
6.107.26: dharmaputra viṣādaṁ tvaṁ mā kr̥thāḥ satyasaṅgara,
yasya te bhrātaraḥ śūrā durjayāḥ śatrusūdanāḥ ॥26॥
6.107.28: māṁ vā niyuṅkṣva sauhārdād yotsye bhīṣmeṇa pāṇḍava,
tvatprayukto mahārāja kiṁ na kuryāṁ mahāhave ॥28॥
6.107.30: yadi bhīṣme hate vīre jayaṁ paśyasi pāṇḍava,
6.107.31: paśya me vikramaṁ rājan mahendrasyeva saṁyuge,
6.107.32: yaḥ śatruḥ pāṇḍuputrāṇāṁ macchatruḥ sa na saṁśayaḥ,
madarthā bhavadīyā ye ye madīyāstavaiva te ॥32॥
6.107.33: tava bhrātā mama sakhā sambandhī śiṣya eva ca,
6.107.34: eṣa cāpi naravyāghro matkr̥te jīvitaṁ tyajet,
6.107.35: sa māṁ niyuṅkṣva rājendra yathā yoddhā bhavāmyaham,
6.107.37: anujñātaṁ tu pārthena mayā kāryaṁ na saṁśayaḥ,
6.107.42: yasya me puruṣavyāghra bhavān pakṣe vyavasthitaḥ ॥42॥
6.107.43: tvayā nāthena govinda kimu bhīṣmaṁ mahāratham ॥43॥
6.107.45: mantrayiṣye tavārthāya na tu yotsye kathañcana ॥45॥
6.107.46: sa hi rājyasya me dātā mantrasyaiva ca mādhava ॥46॥
6.107.48: tad vayaṁ sahitā gatvā bhīṣmamāśu narottamam,
nacirāt sarve vārṣṇeya mantraṁ pr̥cchāma kauravam ॥48॥
6.107.49: yathā ca vakṣyate kr̥ṣṇa tathā kartāsmi saṁyuge ॥49॥
6.107.50: sa no jayasya dātā syānmantrasya ca dr̥ḍhavrataḥ,
bālāḥ pitrā vihīnāśca tena saṁvardhitā vayam ॥50॥
6.107.51: taṁ cet pitāmahaṁ vr̥ddhaṁ hantumicchāmi mādhava,
6.107.52: rocate me mahāprājña rājendra tava bhāṣitam ॥52॥
6.107.54: vaktumarhati satyaṁ sa tvayā pr̥ṣṭo viśeṣataḥ,
te vayaṁ tatra gacchāmaḥ praṣṭuṁ kurupitāmaham ॥54॥
6.107.55: gatvā śāntanavaṁ vr̥ddhaṁ mantraṁ pr̥cchāma bhārata,
sa vo dāsyati mantraṁ yaṁ tena yotsyāmahe parān ॥55॥
6.107.57: praviśya ca tadā bhīṣmaṁ śirobhiḥ praṇipedire ॥57॥
6.107.59: svāgataṁ tava vārṣṇeya svāgataṁ te dhanañjaya ॥59॥
6.107.60: kiṁ vā kāryaṁ karomyadya yuṣmākaṁ prītivardhanam ॥60॥
6.107.60d1: yuddhādanyatra he vatsāḥ vriyantāṁ mā viśaṅkatha,
6.107.61: tathā bruvāṇaṁ gāṅgeyaṁ prītiyuktaṁ punaḥ punaḥ ॥61॥
6.107.62: kathaṁ jayema sarvajña kathaṁ rājyaṁ labhemahi ॥62॥
6.107.63: prajānāṁ saṁśayo na syāt kathaṁ tanme vada prabho,
bhavān hi no vadhopāyaṁ bravītu svayamātmanaḥ ॥63॥
6.107.64: bhavantaṁ samare vīra viṣahema kathaṁ vayam,
na hi te sūkṣmamapyasti randhraṁ kurupitāmaha ॥64॥
6.107.67: ko’tha votsahate jetuṁ tvāṁ pumān bharatarṣabha,
6.107.68: kṣayaṁ nītā hi pr̥tanā saṁyuge mahatī mama,
yathā yudhi jayema tvāṁ yathā rājyaṁ bhr̥śaṁ mama ॥68॥
6.107.69: mama sainyasya ca kṣemaṁ tanme brūhi pitāmaha,
6.107.70: na kathañcana kaunteya mayi jīvati saṁyuge,
jayo bhavati sarvajña satyametad bravīmi te ॥70॥
6.107.71: nirjite mayi yuddhena raṇe jeṣyatha pāṇḍavāḥ,
kṣipraṁ mayi praharadhvaṁ yadīcchatha raṇe jayam ॥71॥
6.107.72: evaṁ hi sukr̥taṁ manye bhavatāṁ vidito hyaham ॥72॥
6.107.73: hate mayi hataṁ sarvaṁ tasmādevaṁ vidhīyatām,
brūhi tasmādupāyaṁ no yathā yuddhe jayemahi ॥73॥
6.107.75: na bhavān samare śakyaḥ sendrairapi surāsuraiḥ,
6.107.76: nāhaṁ jetuṁ raṇe śakyaḥ sendrairapi surāsuraiḥ,
6.107.77: tato māṁ nyastaśastraṁ tu ete hanyurmahārathāḥ,
6.107.78: dravamāṇe ca bhīte ca tavāsmīti ca vādini,
6.107.79: apraśaste nare caiva na yuddhaṁ rocate mama,
imaṁ me śr̥ṇu rājendra saṅkalpaṁ pūrvacintitam ॥79॥
6.107.80: ya eṣa draupado rājaṁstava sainye mahārathaḥ ॥80॥
6.107.81: yathābhavacca strī pūrvaṁ paścāt puṁstvaṁ samāgataḥ ॥81॥
6.107.85: na taṁ paśyāmi lokeṣu māṁ hanyād yaḥ samudyatam ॥85॥
6.107.87: māṁ pātayatu bībhatsurevaṁ tava jayo dhruvam ॥87॥
6.107.88: etat kuruṣva kaunteya yathoktaṁ mama suvrata,
6.107.89: te tu jñātvā tataḥ pārthā jagmuḥ svaśibiraṁ prati,
6.107.92: krīḍatā hi mayā bālye vāsudeva mahāmanāḥ,
6.107.94: iti māmabravīd bālye yaḥ sa vadhyaḥ kathaṁ mayā ॥94॥
6.107.95: kāmaṁ vadhyatu sainyaṁ me nāhaṁ yotsye mahātmanā,
jayo vāstu vadho vā me kathaṁ vā kr̥ṣṇa manyase ॥95॥
6.107.95d1: nyastaśastre ca vr̥ddhe ca prahareddhi pitāmahe.
6.107.96: pratijñāya vadhaṁ jiṣṇo purā bhīṣmasya saṁyuge,
kṣatradharme sthitaḥ pārtha kathaṁ nainaṁ haniṣyasi ॥96॥
6.107.98: yad dr̥ṣṭaṁ hi purā pārtha tat tathā na tadanyathā ॥98॥
6.107.100: jahi bhīṣmaṁ sthiro bhūtvā śr̥ṇu cedaṁ vaco mama,
6.107.103: śikhaṇḍī nidhanaṁ kr̥ṣṇa bhīṣmasya bhavitā dhruvam,
dr̥ṣṭvaiva hi sadā bhīṣmaḥ pāñcālyaṁ vinivartate ॥103॥
6.107.104: te vayaṁ pramukhe tasya puraskr̥tya śikhaṇḍinam,
6.107.106: śrutaṁ hi kurumukhyasya nāhaṁ hanyāṁ śikhaṇḍinam,
kanyā hyeṣā purā bhūtvā puruṣaḥ samapadyata ॥106॥
6.107.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi navamadivasāvahārottaramantre saptādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥107॥
6.108.7: tato yudhiṣṭhiro rājā yamābhyāṁ sahitaḥ prabhuḥ,
6.108.8: virāṭastu tataḥ paścāt svena sainyena saṁvr̥taḥ,
6.108.11: tathaiva kuravo rājan bhīṣmaṁ kr̥tvā mahāratham,
6.108.16: divase divase prāpte bhīṣmaḥ śāntanavo yudhi,
6.108.17: tataḥ pravavr̥te yuddhaṁ tava teṣāṁ ca bhārata,
6.108.25: kathaṁ vā pāṇḍavān yuddhe pratyudyātaḥ parantapaḥ,
6.108.26: ācakṣe te mahārāja yadakārṣīt pitā tava,
6.108.28: nāmr̥ṣyata tadā bhīṣmaḥ sainyaghātaṁ raṇe paraiḥ ॥28॥
6.108.30: sa pāṇḍavānāṁ pravarān pañca rājan mahārathān ॥30॥
6.108.32: nijaghne samare kruddho hastyaśvaṁ cāmitaṁ bahu,
6.108.37: tad dr̥ṣṭvā samare karma putrāstava viśāmpate,
6.108.38: pārthā vimanaso bhūtvā praikṣanta pitaraṁ tava ॥38॥
6.108.42: sa tenātibhr̥śaṁ viddhaḥ prekṣya bhīṣmaḥ śikhaṇḍinam,
6.108.43: kāmamabhyasa vā mā vā na tvāṁ yotsye kathañcana,
yaiva hi tvaṁ kr̥tā dhātrā saiva hi tvaṁ śikhaṇḍinī ॥43॥
6.108.44: tasya tad vacanaṁ śrutvā śikhaṇḍī krodhamūrcchitaḥ,
6.108.45: mayā śrutaṁ ca te yuddhaṁ jāmadagnyena vai saha ॥45॥
6.108.46: divyaśca te prabhāvo’yaṁ mayā ca bahuśaḥ śrutaḥ,
jānannapi prabhāvaṁ te yotsye’dyāhaṁ tvayā saha ॥46॥
6.108.48: dhruvaṁ ca tvāṁ haniṣyāmi śape satyena te’grataḥ,
etacchrutvā ca madvākyaṁ yat kr̥tyaṁ tat samācara ॥48॥
6.108.49: kāmamabhyasa vā mā vā na me jīvan pramokṣyase,
6.108.51: tasya tad vacanaṁ śrutvā savyasācī mahārathaḥ,
6.108.53: na hi te saṁyuge pīḍāṁ śaktaḥ kartuṁ mahābalaḥ,
6.108.54: ahatvā samare bhīṣmaṁ yadi yāsyasi māriṣa,
6.108.55: tathā kuru raṇe yatnaṁ sādhayasva pitāmaham ॥55॥
6.108.56: ahaṁ te rakṣaṇaṁ yuddhe kariṣyāmi mahābala,
6.108.57: droṇaṁ ca droṇaputraṁ ca kr̥paṁ cātha suyodhanam,
citrasenaṁ vikarṇaṁ ca saindhavaṁ ca jayadratham ॥57॥
6.108.58: bhagadattaṁ tathā śūraṁ māgadhaṁ ca mahābalam ॥58॥
6.108.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi bhīṣmaśikhaṇḍīsamāgame aṣṭādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥108॥
6.109.3: kathaṁ śāntanavo bhīṣmaḥ sa tasmin daśame’hani,
6.109.4: na mr̥ṣyāmi raṇe bhīṣmaṁ pratyudyātaṁ śikhaṇḍinā,
6.109.9: pañcālāḥ pāṇḍavaiḥ sārdhaṁ sarve te nābhyavārayan ॥9॥
6.109.11: na hi bhīṣmaṁ maheṣvāsaṁ pāṇḍavāḥ pāṇḍupūrvaja,
6.109.13: śaraughān visr̥jan pārtho vyacarat kālavad raṇe ॥13॥
6.109.22: nānyāṁ gatiṁ prapaśyāmi sthāne yuddhe ca bhārata ॥22॥
6.109.28: adya cāpi mahat karma prakariṣye mahābala,
ahaṁ vādya hataḥ śeṣye haniṣye vādya pāṇḍavān ॥28॥
6.109.29: adya te puruṣavyāghra pratimokṣye r̥ṇaṁ tava,
6.109.33: pañcālānāṁ ca ye śreṣṭhā rājaputrā mahārathāḥ,
6.109.35: prajajvāla raṇe bhīṣmo vidhūma iva pāvakaḥ ॥35॥
6.109.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi bhīṣmaduryodhanasaṁvāde navādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥109॥
6.110.1: arjunastu raṇe rājan dr̥ṣṭvā bhīṣmasya vikramam,
6.110.2: na cāpi bhīstvayā kāryā bhīṣmādadya kathañcana,
6.110.11: tathaiva nakulaṁ śūraṁ kirantaṁ sāyakān bahūn ॥11॥
6.110.12: sahadevaṁ tathā rājan yāntaṁ bhīṣmarathaṁ prati ॥12॥
6.110.14: sātyakiṁ samare yāntaṁ tava putro nyavārayat ॥14॥
6.110.19: anye ca tāvakā yodhāḥ pāṇḍavānāṁ mahārathān ॥19॥
6.110.22: abhidravata mā bhaiṣṭa bhīṣmo hi prāpsyate na vaḥ,
6.110.26: tathaiva pāṇḍavāḥ śūrā gāṅgeyasya rathaṁ prati ॥26॥
6.110.29: tathaiva pāṇḍavaṁ kruddhaṁ tava putro nyavārayat,
ubhau tau rathināṁ śreṣṭhāvubhau bhārata durjayau ॥29॥
6.110.30: ubhau candrārkasadr̥śau kāntyā dīptyā ca bhārata,
6.110.33: te tasya kavacaṁ bhittvā papuḥ śoṇitamāhave ॥33॥
6.110.39: tasya pārtho dhanuśchittvā rathaṁ cāsya tribhiḥ śaraiḥ,
ājaghāna tataḥ paścāt putraṁ te niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ ॥39॥
6.110.43: tataḥ kruddho raṇe pārthaḥ śarān sandhāya kārmuke ॥43॥
6.110.45: yathā haṁsā mahārāja taḍāgaṁ prāpya bhārata,
6.110.46: hitvā pārthaṁ raṇe tūrṇaṁ bhīṣmasya rathamāvrajat,
6.110.47: avārayat tataḥ śūro bhūya eva parākramī ॥47॥
6.110.48: śaraiḥ suniśitaiḥ pārthaṁ yathā vr̥traṁ purandaraḥ,
6.110.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi arjunaduḥśāsanasamāgame daśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥110॥
6.111.3: tathaiva rākṣaso rājan mādhavaṁ navabhiḥ śaraiḥ,
6.111.6: mādhavastu bhr̥śaṁ viddho rākṣasena raṇe tadā,
vāryamāṇaśca tejasvī jahāsa ca nanāda ca ॥6॥
6.111.8: vihāya rākṣasaṁ yuddhe śaineyo rathināṁ varaḥ,
6.111.9: tasya prāgjyotiṣo rājā mādhavasya mahad dhanuḥ,
6.111.10: bhagadattaṁ raṇe kruddhaṁ vivyādha niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ ॥10॥
6.111.13: sātyakiḥ samare rājan dvidhā ciccheda sāyakaiḥ,
6.111.15: duryodhano bhr̥śaṁ kruddho bhrātr̥̄n sarvānuvāca ha ॥15॥
6.111.16: tathā kuruta kauravyā yathā vaḥ sātyako yudhi,
6.111.17: tasmin hate hataṁ manye pāṇḍavānāṁ mahad balam,
6.111.19: punareva catuḥṣaṣṭyā rājan vivyādha taṁ nr̥pa ॥19॥
6.111.23: tataḥ pravavr̥te yuddhaṁ tayostasya ca bhārata ॥23॥
6.111.26: aśvatthāmā tatastau tu vivyādha bahubhiḥ śaraiḥ,
6.111.28: yathā nāgo vane nāgaṁ matto mattamupādravat ॥28॥
6.111.34: nakulaṁ tu raṇe kruddho vikarṇaḥ śatrutāpanaḥ,
vivyādha sāyakaiḥ ṣaṣṭyā rakṣan bhīṣmaṁ mahābalam ॥34॥
6.111.37: ghaṭotkacaṁ raṇe yāntaṁ nighnantaṁ tava vāhinīm,
6.111.39: ṣaṣṭyā vīro nadan hr̥ṣṭo vivyādha raṇamūrdhani ॥39॥
6.111.41: punaḥ pañcāśatā tūrṇaṁ tiṣṭha tiṣṭheti cābravīt ॥41॥
6.111.42: taṁ caiva pārṣato rājan hārdikyaṁ navabhiḥ śaraiḥ ॥42॥
6.111.50: yudhiṣṭhiraṁ tu kaunteyaṁ mahatyā senayā vr̥tam,
6.111.52: sā senā mahatī rājan pāṇḍuputrasya saṁyuge,
droṇena vāritā yattā na cacāla padāt padam ॥52॥
6.111.53: cekitānaṁ raṇe yattaṁ bhīṣmaṁ prati janeśvara,
6.111.56: vimukhīkr̥tya putraṁ te senāṁ tava mamarda ha ॥56॥
6.111.57: kathaṁ bhīṣmaṁ na no hanyāditi niścitya bhārata ॥57॥
6.111.58: sā vadhyamānā samare putrasya tava vāhinī,
6.111.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi dvandvayuddhe ekādaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥111॥
6.112.4: ayaṁ hi divasastāta yatra pārtho mahābalaḥ,
jighāṁsuḥ samare bhīṣmaṁ paraṁ yatnaṁ kariṣyati ॥4॥
6.112.5: utpatanti hi me bāṇā dhanuḥ prasphuratīva ca,
yogamastrāṇi gacchanti krūre me vartate matiḥ ॥5॥
6.112.7: rasate vyathate bhūmiḥ kampatīva ca sarvaśaḥ ॥7॥
6.112.11: kampante ca hasante ca nr̥tyanti ca rudanti ca ॥11॥
6.112.13: dhārtarāṣṭrasya sainyeṣu na ca bhrājanti daṁśitāḥ ॥13॥
6.112.16: hr̥ṣyanti romakūpāṇi sīdatīva ca me manaḥ,
6.112.18: abravīcca purā bhīṣmo nāhaṁ hanyāṁ śikhaṇḍinam,
strī hyeṣā vihitā dhātrā daivācca sa punaḥ pumān ॥18॥
6.112.20: etad vicintayānasya prajñā sīdati me bhr̥śam,
6.112.24: vijayī ca raṇe nityaṁ bhairavāstraśca pāṇḍavaḥ,
tasya mārgaṁ pariharan drutaṁ gaccha yatavrata ॥24॥
6.112.25: hemacitrāṇi śūrāṇāṁ mahānti ca śubhāni ca ॥25॥
6.112.26: chidyante ca dhvajāgrāṇi tomarāśca dhanūṁṣi ca ॥26॥
6.112.28: yāhi svargaṁ puraskr̥tya yaśase vijayāya ca ॥28॥
6.112.30: brahmaṇyatā damo dānaṁ tapaśca caritaṁ mahat,
ihaiva dr̥śyate pārthe bhrātā yasya dhanañjayaḥ ॥30॥
6.112.39: uttamāstrāṇi cādhatsva gr̥hītvā ca mahad dhanuḥ,
pārṣataṁ yāhi rājānaṁ yudhyasva ca vr̥kodaram ॥39॥
6.112.40: ko hi necchet priyaṁ putraṁ jīvantaṁ śāśvatīḥ samāḥ,
6.112.41: eṣa cātiraṇe bhīṣmo dahate vai mahācamūm,
6.112.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi droṇāśvatthāmasaṁvāde dvādaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥112॥
6.113.1: bhagadattaḥ kr̥paḥ śalyaḥ kr̥tavarmā tathaiva ca,
6.113.3: bhīṣmasya samare rājan prārthayānā mahad yaśaḥ ॥3॥
6.113.7: sa tān sarvān mahārāja rājamānān pr̥thak pr̥thak ॥7॥
6.113.9: kr̥pasya saśaraṁ cāpaṁ madhye ciccheda bhārata ॥9॥
6.113.11: durmarṣaṇaṁ ca viṁśatyā citrasenaṁ ca pañcabhiḥ,
6.113.15: saindhavasya tathāśvāṁśca sārathiṁ ca tribhiḥ śaraiḥ,
6.113.17: tasya bhīmo dhanurmadhye dvābhyāṁ ciccheda māriṣa,
6.113.20: tadā na mamr̥ṣe śalyo bhīmasenasya vikramam ॥20॥
6.113.21: bhīmaṁ vivyādha samare tiṣṭha tiṣṭheti cābravīt ॥21॥
6.113.24: sa ca tān prativivyādha pañcabhiḥ pañcabhiḥ śaraiḥ,
śalyaṁ vivyādha saptatyā punaśca daśabhiḥ śaraiḥ ॥24॥
6.113.25: sārathiṁ cāsya bhallena gāḍhaṁ vivyādha marmaṇi ॥25॥
6.113.28: te hi yattā maheṣvāsāḥ pāṇḍavaṁ yuddhakovidam,
6.113.35: dvābhyāṁ dvābhyāṁ tu vivyādha gautamaprabhr̥tīn rathān,
te’pi taṁ samare rājan vivyadhurniśitaiḥ śaraiḥ ॥35॥
6.113.37: te cāpi rathināṁ śreṣṭhā bhīmāya niśitāñcharān,
6.113.39: tomaraṁ saindhavo rājā paṭṭiśaṁ ca mahābhujaḥ,
śataghnīṁ ca kr̥po rājañcharaṁ śalyaśca saṁyuge ॥39॥
6.113.42: sa bibheda śataghnīṁ ca navabhiḥ kaṅkapatribhiḥ,
6.113.46: nighnantaṁ samare śatrūn yodhayānaṁ ca sāyakaiḥ,
tau tu tatra mahātmānau sametau vīkṣya pāṇḍavau ॥46॥
6.113.49: ye sma bhīmaṁ raṇe rājan yodhayanto vyavasthitāḥ,
6.113.51: suśarman gaccha śīghraṁ tvaṁ balaughaiḥ parivāritaḥ,
6.113.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi bhīmaparākrame trayodaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥113॥
6.114.2: prāgjyotiṣaṁ ca samare saindhavaṁ ca jayadratham ॥2॥
6.114.3: durmarṣaṇaṁ ca rājendra hyāvantyau ca mahārathau ॥3॥
6.114.5: jayadratho raṇe pārthaṁ viddhvā bhārata sāyakaiḥ,
6.114.6: śalyaśca samare jiṣṇuṁ kr̥paśca rathināṁ varaḥ,
6.114.8: tau tatra rathināṁ śreṣṭhau kaunteyau bharatarṣabhau ॥8॥
6.114.11: teṣāṁ ca rathināṁ madhye kaunteyau bharatarṣabhau ॥11॥
6.114.13: chittvā dhanūṁṣi śūrāṇāṁ śarāṁśca bahudhā raṇe,
6.114.14: rathāśca bahavo bhagnā hayāśca śataśo hatāḥ,
6.114.20: śaraiḥ saṁvārya tān vīrān yajjaghāna mahābalaḥ ॥20॥
6.114.23: kauravāṇāṁ camūṁ ghorāṁ bhr̥śaṁ dudruvatū raṇe ॥23॥
6.114.27: tasya pārtho dhanuśchittvā hastāvāpaṁ ca pañcabhiḥ,
6.114.36: taṁ bhīmaḥ samaraślāghī guruṁ pitr̥samaṁ raṇe,
6.114.38: tato bhīṣmaśca rājā ca kausalyaśca br̥hadbalaḥ,
6.114.43: tatra pāṇḍusutaiḥ sārdhaṁ bhīṣmasya vijayaṁ prati ॥43॥
6.114.44: tāvakānāṁ jaye bhīṣmo glaha āsīd viśāmpate,
6.114.47: bhīṣmo’pi rathināṁ śreṣṭhaḥ pratijagrāha tāṁ camūm,
6.114.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi bhīmārjunaparākrame caturdaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥114॥
6.115.3: yathā ca tadabhūd yuddhaṁ tat tu vakṣyāmi sāmpratam ॥3॥
6.115.13: śr̥ṇuṣva vacanaṁ tāta dharmyaṁ svargyaṁ ca jalpataḥ ॥13॥
6.115.14: ghnataśca me gataḥ kālaḥ subahūn prāṇino raṇe ॥14॥
6.115.15: madvadhe kriyatāṁ yatno mama cedicchasi priyam ॥15॥
6.115.16: bhīṣmaṁ prati yayau rājā saṅgrāme saha sr̥ñjayaiḥ ॥16॥
6.115.20: mā vo bhīṣmād bhayaṁ kiñcidastvadya yudhi sr̥ñjayāḥ,
6.115.21: te tathā samayaṁ kr̥tvā daśame’hani pāṇḍavāḥ,
6.115.22: bhīṣmasya pātane yatnaṁ paramaṁ te samāsthitāḥ ॥22॥
6.115.30: drauṇiṁ prati yayau yattaḥ pāñcālyaḥ saha sodaraiḥ ॥30॥
6.115.32: śikhaṇḍinaṁ ca putrāste pāṇḍavaṁ ca dhanañjayam,
6.115.34: tāvakānāṁ pareṣāṁ ca dr̥ṣṭvā śāntanavaṁ raṇe ॥34॥
6.115.42: tatrāsīt sumahad yuddhaṁ kurūṇāṁ pāṇḍavaiḥ saha,
6.115.43: teṣāṁ samāgamo ghoro babhūva yudhi saṅgataḥ,
6.115.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi bhīṣmopadeśe pañcadaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥115॥
6.116.4: dvidhā ciccheda te putraḥ kṣurapreṇa mahārathaḥ ॥4॥
6.116.5: tāṁ śaktiṁ patitāṁ dr̥ṣṭvā kārṣṇiḥ paramakopanaḥ,
6.116.7: tad yuddhamabhavad ghoraṁ citrarūpaṁ ca bhārata,
6.116.11: aśvatthāmā tu samare sātyakiṁ navabhiḥ śaraiḥ,
6.116.15: nanāda balavannādaṁ vivyādha ca śitaiḥ śaraiḥ ॥15॥
6.116.17: tau tu tatra maheṣvāsau mahāmātrau mahārathau,
6.116.18: anyonyasya dhanuśchittvā hayān hatvā ca bhārata,
6.116.27: punarvivyādha taṁ ṣaṣṭyā punaśca navabhiḥ śaraiḥ ॥27॥
6.116.28: suśarmā tu raṇe kruddhastava putraṁ viśāmpate,
6.116.29: ājaghāna raṇe kruddhaḥ sa ca taṁ pratyavidhyata ॥29॥
6.116.30: bhīṣmasya samare rājan yaśo mānaṁ ca vardhayan,
6.116.33: nākampayata saṅgrāme vivyādha ca punaḥ śaraiḥ,
6.116.35: phālguniṁ samare kruddho vivyādha bahubhiḥ śaraiḥ,
6.116.46: tato droṇo mahārāja pārṣatasya mahad dhanuḥ,
6.116.51: sā chinnā bahudhā rājan droṇacāpacyutaiḥ śaraiḥ,
6.116.55: arjunaḥ prāpya gāṅgeyaṁ pīḍayan niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ,
6.116.56: pratyudyayau ca taṁ rājā bhagadattaḥ pratāpavān,
6.116.61: prayayau tvarito rājan drupadasya rathaṁ prati ॥61॥
6.116.63: tataste tāvakāḥ śūrāḥ pāṇḍavaṁ rabhasaṁ yudhi,
6.116.69: nādayan sa diśo bhīṣmaḥ pradiśaśca mahāhave ॥69॥
6.116.77: na tatrāsīd raṇe rājan somakānāṁ mahārathaḥ ॥77॥
6.116.78: yaḥ samprāpya raṇe bhīṣmaṁ jīvite sma mano dadhe,
tāṁśca sarvān raṇe yodhān pretarājapuraṁ prati ॥78॥
6.116.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi saṅkulayuddhe ṣoḍaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥116॥
6.117.3: strītvaṁ tasya smaran rājan sarvalokasya paśyataḥ,
nājaghāna raṇe bhīṣmaḥ sa ca tannāvabuddhavān ॥3॥
6.117.5: kiṁ te vivakṣayā vīra jahi bhīṣmaṁ mahāratham,
6.117.6: r̥te tvāṁ puruṣavyāghra satyametad bravīmi te ॥6॥
6.117.9: tathaiva ca camūṁ sarvāṁ pāṇḍavānāṁ mahārathaḥ,
6.117.10: tathaiva pāṇḍavā rājan sainyena mahatā vr̥tāḥ,
6.117.11: nirdadāha raṇe śūrān vane vahniriva jvalan ॥11॥
6.117.12: ayodhayacca yat pārthaṁ jugopa ca pitāmaham ॥12॥
6.117.13: karmaṇā tena samare tava putrasya dhanvinaḥ,
6.117.19: sa hi taṁ samare rājan nirjitya vijayo’rjunaḥ ॥19॥
6.117.22: śikhaṇḍī tu raṇe rājan vivyādhaiva pitāmaham,
6.117.23: na ca sma te rujaṁ cakruḥ pitustava janeśvara,
6.117.27: bhīṣmo vaḥ samare sarvān pālayiṣyati dharmavit,
te bhayaṁ sumahat tyaktvā pāṇḍavān prati yudhyata ॥27॥
6.117.28: sarveṣāṁ dhārtarāṣṭrāṇāṁ samare śarma varma ca ॥28॥
6.117.30: tasmād dravata mā yodhāḥ phālgunaṁ prāpya saṁyuge,
6.117.31: tacchrutvā tu vaco rājaṁstava putrasya dhanvinaḥ ॥31॥
6.117.35: abhipetū raṇe pārthaṁ pataṅgā iva pāvakam,
6.117.42: te tu bhittvā tava sutaṁ duḥśāsanamayomukhāḥ ॥42॥
6.117.43: hayāṁścāsya tato jaghne sārathiṁ ca nyapātayat ॥43॥
6.117.44: viviṁśatiṁ ca viṁśatyā virathaṁ kr̥tavān prabhuḥ,
6.117.45: kr̥paṁ vikarṇaṁ śalyaṁ ca viddhvā bahubhirāyasaiḥ,
6.117.46: evaṁ te virathāḥ sarve kr̥paḥ śalyaśca māriṣa,
6.117.48: prajajvāla raṇe pārtho vidhūma iva pāvakaḥ,
6.117.57: śvānaḥ kākāśca gr̥dhrāśca vr̥kā gomāyubhiḥ saha,
6.117.58: dr̥śyamāneṣu rakṣaḥsu bhūteṣu ca nadatsu ca ॥58॥
6.117.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi saṅkulayuddhe saptadaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥117॥
6.118.2: rathā na rathibhiḥ sārdhaṁ pādātā na padātibhiḥ ॥2॥
6.118.8: yathā hi śaiśiraḥ kālo gavāṁ marmāṇi kr̥ntati,
tathā pāṇḍusutānāṁ vai bhīṣmo marmāṇi kr̥ntati ॥8॥
6.118.9: tathaiva tava sainyasya pārthena ca mahātmanā,
6.118.13: bhīṣme ca yudhi vikrānte pāṇḍave ca dhanañjaye,
6.118.14: icchanto nidhanaṁ yuddhe svargaṁ kr̥tvā parāyaṇam ॥14॥
6.118.16: kleśān kr̥tān saputreṇa tvayā pūrvaṁ narādhipa,
bhayaṁ tyaktvā raṇe śūrā brahmalokāya tatparāḥ ॥16॥
6.118.27: śatānīkaṁ ca samare hatvā bhīṣmaḥ pratāpavān ॥27॥
6.118.30: evaṁ daśa diśo bhīṣmaḥ śarajālaiḥ samantataḥ,
6.118.31: sa kr̥tvā sumahat karma tasmin vai daśame’hani,
6.118.32: na cainaṁ pārthivāḥ kecicchaktā rājan nirīkṣitum,
madhyaṁ prāptaṁ yathā grīṣme tapantaṁ bhāskaraṁ divi ॥32॥
6.118.40: yamau ca cekitānaśca kekayāḥ pañca caiva ha,
6.118.42: ete cānye ca bahavaḥ pīḍitā bhīṣmasāyakaiḥ,
6.118.48: vidhūya tān bāṇagaṇān ye muktāḥ pārthivottamaiḥ ॥48॥
6.118.54: tatastasya ca teṣāṁ ca yuddhe devāsuropame,
6.118.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi bhīṣmaparākrame aṣṭādaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥118॥
6.119.1: evaṁ te pāṇḍavāḥ sarve puraskr̥tya śikhaṇḍinam,
6.119.5: na vivyathe tadā bhīṣmo bhidyamāneṣu marmasu,
6.119.9: tataḥ sātyakibhīmau ca pāṇḍavaṁ ca dhanañjayam ॥9॥
6.119.10: drupadaṁ ca virāṭaṁ ca dhr̥ṣṭadyumnaṁ ca pārṣatam,
6.119.11: tasya te niśitān bāṇān saṁnivārya mahārathāḥ ॥11॥
6.119.12: śikhaṇḍī tu mahābāṇān yān mumoca mahārathaḥ ॥12॥
6.119.13: na cakruste rujaṁ tasya svarṇapaṅkhāḥ śilāśitāḥ,
6.119.19: ityāsīt tumulaḥ śabdaḥ phālgunasya rathaṁ prati,
taṁ śabdaṁ tumulaṁ śrutvā pāṇḍavānāṁ mahārathāḥ ॥19॥
6.119.23: śikhaṇḍī tu raṇe śreṣṭho rakṣyamāṇaḥ kirīṭinā ॥23॥
6.119.26: evaṁ sa pāṇḍavaḥ kruddha āttamāttaṁ punaḥ punaḥ,
6.119.28: tāṁ ca cikṣepa saṅkruddhaḥ phālgunasya rathaṁ prati,
6.119.29: tasya ciccheda tāṁ śaktiṁ pañcadhā pañcabhiḥ śaraiḥ ॥29॥
6.119.30: sā papāta tathā cchinnā saṅkruddhena kirīṭinā ॥30॥
6.119.33: yadyeṣāṁ na bhaved goptā viṣvakseno mahābalaḥ,
6.119.34: pitrā tuṣṭena me pūrvaṁ yadā kālīmudāvaham ॥34॥
6.119.37: yat te vyavasitaṁ tāta tadasmākamapi priyam,
tat kuruṣva mahārāja yuddhe buddhiṁ nivartaya ॥37॥
6.119.40: na ca tacchuśruve kaścit teṣāṁ saṁvadatāṁ nr̥pa,
r̥te bhīṣmaṁ mahābāhuṁ māṁ cāpi munitejasā ॥40॥
6.119.42: iti devagaṇānāṁ ca vākyaṁ śrutvā mahātapāḥ,
6.119.49: śikhaṇḍī tu raṇe bāṇān yān mumoca mahārathaḥ ॥49॥
6.119.50: na cakruste rujaṁ tasya rukmapuṅkhāḥ śilāśitāḥ,
6.119.56: eṣa pārtho raṇe kruddhaḥ pāṇḍavānāṁ mahārathaḥ,
6.119.57: na caiṣa samare śakyo jetuṁ vajrabhr̥tā api,
6.119.58: māṁ cāpi śaktā nirjetuṁ kimu martyā mahārathāḥ,
evaṁ tayoḥ saṁvadatoḥ phālguno niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ ॥58॥
6.119.62: musalā iva me ghnanti neme bāṇāḥ śikhaṇḍinaḥ,
6.119.65: arjunasya ime bāṇā neme bāṇāḥ śikhaṇḍinaḥ ॥65॥
6.119.66: kr̥ntanti mama gātrāṇi māghamāṁ segavā iva,
sarve hyapi na me duḥkhaṁ kuryuranye narādhipāḥ ॥66॥
6.119.68: śaktiṁ bhīṣmaḥ sa pārthāya tataścikṣepa bhārata,
6.119.75: tatrāsīt tumulaṁ yuddhaṁ tāvakānāṁ paraiḥ saha ॥75॥
6.119.78: samaṁ ca viṣamaṁ caiva na prājñāyata kiñcana,
6.119.79: tataḥ senāmukhe tasmin sthitaḥ pārtho dhanurdharaḥ ॥79॥
6.119.81: pīḍyamānāḥ śitaiḥ śastraiḥ prādravāma raṇe tadā,
6.119.85: ityāsīt tumulaḥ śabdo rājan bhīṣmarathaṁ prati ॥85॥
6.119.88: hāheti divi devānāṁ pārthivānāṁ ca bhārata ॥88॥
6.119.90: saha bhīṣmeṇa sarveṣāṁ prāpatan hr̥dayāni naḥ,
6.119.91: dharaṇīṁ na sa pasparśa śarasaṅghaiḥ samāvr̥taḥ ॥91॥
6.119.92: rathāt prapatitaṁ cainaṁ divyo bhāvaḥ samāviśat ॥92॥
6.119.93: patan sa dadr̥śe cāpi dakṣiṇena divākaram ॥93॥
6.119.94: sañjñāṁ copālabhad vīraḥ kālaṁ sañcintya bhārata,
antarikṣe ca śuśrāva divyā vācaḥ samantataḥ ॥94॥
6.119.100: te tu bhīṣmaṁ samāsādya r̥ṣayo haṁsarūpiṇaḥ,
6.119.101: te taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā mahātmānaṁ kr̥tvā cāpi pradakṣiṇam,
6.119.102: bhīṣmaḥ kathaṁ mahātmā san saṁsthātā dakṣiṇāyane ॥102॥
6.119.105: udagāyana āditye haṁsāḥ satyaṁ bravīmi vaḥ ॥105॥
6.119.107: yaśca datto varo mahyaṁ pitrā tena mahātmanā ॥107॥
6.119.109: ityuktvā tāṁstadā haṁsān sa śete śaratalpagaḥ,
evaṁ kurūṇāṁ patite śr̥ṅge bhīṣme mahaujasi ॥109॥
6.119.113: dadhyuścaiva mahārāja na yuddhe dadhire manaḥ,
6.119.114: avadhye śantanoḥ putre hate bhīṣme mahaujasi,
6.119.116: pāṇḍavāśca jayaṁ labdhvā paratra ca parāṁ gatim,
6.119.121: bharatānāṁ ca ye pūrve te cainaṁ praśaśaṁsire,
6.119.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi bhīṣmanipātane ekonaviṁśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥119॥
6.120.2: na prāharad yadā bhīṣmo ghr̥ṇitvād drupadātmajam ॥2॥
6.120.3: adyāhaṁ pitaraṁ śrutvā nihataṁ sma sudurmatiḥ ॥3॥
6.120.4: śrutvā vinihataṁ bhīṣmaṁ śatadhā yanna dīryate ॥4॥
6.120.12: rarāsa pr̥thivī caiva bhīṣme śāntanave hate ॥12॥
6.120.13: ayaṁ brahmavidāṁ śreṣṭho hyayaṁ brahmavidāṁ varaḥ,
6.120.16: na kiñcit pratyapadyanta putrāstava hi māriṣa ॥16॥
6.120.23: dr̥ṣṭvā ca patitaṁ bhīṣmaṁ putro duḥśāsanastava,
6.120.31: te tu bhīṣmaṁ samāsādya śayānaṁ bharatarṣabham,
6.120.33: svāgataṁ vo mahābhāgāḥ svāgataṁ vo mahārathāḥ,
6.120.35: tato nr̥pāḥ samājahrustanūni ca mr̥dūni ca,
6.120.38: dhanañjaya mahābāho śiro me tāta lambate,
6.120.40: preṣyo’haṁ tava durdharṣa kriyatāṁ kiṁ pitāmaha ॥40॥
6.120.42: śayanasyānurūpaṁ vai śīghraṁ vīra prayaccha me,
tvaṁ hi pārtha samartho vai śreṣṭhaḥ sarvadhanuṣmatām ॥42॥
6.120.47: prāha sarvān samudvīkṣya bharatān bhārataṁ prati,
6.120.52: ye tadā māṁ gamiṣyanti te ca prekṣyanti māṁ nr̥pāḥ,
6.120.56: tān dr̥ṣṭvā jāhnavīputraḥ provāca tanayaṁ tava ॥56॥
6.120.58: kṣatradharme praśastāṁ hi prāpto’smi paramāṁ gatim,
6.120.63: te’bhivādya tato bhīṣmaṁ kr̥tvā ca triḥ pradakṣiṇam,
vidhāya rakṣāṁ bhīṣmasya sarva eva samantataḥ ॥63॥
6.120.66: diṣṭyā jayasi kauravya diṣṭyā bhīṣmo nipātitaḥ ॥66॥
6.120.68: tvāṁ tu cakṣurhaṇaṁ prāpya dagdho ghoreṇa cakṣuṣā,
6.120.69: tava prasādād vijayaḥ krodhāt tava parājayaḥ,
tvaṁ hi naḥ śaraṇaṁ kr̥ṣṇa bhaktānāmabhayaṅkaraḥ ॥69॥
6.120.70: rakṣitā samare nityaṁ nityaṁ cāpi hite rataḥ ॥70॥
6.120.71: sarvathā tvāṁ samāsādya nāścaryamiti me matiḥ,
6.120.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi bhīṣmopadhānadāne viṁśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥120॥
6.121.6: upāramya ca yuddhebhyaḥ saṁnāhān vipramucya te,
6.121.13: nādyātītā mayā śakyā bhogāḥ kecana mānuṣāḥ ॥13॥
6.121.16: atiṣṭhat prāñjaliḥ prahvaḥ kiṁ karomīti cābravīt ॥16॥
6.121.19: tvaṁ hi śakto maheṣvāsa dātumāpo yathāvidhi ॥19॥
6.121.20: adhijyaṁ balavat kr̥tvā gāṇḍīvaṁ vyākṣipad dhanuḥ ॥20॥
6.121.21: vitresuḥ sarvabhūtāni sarve śrutvā ca pārthivāḥ ॥21॥
6.121.22: tataḥ pradakṣiṇaṁ kr̥tvā rathena rathināṁ varaḥ,
6.121.23: sandhāya ca śaraṁ dīptamabhimantrya sa pāṇḍavaḥ
6.121.24: avidhyat pr̥thivīṁ pārthaḥ pārśve bhīṣmasya dakṣiṇe,
utpapāta tato dhārā vāriṇo vimalā śubhā ॥24॥
6.121.39: dr̥ṣṭaṁ duryodhanaitat te yathā pārthena dhīmatā,
6.121.40: etasya kartā loke’smin nānyaḥ kaścana vidyate,
6.121.42: sarvasmin mānuṣe loke vettyeko hi dhanañjayaḥ,
kr̥ṣṇo vā devakīputro nānyo vedeha kaścana ॥42॥
6.121.44: kr̥tinā samare rājan sandhirbhavatu mā ciram ॥44॥
6.121.45: tāvat pārthena śūreṇa sandhiste tāta yujyatām ॥45॥
6.121.46: yāvanna te camūḥ sarvāḥ śaraiḥ saṁnataparvabhiḥ,
6.121.48: yudhiṣṭhiro raṇe tāvat sandhiste tāta yujyatām ॥48॥
6.121.50: tāvat te pāṇḍavairvīraiḥ sauhārdaṁ mama rocate,
6.121.51: etat tu rocatāṁ vākyaṁ yadukto’si mayānagha,
etat kṣemamahaṁ manye tava caiva kulasya ca ॥51॥
6.121.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi duryodhanaṁ prati bhīṣmavākye ekaviṁśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥121॥
6.122.1: tataste pārthivāḥ sarve jagmuḥ svānālayān punaḥ,
6.122.2: śrutvā tu nihataṁ bhīṣmaṁ rādheyaḥ puruṣarṣabhaḥ,
6.122.5: dveṣyo’haṁ tava sarvatra iti cainamuvāca ha ॥5॥
6.122.8: ehyehi me vipratīpa spardhase tvaṁ mayā saha,
yadi māṁ nādhigacchethā na te śreyo dhruvaṁ bhavet ॥8॥
6.122.9: kaunteyastvaṁ na rādheyo na tavādhirathaḥ pitā,
6.122.10: na ca dveṣo’sti me tāta tvayi satyaṁ bravīmi te ॥10॥
6.122.14: brahmaṇyatāṁ ca śauryaṁ ca dāne ca paramāṁ sthitim ॥14॥
6.122.18: tathā ca balavān rājā jarāsandho durāsadaḥ,
6.122.19: brahmaṇyaḥ sattvayodhī ca tejasā ca balena ca,
6.122.20: vyapanīto’dya manyurme yastvāṁ prati purā kr̥taḥ,
6.122.23: yathā vadasi me bhīṣma kaunteyo’haṁ na sūtajaḥ ॥23॥
6.122.24d1: purā duryodhanenāhaṁ snehaṁ vai kr̥tavān mudā,
tava kāryaṁ kariṣyāmi yad yat sarvaṁ durāsadam.
6.122.24d2: ityevaṁ vai pratijñātaṁ vacanaṁ vai suyodhane,
6.122.25: vasu caiva śarīraṁ ca putradāraṁ tathā yaśaḥ ॥25॥
6.122.26: mā caitad vyādhimaraṇaṁ kṣatraṁ syāditi kaurava ॥26॥
6.122.27: avaśyabhāvī hyartho’yaṁ yo na śakyo nivartitum ॥27॥
6.122.30: vijayiṣye raṇe pāṇḍūniti me niścitaṁ manaḥ ॥30॥
6.122.33: yanmayeha kr̥taṁ kiñcit tanme tvaṁ kṣantumarhasi ॥33॥
6.122.38: praśame hi kr̥to yatnaḥ sumahān suciraṁ mayā,
na caiva śakitaḥ kartuṁ karṇa satyaṁ bravīmi te ॥38॥
6.122.39: rādheyo rathamāruhya prāyāt tava sutaṁ prati ॥39॥
6.122.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi bhīṣmakarṇasaṁvāde dvāviṁśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥122॥
6.mahima.1: śr̥ṇvate te mahārāja proktaṁ pāpaharaṁ śubham ॥1॥
6.mahima.2: yaḥ śrāvayet sadā rājan brāhmaṇān vedapāragān,
śraddhāvantaśca ye cāpi śroṣyanti manujā bhuvi ॥2॥
6.mahima.3: prayānti tat padaṁ viṣṇoryat prāpya na nivartate ॥3॥
